h2h.summary: 8 selected senior meetings available in our dataset: England 3 wins, Norway 2, 3 draws. Complete historical coverage has not been confirmed.

keyPlayers.basis: Team-level key-player watchlist; replace with API/squad-sourced fixture notes when available

home.name: Erling Haaland
home.note: Norway's headline finisher, a box force who changes how every opponent defends crosses and depth.

home.name: Martin Odegaard
home.note: The left-footed creator and rhythm setter, responsible for turning Norway's possession into service for Haaland.

home.name: Antonio Nusa
home.note: The young wide spark, able to beat defenders and give Norway a different speed outside the main stars.

away.name: Jude Bellingham
away.note: The connector between midfield and attack, dangerous because he arrives late rather than standing still as a No. 10.

away.name: Harry Kane
away.note: England's captain and central finisher. His dropping movements can pull center-backs out of shape.

away.name: Declan Rice
away.note: The balance piece in midfield, responsible for stopping counters before opponents can slow the game down.

keyInformation.home: Norway are a direct star-powered side whose attacking question is how quickly they can serve the finisher, led by Erling Haaland, Martin Odegaard, and Antonio Nusa. Against England, their Odegaard-to-Haaland supply has to beat England's Kane-Bellingham box entries. They want to get Odegaard facing forward and deliver early enough for Haaland to attack the box. The risk is England can attack quickly through Kane and Bellingham while Rice controls the counter.
keyInformation.away: England are one of the strongest teams in the tournament, built around power, speed, and danger near goal, led by Jude Bellingham, Harry Kane, and Declan Rice. Against Norway, their Kane-Bellingham box entries has to beat Norway's Odegaard-to-Haaland supply. They want to turn Kane's dropping movements into Bellingham runs and fast cutbacks from wide areas. The risk is Norway can feed Haaland through Odegaard's service and Nusa's change of speed.

resultStoryBullets: Schjelderup put Norway in front in the 36th minute, but Bellingham answered before halftime after England absorbed a tense opening half.
Norway had a second-half goal ruled out for Haaland's foul and later hit the crossbar, keeping the tie at 1-1 into extra time.
Bellingham struck again early in extra time to complete his brace, sending England through 2-1 to an Argentina semi-final.
resultStoryBulletsZh: 施耶尔德鲁普第36分钟让挪威领先，但裘德·贝林厄姆半场前扳平，英格兰撑过了紧张的上半场。
挪威下半场一粒进球因哈兰德犯规被判无效，随后还曾击中横梁，比赛以1比1进入加时。
裘德·贝林厄姆加时赛开局再度破门完成梅开二度，英格兰2比1晋级并将在半决赛对阵阿根廷。

resultStoryResearch.note: FOX/AP plus official FOX Sports highlights checked for the opener, Bellingham brace, disallowed goal, crossbar chance, and semi-final path.

h2h.summary: 7 selected senior meetings available in our dataset: Argentina 5 wins, Switzerland 0, 2 draws. Complete historical coverage has not been confirmed.

keyPlayers.basis: Team-level key-player watchlist; replace with API/squad-sourced fixture notes when available

home.name: Lionel Messi
home.note: Argentina's central attacking reference, whose between-lines gravity can turn pressure into clean chances.

home.name: Julian Alvarez
home.note: Argentina's pressing forward and flexible finisher, dangerous whether he starts moves or attacks the last line.

home.name: Enzo Fernandez
home.note: The midfield passer who can change the angle of attacks and keep Argentina's control from going stale.

away.name: Granit Xhaka
away.note: Switzerland's rhythm setter, controlling where the match is played and when pressure releases.

away.name: Manuel Akanji
away.note: The defensive organizer, especially important when Switzerland have to manage direct central attacks.

away.name: Breel Embolo
away.note: A powerful runner who can turn Switzerland's possession into box entries.

keyInformation.home: Argentina are the defending champions and still one of the most complete tournament teams, led by Lionel Messi, Julian Alvarez, and Enzo Fernandez. Against Switzerland, their Messi-Alvarez midfield breaks has to beat Switzerland's Xhaka-Embolo control-and-release. They want to press high through Alvarez, find Messi in space behind midfield, and let Enzo Fernandez change the angle of the attack. The risk is Switzerland can slow the game through Xhaka and use Embolo as the release valve.
keyInformation.away: Switzerland are a tournament-tested structure team who rarely look rushed when the match gets tense, led by Granit Xhaka, Manuel Akanji, and Breel Embolo. Against Argentina, their Xhaka-Embolo control-and-release has to beat Argentina's Messi-Alvarez midfield breaks. They want to let Xhaka dictate the first pass and find Embolo before the opponent can squeeze midfield. The risk is Argentina can turn one midfield win into Messi touches, Alvarez movement, and Enzo service.

resultStoryBullets: Mac Allister headed in Messi's early corner, giving Argentina control before Switzerland dragged the quarter-final into a grind.
Ndoye pulled Switzerland level in the 67th minute, but Embolo's second yellow left them protecting 1-1 with ten men.
Alvarez curled Argentina back ahead in the 112th minute and Lautaro Martinez finished it late, setting up the England semi-final.
resultStoryBulletsZh: 麦卡利斯特开场阶段接梅西角球头球破门，阿根廷取得控制权，但瑞士随后把四分之一决赛拖进硬仗。
恩多耶第67分钟为瑞士扳平，不过恩博洛第二张黄牌离场，让瑞士只能十人守住1比1。
阿尔瓦雷斯第112分钟弧线球帮助阿根廷再度领先，劳塔罗·马丁内斯尾声锁定胜局，半决赛将对阵英格兰。

resultStoryResearch.note: AP, Guardian, and official FOX Sports highlights reviewed for the opener, equalizer, Embolo dismissal, extra-time winner, and semi-final path.

The risk is France can combine Olise's final ball with Mbappe's acceleration before Saliba controls the counter.

resultStoryBullets: Yamal won the 22nd-minute penalty, and Oyarzabal converted his fifth goal of the tournament.
Spain controlled midfield and isolated Mbappé, stopping France from building sustained pressure.
Porro finished a slick one-two with Olmo, sealing Spain's 2-0 win and first World Cup final since 2010.

resultStoryResearch.note: FIFA's match report was reviewed for Spain's control, Mbappe's limited chances, the penalty, and Porro's one-two with Olmo.

resultStoryBulletsZh: 亚马尔赢得第22分钟点球，奥亚萨瓦尔罚入个人本届赛事第五球。

波罗与奥尔莫完成漂亮二过一后破门，锁定西班牙2比0取胜并自2010年以来首次晋级世界杯决赛。

reason.en: Spain conceded only once in eight matches without becoming passive. De la Fuente kept the same clear 4-3-3 identity while shifting between patient possession, aggressive pressing and a more secure knockout shape; two of his substitutes then combined for the winning goal in the final.
reason.es: España solo encajó una vez en ocho partidos sin volverse pasiva. De la Fuente mantuvo una identidad clara de 4-3-3 mientras alternaba posesión paciente, presión agresiva y una estructura más segura en las eliminatorias; dos de sus suplentes combinaron después para el gol del título en la final.
reason.zh: 西班牙8场比赛只丢1球，却没有因此变得保守。德拉富恩特始终保持清晰的4-3-3体系，同时在耐心控球、主动逼抢与更稳固的淘汰赛结构之间灵活调整；决赛中，两名替补球员又联手制造了制胜球。
reason.ko: 스페인은 8경기에서 단 1골만 내주면서도 수동적으로 변하지 않았다. 데 라 푸엔테는 명확한 4-3-3 정체성을 유지한 채 차분한 점유, 적극적인 압박과 더 안정적인 토너먼트 구조를 오갔고, 결승에서는 교체 선수 두 명이 결승골을 합작했다.

selection.methodology: A performance-based XI selected across the full tournament, with extra weight for knockout matches and a balance of individual output, tactical responsibility, and positional fit in a functioning 4-3-3. The Honorable Mentions panel displays 15 players across the 11 roles, including additional researched options where more than one player was selected for a role.

methodologyLocalized.en: The Honorable Mentions panel displays 15 players across the 11 roles, including additional researched options where more than one player was selected for a role.
methodologyLocalized.es: El panel de Menciones honoríficas muestra a 15 jugadores repartidos entre los 11 puestos, con opciones investigadas adicionales cuando se eligió a más de un jugador para una función.
methodologyLocalized.zh: “荣誉提名”面板按11个位置展示15名球员；部分位置经过资料核查后选入了不止一名候选人。
methodologyLocalized.ko: 명예의 11인 패널은 11개 역할에 걸쳐 15명을 보여 주며, 한 역할에 두 명 이상을 선정한 경우 추가 검토 후보도 포함합니다.

sources.label: Argentina v Cabo Verde match report

en: Kobel made 20 saves, kept two clean sheets and prevented 3.27 goals compared with the quality of shots he faced, the best shot-stopping figure among tournament goalkeepers.
He was not protected by Spain-level territorial control, and his set positioning, reach and patience in one-on-ones carried Switzerland to the quarterfinals.
es: Kobel hizo 20 paradas, dejó dos porterías a cero y evitó 3,27 goles respecto a la calidad de los remates que recibió, la mejor cifra de paradas entre los porteros del torneo.
No contó con el control territorial de España, y su colocación, alcance y paciencia en los mano a mano llevaron a Suiza hasta los cuartos de final.
zh: 科贝尔完成20次扑救、两场零封；按射门质量计算，他比预期少丢3.27球，是本届赛事门将中最佳的扑救表现。
他没有西班牙那样的控场保护，但稳定的站位、覆盖范围和单刀球中的耐心帮助瑞士闯入八强。
ko: 코벨은 20개의 선방과 2경기 무실점을 기록했고, 상대 슈팅의 질을 기준으로 예상보다 3.27골을 덜 내줘 대회 골키퍼 중 최고의 선방 수치를 남겼다.
스페인 수준의 점유 통제를 보호막으로 누리지 못했지만, 안정적인 위치 선정과 넓은 방어 범위, 일대일 상황의 인내심으로 스위스를 8강까지 이끌었다.

en: Simón kept seven clean sheets, conceded only once and won the official Golden Glove, although Spain’s defensive control meant he made only ten saves.
His value came through concentration, starting position and clean distribution; Kobel edged him on individual shot-stopping rather than overall tournament security.
es: Simón dejó siete porterías a cero, encajó una sola vez y ganó el Guante de Oro oficial, aunque el control defensivo de España hizo que solo tuviera que realizar diez paradas.
Su valor estuvo en la concentración, posición inicial y distribución limpia; Kobel lo superó por la capacidad individual de parar remates, no por la seguridad global del torneo.
zh: 西蒙完成7场零封、仅丢1球，并获得官方金手套；不过西班牙的防守控制意味着他只需完成10次扑救。
他的价值来自专注、初始站位和清晰出球；科贝尔凭个人扑救能力压过他，而不是因为整届赛事的稳定性更高。
ko: 시몬은 7경기 무실점과 단 1실점으로 공식 골든글러브를 받았지만, 스페인의 수비 통제 덕분에 선방은 10개만 필요했다.
집중력과 출발 위치, 깔끔한 배급이 그의 가치였다. 대회 전체의 안정감보다 개인 선방 능력에서 코벨이 근소하게 앞섰다.

en: Vozinha played 390 minutes across Cabo Verde’s remarkable four-match debut, kept Spain scoreless and made eight saves against Argentina, four from Messi.
His reflexes, bravery in holding his position and composure under sustained pressure made him the tournament’s defining underdog goalkeeper.
es: Vozinha jugó 390 minutos en los cuatro notables partidos del debut de Cabo Verde, dejó a España sin marcar y realizó ocho paradas ante Argentina, cuatro de ellas a Messi.
Sus reflejos, valentía para mantener la posición y serenidad bajo presión constante lo convirtieron en el portero de la gran historia inesperada del torneo.
zh: 沃齐尼亚在佛得角令人惊叹的世界杯首秀中4场出战390分钟，零封西班牙，并在对阿根廷时完成8次扑救，其中4次挡出梅西的射门。
他的反应、坚守站位的勇气，以及持续受压下的沉着，使他成为本届赛事最具代表性的黑马门将。
ko: 보지냐는 카보베르데의 놀라운 월드컵 데뷔 4경기에서 390분을 뛰며 스페인을 무득점으로 막고, 아르헨티나전에서는 메시의 슛 4개를 포함해 8개의 선방을 기록했다.
반사 신경과 자리를 지키는 용기, 지속적인 압박 속 침착함으로 대회를 대표하는 언더독 골키퍼가 됐다.

reason.en: Martínez made 11 saves in the final and kept Argentina alive until extra time. It was one of the tournament’s defining knockout goalkeeping displays.
reason.es: Martínez hizo 11 paradas en la final y mantuvo con vida a Argentina hasta la prórroga. Fue una de las grandes actuaciones de un portero en las eliminatorias.
reason.zh: 马丁内斯在决赛完成11次扑救，让阿根廷一直坚持到加时赛。这是本届淘汰赛最具代表性的门将表现之一。
reason.ko: 마르티네스는 결승에서 11개의 선방을 기록하며 아르헨티나를 연장전까지 버티게 했다. 이번 대회 토너먼트를 대표하는 골키퍼 활약 중 하나였다.

en: Hakimi logged 570 minutes across Morocco’s six matches and contributed one goal and two assists, including a goal-and-assist performance against Haiti.
His overlaps, inside carries and recovery speed made him Morocco’s main progression route while still allowing him to defend the position as a genuine right-back.
es: Hakimi disputó 570 minutos en los seis partidos de Marruecos y aportó un gol y dos asistencias, incluida una actuación con gol y asistencia ante Haití.
Sus desdoblamientos, conducciones interiores y velocidad de recuperación lo convirtieron en la principal vía de progresión marroquí sin dejar de defender como un lateral derecho auténtico.
zh: 哈基米在摩洛哥的6场比赛中出场570分钟，贡献1球2助攻，其中对海地一战传射建功。
他的套边、向内带球和回追速度让他成为摩洛哥最主要的推进通道，同时仍能以真正右后卫的方式完成防守。
ko: 하키미는 모로코의 6경기에서 570분을 뛰며 1골 2도움을 기록했고, 아이티전에서는 골과 도움을 모두 올렸다.
오버래핑, 안쪽으로 파고드는 운반과 빠른 복귀로 모로코의 주된 전진 경로가 되면서도 정통 오른쪽 풀백의 수비 책임을 다했다.

en: Porro scored twice, delivered a defender-leading 24 open-play crosses and created ten chances before scoring against France and playing all 120 minutes of the final.
Hakimi narrowly took the positional award, but Porro’s width, repeated overlaps and early delivery were central to Spain’s title run.
es: Porro marcó dos goles, envió 24 centros en juego abierto —la mayor cifra entre defensas— y creó diez ocasiones, además de marcar ante Francia y disputar los 120 minutos de la final.
Hakimi ganó por poco el puesto, pero la amplitud, los desdoblamientos constantes y los centros tempranos de Porro fueron centrales en el camino de España al título.
zh: 波罗攻入2球，送出后卫中最多的24次运动战传中，并创造10次机会；他还在对法国时进球，并打满决赛120分钟。
哈基米以微弱优势获得该位置，但波罗提供的宽度、连续套边和早早传中，是西班牙夺冠之路的重要组成。
ko: 포로는 2골을 넣고 수비수 중 가장 많은 오픈 플레이 크로스 24개와 기회 창출 10회를 기록했으며, 프랑스전 득점 뒤 결승 120분을 모두 소화했다.
하키미가 근소하게 자리를 차지했지만 포로의 폭, 반복되는 오버래핑과 빠른 타이밍의 크로스는 스페인의 우승 여정에서 핵심이었다.

reason.en: Senaya defended aggressively without losing control, repeatedly stopping attacks on Ghana’s right. Injury interrupted an impressive knockout run.
reason.es: Senaya defendió con agresividad y control, frenando una y otra vez los ataques por la derecha de Ghana. Una lesión interrumpió su gran fase eliminatoria.
reason.zh: 塞纳亚防守积极却不失控制，多次在加纳右路终结对手进攻。伤病中断了他原本出色的淘汰赛征程。
reason.ko: 세나야는 과감하면서도 침착한 수비로 가나의 오른쪽에서 여러 차례 공격을 끊었다. 부상으로 인상적인 토너먼트 활약이 일찍 끝났다.

en: Cubarsí played every minute for the champions, completed 671 of 699 passes, created eight chances and helped Spain keep a record seven clean sheets.
His scanning before receiving, brave line-breaking distribution and composure when defending open space made him the tournament’s most complete centre-back.
es: Cubarsí disputó todos los minutos con la campeona, completó 671 de 699 pases, creó ocho ocasiones y ayudó a España a lograr un récord de siete porterías a cero.
Su lectura antes de recibir, sus valientes pases entre líneas y su serenidad al defender espacios abiertos lo convirtieron en el central más completo del torneo.
zh: 库巴西为冠军队打满全部比赛，699次传球成功671次，创造8次机会，并帮助西班牙创纪录地完成7场零封。
接球前的观察、勇敢的穿线传球，以及防守开阔空间时的沉着，使他成为本届赛事最全面的中后卫。
ko: 쿠바르시는 우승팀의 모든 경기에서 전 시간을 뛰며 699개 중 671개의 패스를 완성하고 8번의 기회를 만들었으며, 스페인의 대회 기록인 7경기 무실점에 기여했다.
공을 받기 전의 시야, 과감한 라인 브레이킹 패스와 넓은 공간을 수비하는 침착함으로 대회에서 가장 완성도 높은 센터백이 됐다.

en: Saliba started six matches and played 480 minutes before his tournament ended 30 minutes into France’s semifinal defeat.
His recovery pace, body orientation and ability to defend large spaces allowed France to hold a higher line, but the shortened campaign left him behind Cubarsí and Laporte.
es: Saliba fue titular en seis partidos y jugó 480 minutos antes de que su torneo terminara a los 30 minutos de la derrota de Francia en semifinales.

Su velocidad de recuperación, orientación corporal y capacidad para defender espacios amplios permitieron a Francia sostener una línea alta, pero el torneo abreviado lo dejó detrás de Cubarsí y Laporte.
zh: 萨利巴首发6场、出场480分钟，他的赛事在法国半决赛失利的第30分钟结束。
回追速度、身体朝向和防守大片空间的能力让法国可以维持更高防线，但较短的赛事历程使他排在库巴西和拉波尔特之后。
ko: 살리바는 6경기에 선발로 나서 480분을 뛰었고, 프랑스가 패한 준결승 30분에 그의 대회가 끝났다.
빠른 복귀와 몸의 방향, 넓은 공간을 지키는 능력으로 프랑스가 높은 수비선을 유지할 수 있었지만 짧아진 출전 기간 때문에 쿠바르시와 라포르트에 뒤졌다.

en: Akanji played every minute of Switzerland’s six-match run, 600 in total, including the full 120 against Argentina in the quarterfinal.
He defended large spaces behind an adventurous midfield, progressed possession without panic and provided the organization that allowed Kobel’s shot-stopping to matter.
es: Akanji disputó todos los minutos de los seis partidos de Suiza, 600 en total, incluidos los 120 completos ante Argentina en cuartos de final.
Defendió grandes espacios detrás de un mediocampo ambicioso, hizo progresar la posesión sin precipitarse y aportó la organización que dio valor a las paradas de Kobel.
zh: 阿坎吉打满瑞士6场比赛，共600分钟，其中包括四分之一决赛对阿根廷的全部120分钟。
他保护积极中场身后的大片空间，沉着推进球权，并提供防线组织，让科贝尔的扑救真正产生意义。
ko: 아칸지는 스위스의 6경기 600분을 모두 뛰었고, 아르헨티나와의 8강 120분도 전부 소화했다.
공격적인 중원 뒤의 넓은 공간을 지키고 침착하게 공을 전진시키며, 코벨의 선방이 의미를 갖게 한 수비 조직을 제공했다.

en: Laporte appeared in all eight matches, played 729 minutes and made 229 forward passes, more than any other centre-back.
His left-footed circulation, aerial positioning and calm covering behind Spain’s aggressive press gave the champions an experienced defensive organizer alongside Cubarsí.
es: Laporte participó en los ocho partidos, jugó 729 minutos y dio 229 pases hacia adelante, más que cualquier otro central.
Su circulación con la zurda, colocación aérea y coberturas serenas detrás de la presión agresiva de España dieron a la campeona un organizador defensivo experimentado junto a Cubarsí.
zh: 拉波尔特出战全部8场、累计729分钟，并送出229次向前传球，为所有中后卫之最。
他的左脚组织、高空球站位，以及在西班牙主动逼抢身后的冷静补位，让冠军队在库巴西身旁拥有一名经验丰富的防线组织者。
ko: 라포르트는 8경기에 모두 출전해 729분을 뛰고 센터백 중 가장 많은 229개의 전진 패스를 기록했다.
왼발 전개, 공중볼 위치 선정과 스페인의 적극적인 압박 뒤를 침착하게 커버하는 능력으로 쿠바르시 옆에서 우승팀 수비를 조직했다.

en: Lisandro recorded one goal and one assist, both in Argentina’s dramatic 3–2 victory over Cabo Verde, while also making 34 clearances and 169 forward passes.
His front-foot aggression, left-footed progression and appetite for box defending made him a serious main-XI candidate before injury shortened his final.
es: Lisandro sumó un gol y una asistencia, ambos en la dramática victoria argentina por 3–2 ante Cabo Verde, además de realizar 34 despejes y 169 pases hacia adelante.
Su agresividad para anticipar, progresión con la zurda y gusto por defender el área lo hicieron un candidato serio al once antes de que una lesión acortara su final.
zh: 利桑德罗贡献1球1助攻，均来自阿根廷3比2险胜佛得角一战；他还完成34次解围和169次向前传球。
主动上抢的侵略性、左脚推进和对禁区防守的投入，使他一度成为主力阵容的有力候选，直到伤病缩短了他的决赛。
ko: 리산드로는 아르헨티나가 카보베르데에 3-2로 극적인 승리를 거둔 경기에서 1골 1도움을 모두 기록했고, 클리어링 34개와 전진 패스 169개도 남겼다.
앞으로 나서는 공격적인 수비와 왼발 전진, 박스 수비에 대한 적극성으로 베스트 XI의 유력 후보였지만 부상으로 결승 출전이 짧아졌다.

reason.en: Upamecano’s recovery speed protected the space behind France’s midfield and let the team defend higher without losing control of its own penalty area.
reason.es: La velocidad de recuperación de Upamecano protegió el espacio a la espalda del mediocampo francés y permitió defender más arriba sin perder el control del área.
reason.zh: 于帕梅卡诺的回追速度保护了法国中场身后的空间，让球队能够提高防线，同时不失去对禁区的控制。
reason.ko: 우파메카노의 빠른 복귀는 프랑스 중원 뒤 공간을 보호했고, 페널티 지역의 통제력을 잃지 않은 채 수비 라인을 높일 수 있게 했다.

en: Cucurella created three big chances and generated 1.19 expected assists, including two assists against Austria.
He also won three tackles as Spain denied France a single big chance in the semifinal; his pressing, underlapping runs and ability to defend high or deep made him the outstanding left-back.
es: Cucurella creó tres grandes ocasiones y generó 1,19 asistencias esperadas, incluidas dos asistencias ante Austria.

También ganó tres entradas mientras España no concedió una sola gran ocasión a Francia en la semifinal; su presión, desmarques interiores y capacidad para defender arriba o atrás lo convirtieron en el lateral izquierdo más destacado.
zh: 库库雷利亚创造3次绝佳机会，预期助攻达到1.19，其中对奥地利一战送出2次助攻。
半决赛西班牙没有让法国获得一次绝佳机会，他也成功完成3次抢断；逼抢、内线前插以及高位低位皆能防守的能力，使他成为最出色的左后卫。
ko: 쿠쿠레야는 오스트리아전 2도움을 포함해 3번의 결정적 기회를 만들고 1.19의 기대 도움을 기록했다.
스페인이 준결승에서 프랑스에 결정적 기회를 하나도 허용하지 않는 동안 태클 3개를 따냈고, 압박과 안쪽 침투, 높은 위치와 낮은 위치를 모두 지키는 능력으로 대회 최고의 왼쪽 풀백이 됐다.

en: Mendes scored against Uzbekistan and created four big chances, more than any other defender, despite playing only 398 minutes across five appearances.
His acceleration, recovery speed and ability to advance inside or outside made him Portugal’s strongest two-way outlet, but Cucurella produced the more complete tournament.
es: Mendes marcó ante Uzbekistán y creó cuatro grandes ocasiones, más que cualquier otro defensa, pese a jugar solo 398 minutos en cinco partidos.

Su aceleración, velocidad de recuperación y capacidad para avanzar por dentro o por fuera lo hicieron la vía más fuerte de Portugal en ambas direcciones, pero Cucurella completó un torneo más completo.
zh: 门德斯对乌兹别克斯坦进球，并创造4次绝佳机会，为所有后卫之最，尽管他5次出场仅累计398分钟。
加速、回追速度以及内外线都能推进的能力，使他成为葡萄牙最强的双向通道，但库库雷利亚完成了更全面的赛事表现。
ko: 멘데스는 우즈베키스탄전에서 득점하고 수비수 중 가장 많은 결정적 기회 4개를 만들었지만, 5경기 398분만 뛰었다.
가속과 복귀 속도, 안팎으로 전진하는 능력으로 포르투갈 최고의 공수 연결점이 됐으나 대회 전체의 완성도에서는 쿠쿠레야가 앞섰다.

reason.en: Nakamura was the attack-first option: a goal, an assist and direct carrying from the left made him especially useful when Japan needed to chase a game.
reason.es: Nakamura fue la opción más ofensiva: un gol, una asistencia y conducción directa por la izquierda lo hicieron especialmente útil cuando Japón debía buscar el partido.
reason.zh: 中村敬斗是偏进攻的选择：一球一助，加上左路直接带球推进，让他特别适合日本需要追分的比赛。
reason.ko: 나카무라는 공격적인 선택지였다. 1골 1도움과 왼쪽에서의 직선적인 전진은 일본이 득점이 필요할 때 특히 유용했다.

en: Rodri completed 811 passes, including 122 line-breaking passes and 76 line-breakers in the final third, while also winning 49 duels on his way to the Golden Ball.
He controlled where matches were played, accelerating Spain through pressure before slowing possession whenever the game required protection.
es: Rodri completó 811 pases, incluidos 122 que rompieron líneas y 76 pases de ese tipo en el último tercio, además de ganar 49 duelos camino al Balón de Oro.
Controló dónde se jugaban los partidos, acelerando a España bajo presión y pausando después la posesión cuando el encuentro necesitaba protección.
zh: 罗德里完成811次传球，其中122次穿透防线、76次发生在进攻三区；他还赢下49次对抗，并最终获得金球奖。
他决定比赛在哪些区域展开：在压力下为西班牙提速，又会在球队需要保护时放慢控球节奏。
ko: 로드리는 811개의 패스를 완성했고 그중 122개가 라인을 깼으며, 공격 3분의 1 지역에서만 76개의 라인 브레이킹 패스를 기록했다. 49번의 경합도 이기며 골든볼을 받았다.
압박 속에서는 스페인의 속도를 높이고 보호가 필요할 때는 점유를 늦추며 경기가 어느 지역에서 펼쳐질지를 통제했다.

en: Paredes played 472 minutes across seven appearances, acting as Argentina’s deepest midfield distributor even without a goal or assist.

His shoulder checks, vertical passing into Messi and aggressive control of transitions helped Argentina navigate several chaotic knockout matches, although his post-match red card in the final blemished the campaign.
es: Paredes jugó 472 minutos en siete partidos y actuó como el distribuidor más retrasado del mediocampo argentino aun sin marcar ni asistir.

Sus controles del entorno, pases verticales hacia Messi y dominio agresivo de las transiciones ayudaron a Argentina en varias eliminatorias caóticas, aunque la roja posterior al partido de la final manchó su torneo.
zh: 帕雷德斯7次出场共472分钟，即使没有进球或助攻，仍担任阿根廷中场最靠后的出球者。
接球前观察、向梅西送出纵向传球，以及强硬控制攻防转换，帮助阿根廷走过数场混乱的淘汰赛；不过决赛赛后的红牌为他的赛事留下瑕疵。
ko: 파레데스는 7경기 472분을 뛰며 골이나 도움 없이도 아르헨티나 중원 가장 깊은 곳의 배급을 맡았다.
주변을 확인하는 움직임과 메시를 향한 수직 패스, 전환을 적극적으로 통제하는 능력으로 혼란스러운 토너먼트 경기를 넘겼지만 결승 종료 뒤 받은 퇴장은 흠으로 남았다.

en: Xhaka played all 600 minutes of Switzerland’s run and scored in the 4–1 victory over Bosnia and Herzegovina.

Operating from the left side of midfield, he switched play early, resisted pressure and protected the space behind advancing teammates, providing the leadership and tactical stability behind a quarterfinal appearance.
es: Xhaka disputó los 600 minutos de Suiza y marcó en la victoria por 4–1 ante Bosnia y Herzegovina.

Desde el lado izquierdo del mediocampo, cambió el juego pronto, resistió la presión y protegió el espacio detrás de los compañeros que avanzaban, aportando el liderazgo y la estabilidad táctica de una clasificación a cuartos.
zh: 扎卡打满瑞士征程的600分钟，并在4比1战胜波黑时取得进球。
他从中场左侧提前转移、抵抗压力，并保护队友前插后的空间，以领导力和战术稳定性支撑球队闯入八强。
ko: 자카는 스위스의 600분을 모두 뛰었고 보스니아 헤르체고비나를 4-1로 이긴 경기에서 득점했다.
중원 왼쪽에서 빠르게 방향을 전환하고 압박을 견디며 전진한 동료 뒤를 보호해, 8강 진출의 리더십과 전술적 안정성을 제공했다.

en: Bellingham scored seven goals from only 3.06 expected goals, including knockout braces against Mexico and Norway, and won 50 duels.
His late box arrivals, carries through contact and ability to turn loose balls into immediate attacks gave England exceptional production from a central-midfield position.
es: Bellingham marcó siete goles con solo 3,06 goles esperados, incluidos dobletes en las eliminatorias ante México y Noruega, y ganó 50 duelos.

Sus llegadas tardías al área, conducciones resistiendo el contacto y capacidad para convertir balones sueltos en ataques inmediatos dieron a Inglaterra una producción excepcional desde el centro del campo.
zh: 贝林厄姆在仅3.06预期进球的情况下攻入7球，其中包括淘汰赛对墨西哥和挪威的两次梅开二度，并赢下50次对抗。
他后插上进入禁区、在身体接触中继续带球，并把二点球迅速转化为进攻，为英格兰带来中场位置上罕见的产量。
ko: 벨링엄은 기대 득점 3.06에서 7골을 넣었고 멕시코와 노르웨이를 상대한 토너먼트에서 각각 멀티골을 기록했으며, 경합 50번을 이겼다.
늦은 박스 침투, 접촉을 견디는 운반과 세컨드 볼을 즉시 공격으로 바꾸는 능력으로 중앙 미드필더 자리에서 잉글랜드에 특별한 생산성을 제공했다.

en: Olmo appeared in all eight matches, played 495 minutes and supplied two assists before producing an influential display in the final.
His movement between midfield and defence, one-touch combinations and immediate counterpressing made him Spain’s most useful advanced midfielder, even though he did not score.
es: Olmo participó en los ocho partidos, jugó 495 minutos, dio dos asistencias y después firmó una actuación influyente en la final.
Su movimiento entre el mediocampo y la defensa rival, combinaciones a un toque y contrapresión inmediata lo hicieron el mediapunta más útil de España, aunque no marcara.
zh: 奥尔莫出战全部8场、累计495分钟，送出2次助攻，并在决赛发挥重要作用。
他在中场与对方防线之间的移动、一脚配合和立即反抢，使他成为西班牙最有用的前腰型中场，尽管没有进球。
ko: 올모는 8경기에 모두 출전해 495분을 뛰고 2도움을 기록한 뒤 결승에서도 영향력 있는 활약을 펼쳤다.
중원과 상대 수비 사이의 움직임, 원터치 연계와 즉각적인 역압박으로 득점 없이도 스페인에서 가장 유용한 공격형 미드필더가 됐다.

reason.en: McKennie added vertical running and well-timed box arrivals, giving the United States a direct dimension their other midfielders could not match.
reason.es: McKennie aportó carreras verticales y llegadas bien medidas al área, dando a Estados Unidos una vía directa que sus otros centrocampistas no podían igualar.
reason.zh: 麦肯尼带来纵向跑动和恰到好处的禁区后插上，为美国队提供了其他中场难以复制的直接性。
reason.ko: 매케니는 직선적인 움직임과 정확한 타이밍의 박스 침투로 미국의 다른 미드필더들이 만들기 어려운 직접성을 더했다.

en: Enzo played 660 minutes and scored twice in the knockout stage, including the semifinal equaliser against England.
His sustained responsibility in Argentina’s buildup, progression and pressing gave him the edge over Fabián’s impactful but much smaller sample.
es: Enzo jugó 660 minutos y marcó dos veces en las eliminatorias, incluido el empate de la semifinal ante Inglaterra.
Su responsabilidad sostenida en la salida, progresión y presión argentinas le dio ventaja sobre el impacto de Fabián en una muestra mucho menor.
zh: 恩佐出场660分钟，并在淘汰赛打入2球，其中包括半决赛对英格兰的扳平球。
他持续承担阿根廷后场组织、向前推进和逼抢的责任，因此领先于表现亮眼但样本小得多的法比安。
ko: 엔소는 660분을 뛰며 잉글랜드와의 준결승 동점골을 포함해 토너먼트에서 2골을 넣었다.
아르헨티나의 후방 전개와 전진, 압박을 꾸준히 맡은 책임감으로 인상적이지만 표본이 훨씬 적은 파비안보다 앞섰다.

en: Fabián played 321 minutes, scored the opener against Belgium and then started Spain’s quarterfinal, semifinal and final.

His left foot, half-space awareness and disciplined support gave Spain a clean possession option in the hardest matches, but Enzo’s much larger workload and sustained responsibility put him narrowly ahead.
es: Fabián jugó 321 minutos, marcó el primer gol ante Bélgica y después fue titular en los cuartos, la semifinal y la final de España.

Su zurda, lectura de los medios espacios y apoyos disciplinados dieron a España una salida limpia en los partidos más difíciles, pero la carga mucho mayor y la responsabilidad sostenida de Enzo lo situaron ligeramente por delante.
zh: 法比安出场321分钟，对比利时打入首球，随后在西班牙的四分之一决赛、半决赛和决赛中均首发。
他的左脚、对肋部空间的理解和纪律严明的接应，让西班牙在最困难的比赛中拥有稳定的控球选择；但恩佐更大的比赛负荷和持续承担的责任使其略胜一筹。
ko: 파비안은 321분을 뛰며 벨기에전 선제골을 넣었고, 이후 스페인의 8강과 준결승, 결승에 선발 출전했다.
왼발, 하프스페이스 인식과 규율 있는 지원으로 가장 어려운 경기에서 스페인에 안정적인 점유 선택지를 제공했지만, 엔소의 훨씬 큰 출전 부담과 지속적인 책임이 근소한 우위를 만들었다.

reason.en: Vite was an understated two-way midfielder, combining useful chance creation with exceptional tackling and recovery work for Ecuador.
reason.es: Vite fue un centrocampista de ida y vuelta poco reconocido, combinando creación de ocasiones con un trabajo excepcional en entradas y recuperaciones para Ecuador.
reason.zh: 维特是一名低调而全面的双向中场，既能创造机会，也为厄瓜多尔贡献了出色的抢断与球权回收。
reason.ko: 비테는 주목은 덜 받았지만 기회 창출과 뛰어난 태클, 볼 회수 능력을 함께 보여준 에콰도르의 공수형 미드필더였다.

en: Messi finished with eight goals and four assists while creating a tournament-high 25 chances, at least seven more than anyone else.

He produced both late assists in the semifinal comeback against England and remained most dangerous drifting inside from the right before deciding attacks with disguised passes, crosses and short bursts.
es: Messi terminó con ocho goles y cuatro asistencias y creó 25 ocasiones, el máximo del torneo y al menos siete más que cualquier otro jugador.

Dio las dos asistencias tardías en la remontada de la semifinal ante Inglaterra y siguió siendo más peligroso al entrar desde la derecha antes de decidir ataques con pases disimulados, centros y aceleraciones cortas.
zh: 梅西以8球4助攻结束赛事，并创造赛事最高的25次机会，至少比其他任何球员多7次。
半决赛逆转英格兰时，他送出两次后段助攻；从右路内收后，他仍能以隐蔽传球、传中和短距离爆发决定进攻。
ko: 메시는 8골 4도움과 대회 최다인 25번의 기회 창출을 기록해 다른 누구보다 최소 7개가 많았다.
잉글랜드와의 준결승 역전에서 두 번의 막판 도움을 만들었고, 오른쪽에서 안으로 들어온 뒤 감춘 패스와 크로스, 짧은 가속으로 공격을 결정할 때 가장 위협적이었다.

en: Olise supplied seven assists in 650 minutes, breaking the recorded single-tournament World Cup record, and added two assists against England in the third-place match.
His disguised left-footed passing, half-space combinations and set-piece delivery made him the tournament’s leading specialist creator, but Messi offered more combined scoring and creation.
es: Olise dio siete asistencias en 650 minutos, superó el récord registrado en una sola Copa del Mundo y añadió dos ante Inglaterra en el partido por el tercer puesto.

Sus pases disimulados con la zurda, combinaciones en los medios espacios y golpeo a balón parado lo hicieron el principal creador especialista del torneo, pero Messi ofreció más entre goles y creación.
zh: 奥利塞在650分钟内送出7次助攻，打破有记录以来单届世界杯助攻纪录，并在季军赛对英格兰时贡献2次助攻。
隐蔽的左脚传球、肋部配合和定位球输送，使他成为本届赛事最出色的专项创造者；但梅西在得分与创造的综合贡献上更高。
ko: 올리세는 650분 동안 7도움을 기록해 집계된 단일 월드컵 기록을 경신했고, 잉글랜드와의 3위 결정전에서도 2도움을 추가했다.
감춘 왼발 패스와 하프스페이스 연계, 세트피스 배급으로 대회 최고의 전문 창조자가 됐지만 득점과 기회 창출의 합에서는 메시가 앞섰다.

en: Yamal played 616 minutes across all eight matches, scored against Saudi Arabia and completed the full 120 minutes of the final at only 19.
His isolation dribbling, changes of pace and ability to hold width stretched almost every opponent, although one goal and no assists left him below Messi and Olise on tournament production.
es: Yamal jugó 616 minutos en los ocho partidos, marcó ante Arabia Saudí y completó los 120 minutos de la final con solo 19 años.

Su regate en aislamiento, cambios de ritmo y capacidad para mantener la amplitud estiraron a casi todos los rivales, aunque un gol y ninguna asistencia lo dejaron por debajo de Messi y Olise en producción.
zh: 亚马尔8场比赛出场616分钟，对沙特阿拉伯进球，并在年仅19岁时打满决赛120分钟。
单挑盘带、节奏变化和保持宽度的能力几乎拉开了每个对手；但1球0助攻的产量仍低于梅西和奥利塞。
ko: 야말은 8경기 616분을 뛰고 사우디아라비아전에서 득점했으며, 19세의 나이로 결승 120분을 모두 소화했다.
고립 상황의 드리블과 속도 변화, 폭을 유지하는 능력으로 거의 모든 상대를 벌려 놓았지만 1골 무도움의 생산성은 메시와 올리세보다 낮았다.

en: Haaland scored seven times in only five appearances, averaging a tournament-best 1.35 goals per 90 minutes among players with at least 200 minutes.
His movement along the blind side of centre-backs, explosive attacks across the front defender and ruthless penalty-area finishing culminated in the late brace that eliminated Brazil.
es: Haaland marcó siete goles en solo cinco partidos y promedió 1,35 goles cada 90 minutos, la mejor cifra del torneo entre quienes jugaron al menos 200 minutos.
Sus movimientos a la espalda de los centrales, ataques explosivos por delante del defensor y definición implacable en el área culminaron en el doblete tardío que eliminó a Brasil.
zh: 哈兰德仅出战5场便攻入7球；在至少出场200分钟的球员中，他每90分钟1.35球的效率为赛事最高。
他沿中后卫盲侧的跑动、从防守者身前爆发抢点，以及禁区内冷酷的终结，最终在淘汰巴西时化为最后阶段的梅开二度。
ko: 홀란은 5경기에서 7골을 넣었고, 200분 이상 뛴 선수 중 대회 최고인 90분당 1.35골을 기록했다.
센터백의 시야 밖을 파고드는 움직임, 앞선 수비수를 가로지르는 폭발적인 침투와 페널티 지역의 냉정한 마무리는 브라질을 탈락시킨 막판 멀티골로 정점을 찍었다.

en: Oyarzabal finished with five goals and one assist in 607 minutes, including the semifinal penalty against France.
Beyond the scoring, his curved pressing runs, near-post movement and willingness to drop into midfield made him a dependable reference point throughout Spain’s championship run.
es: Oyarzabal terminó con cinco goles y una asistencia en 607 minutos, incluido el penalti de la semifinal ante Francia.
Más allá de los goles, sus carreras curvas de presión, movimientos al primer palo y disposición para bajar al mediocampo lo hicieron una referencia fiable durante el camino de España al título.
zh: 奥亚萨瓦尔在607分钟内攻入5球并送出1次助攻，其中包括半决赛对法国的点球。
除进球外，弧线逼抢、前点跑位和主动回撤中场，使他在西班牙夺冠征程中始终是可靠的进攻支点。
ko: 오야르사발은 607분 동안 5골 1도움을 기록했고, 프랑스와의 준결승 페널티킥 득점도 포함됐다.
득점뿐 아니라 곡선을 그리는 압박과 니어포스트 움직임, 중원으로 내려오는 성실함으로 스페인의 우승 여정 내내 믿을 수 있는 기준점이 됐다.

reason.en: Kane scored six goals and remained the strongest deep distributor among the leading centre-forwards, linking play as well as finishing it.
reason.es: Kane marcó seis goles y fue el mejor distribuidor desde zonas profundas entre los grandes delanteros, conectando el juego además de definirlo.
reason.zh: 凯恩打进六球，也是顶级中锋中最出色的回撤传球手，既能串联进攻，也能完成终结。
reason.ko: 케인은 6골을 넣었고 정상급 스트라이커 중 가장 뛰어난 후방 배급 능력으로 득점뿐 아니라 연계에도 기여했다.

en: Mbappé finished with ten goals, four assists and 18 chances created from open play, scoring from approximately 6.87 expected goals.
His speed, isolation dribbling and finishing made him the outstanding left-sided attacker; the unusually open third-place match increased his totals, but it did not create his case.
es: Mbappé terminó con diez goles, cuatro asistencias y 18 ocasiones creadas en juego abierto, marcando a partir de aproximadamente 6,87 goles esperados.

Su velocidad, regate en aislamiento y definición lo convirtieron en el atacante izquierdo más destacado; el inusualmente abierto partido por el tercer puesto elevó sus cifras, pero no creó su candidatura.
zh: 姆巴佩以10球4助攻结束赛事，并在运动战创造18次机会；他的进球来自约6.87的预期进球。
速度、单挑盘带和终结能力使他成为最出色的左路攻击手；异常开放的季军赛提高了数据，却并非他入选的根本理由。
ko: 음바페는 약 6.87의 기대 득점에서 10골을 넣고 4도움과 오픈 플레이 기회 창출 18회를 기록했다.
속도와 고립 상황의 드리블, 마무리로 최고의 왼쪽 공격수가 됐다. 이례적으로 열린 3위 결정전이 수치를 높였지만 그의 선정 근거를 만든 경기는 아니었다.

en: Dembélé produced six goals and two assists in 596 minutes, giving France another high-output attacker alongside Mbappé and Olise.

His two-footed dribbling and ability to attack either channel made opponents difficult to set against, but Spain neutralized him in the semifinal and Messi delivered the stronger overall right-sided tournament.
es: Dembélé produjo seis goles y dos asistencias en 596 minutos, dando a Francia otro atacante de alta producción junto a Mbappé y Olise.

Su regate con ambos pies y capacidad para atacar cualquiera de los dos canales dificultaron la defensa rival, pero España lo neutralizó en semifinales y Messi completó un torneo más fuerte desde la derecha.
zh: 登贝莱在596分钟内贡献6球2助攻，让法国在姆巴佩和奥利塞之外又拥有一名高产攻击手。
双足盘带和攻击两侧通道的能力让对手很难针对布置，但西班牙在半决赛限制了他，而梅西在右路完成了整体更强的赛事表现。
ko: 뎀벨레는 596분 동안 6골 2도움을 기록해 음바페와 올리세에 이어 프랑스에 또 하나의 높은 생산성을 지닌 공격 옵션을 제공했다.
양발 드리블과 어느 채널이든 공략하는 능력 때문에 상대가 대비하기 어려웠지만 스페인이 준결승에서 그를 봉쇄했고, 오른쪽 전체 활약에서는 메시가 더 강했다.

reason.en: Vinícius produced four goals, one assist and constant one-on-one threat. His quieter knockout stage keeps him behind Mbappé and Dembélé here.
reason.es: Vinícius aportó cuatro goles, una asistencia y una amenaza constante en el uno contra uno. Su fase eliminatoria más discreta lo deja detrás de Mbappé y Dembélé.
reason.zh: 维尼修斯贡献四球一助攻，并持续制造一对一威胁。但淘汰赛相对安静，让他在这里排在姆巴佩和登贝莱之后。
reason.ko: 비니시우스는 4골 1도움과 꾸준한 일대일 위협을 보여줬다. 다만 토너먼트 활약이 비교적 조용해 음바페와 뎀벨레 뒤에 놓였다.

Aaron Wan-Bissaka.name: Aaron Wan-Bissaka
Aaron Wan-Bissaka.summary: Aaron Wan-Bissaka (born 26 November 1997) is a professional footballer who plays as a right-back for EFL Championship club West Ham United. Born in England, he plays for the DR Congo national team.
Aaron Wan-Bissaka.note: Wan-Bissaka stands out for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him.
Aaron Wan-Bissaka.noteZh: 他的突出特点是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。他也会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。

Abbosbek Fayzullaev.name: Abbosbek Fayzullaev
Abbosbek Fayzullaev.summary: Abbosbek Sayidjon ugli Fayzullaev (Uzbek: Abbosbek Sayidjon oʻgʻli Fayzullayev; born 3 October 2003) is an Uzbek professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or winger for Süper Lig club İstanbul Başakşehir and the Uzbekistan national team.
Abbosbek Fayzullaev.note: Fayzullaev's edge is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him.
Abbosbek Fayzullaev.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。

Abdukodir Khusanov.name: Abdukodir Khusanov
Abdukodir Khusanov.summary: Abdukodir Khikmatzhon ugli Khusanov (Uzbek: Abduqodir Xikmatjon oʻgʻli Xusanov; born 29 February 2004) is an Uzbek professional footballer who plays as a centre-back and right-back for Premier League club Manchester City and the Uzbekistan national team.
Abdukodir Khusanov.note: Khusanov's signature is recovery speed when the defensive line is exposed. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Abdukodir Khusanov.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在防线暴露后的回追速度上。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Abduvohid Nematov.name: Abduvohid Nematov
Abduvohid Nematov.summary: Abduvohid Nematov (Uzbek: Abduvohid Neʼmatov, Абдувоҳид Неъматов; born 20 March 2001) is an Uzbek professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Nasaf and the Uzbekistan national team.
Abduvohid Nematov.note: Watch Nematov for organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Abduvohid Nematov.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在危险出现前组织好队友。留意他如何在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Achraf Hakimi.name: Achraf Hakimi
Achraf Hakimi.summary: Achraf Hakimi Mouh (Arabic: أشرف حكيمي موح, pronounced [ˈʔaʃraf ħaˈkiːmiː ˈmuːħ]; born 4 November 1998) is a professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Ligue 1 club Paris Saint-Germain and captains the Morocco national team.
Achraf Hakimi.note: Hakimi is defined by recovery speed when the defensive line is exposed. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Achraf Hakimi.noteZh: 他靠防线暴露后的回追速度与同位置球员拉开差异。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Adalberto Carrasquilla.name: Adalberto Carrasquilla
Adalberto Carrasquilla.summary: Adalberto Eliécer Carrasquilla Alcázar (born 28 November 1998), commonly known as Coco Carrasquilla is a Panamanian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Liga MX club Pumas UNAM and the Panama national team.
Adalberto Carrasquilla.note: Watch Carrasquilla for creating a better angle for the next pass. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him.
Adalberto Carrasquilla.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是为下一脚传球制造更好的角度。留意他如何第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。

Adam Hlozek.name: Adam Hlozek
Adam Hlozek.summary: Adam Hložek (born 25 July 2002) is a Czech professional footballer who plays as a forward for Bundesliga club TSG Hoffenheim and the Czech Republic national team.
Adam Hlozek.note: Hložek is defined by waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. He opens his body on the first touch so he can play forward. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him.
Adam Hlozek.noteZh: 他靠等防守者注意力转移后再启动与同位置球员拉开差异。他会第一脚触球时打开身体，准备向前处理。他也会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。

Agustin Canobbio.name: Agustin Canobbio
Agustin Canobbio.summary: Agustín Canobbio Graviz (born 1 October 1998) is a Uruguayan professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or winger for Campeonato Brasileiro Série A club Fluminense and the Uruguay national team.
Agustin Canobbio.note: Canobbio stands out for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Agustin Canobbio.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Akram Afif.name: Akram Afif
Akram Afif.summary: Akram Hassan Afif Yahya Afif (Arabic: أَكْرَم حَسَن عَفِيف يَحْيَى عَفِيف; born 18 November 1996) is a Qatari professional footballer who plays as a left winger for Qatar Stars League club Al Sadd and the Qatar national team.
Akram Afif.note: Watch Afif for seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Akram Afif.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。留意他如何主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Alex Freeman.name: Alex Freeman
Alex Freeman.summary: Alexander Michael Freeman (born August 9, 2004) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a right-back, right winger, or center back for La Liga club Villarreal and the United States national team.
Alex Freeman.note: Freeman's signature is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He turns early and closes the runner before the box.
Alex Freeman.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在防线重组前制造干净射门上。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。

Alexander Isak.name: Alexander Isak
Alexander Isak.summary: Alexander Isak (Swedish pronunciation: [alɛkˈsǎnːdɛr ˈîːsak]; born 21 September 1999) is a Swedish professional footballer who plays as a striker for Premier League club Liverpool and the Sweden national team.
Alexander Isak.note: Isak's edge is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Alexander Isak.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Ali Jasim.name: Ali Jasim
Ali Jasim.summary: Ali Jasim Elaibi Al-Tameemi (Arabic: علي جاسم لعيبي التميمي; born 20 January 2004) is an Iraqi professional footballer who plays as a forward for Saudi Pro League club Al-Najma, on loan from Serie A club Como, and the Iraq national team.
Ali Jasim.note: Jasim is defined by making purposeful movement away from the ball. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Ali Jasim.noteZh: 他靠用有目的的无球移动创造接应点与同位置球员拉开差异。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Ali Olwan.name: Ali Olwan
Ali Olwan.summary: Ali Iyad Ali Olwan (Arabic: علي إياد علي علوان; born 26 March 2000) is a Jordanian professional footballer who plays as a forward for Qatar Stars League club Al-Sailiya and the Jordan national team.
Ali Olwan.note: Watch Olwan for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Ali Olwan.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在防线重组前制造干净射门。留意他如何接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Alireza Jahanbakhsh.name: Alireza Jahanbakhsh
Alireza Jahanbakhsh.summary: Alireza Jahanbakhsh (Persian: علیرضا جهانبخش, romanized: Alirezâ Jahânbaxš, pronounced [æliːɾezɑː dʒæhɑːnˈbæxʃ]; born 11 August 1993) is an Iranian professional footballer who plays as a winger for Belgian Pro League club Dender and captains the Iran national...
Alireza Jahanbakhsh.note: Jahanbakhsh's edge is calm decisions shaped by experience in high-pressure moments. He varies the height and pace of his delivery. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Alireza Jahanbakhsh.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是高压时刻由经验带来的冷静判断。他会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Almoez Ali.name: Almoez Ali
Almoez Ali.summary: Almoez Ali Zainalabedeen Mohamed Abdulla (Arabic: الْمُعِزّ عَلِيّ زَيْن الْعَابِدِين مُحَمَّد عَبْدُ اللّٰه; born 19 August 1996) is a professional footballer who plays as a striker for Qatar Stars League club Al-Duhail, which he currently captains.
Almoez Ali.note: Ali's signature is making purposeful movement away from the ball. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Almoez Ali.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在用有目的的无球移动创造接应点上。他会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Alphonso Davies.name: Alphonso Davies
Alphonso Davies.summary: Alphonso Boyle Davies (born November 2, 2000) is a professional soccer player who plays as a left-back, winger, or wing-back for Bundesliga club Bayern Munich and captains the Canada national team.
Alphonso Davies.note: Watch Davies for recovery speed when the defensive line is exposed. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose.
Alphonso Davies.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是防线暴露后的回追速度。留意他如何主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。

Amad Diallo.name: Amad Diallo
Amad Diallo.summary: Amad Diallo (born 11 July 2002), sometimes known mononymously as Amad, is an Ivorian professional footballer who plays as a winger or attacking midfielder for Premier League club Manchester United and the Ivory Coast national team.
Amad Diallo.note: Diallo is defined by creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Amad Diallo.noteZh: 他靠在防线重组前制造干净射门与同位置球员拉开差异。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。

Amine Gouiri.name: Amine Gouiri
Amine Gouiri.summary: Amine Ferid Gouiri (Arabic: أمين فريد قويري; born 16 February 2000) is a professional footballer who plays as a striker or left winger for Ligue 1 club Marseille. Born in France, he plays for the Algeria national team.
Amine Gouiri.note: Gouiri's signature is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Amine Gouiri.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在防线重组前制造干净射门上。他会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。他也会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Andy Robertson.name: Andy Robertson
Andy Robertson.summary: Andrew Henry Robertson (born 11 March 1994) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Premier League club Liverpool and captains the Scotland national team.
Andy Robertson.note: Robertson's edge is organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Andy Robertson.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在危险出现前组织好队友。他会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Anthony Elanga.name: Anthony Elanga
Anthony Elanga.summary: Anthony David Junior Elanga (born 27 April 2002) is a Swedish professional footballer who plays as a forward or winger for Premier League club Newcastle United and the Sweden national team.
Anthony Elanga.note: Elanga stands out for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Anthony Elanga.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。他也会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。

Antoine Semenyo.name: Antoine Semenyo
Antoine Semenyo.summary: Antoine Selorm Semenyo (born 7 January 2000) is a professional footballer who plays as a winger or wide midfielder for Premier League club Manchester City. Born in England, he plays for the Ghana national team.
Antoine Semenyo.note: Semenyo's signature is using strength without slowing the next action. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Antoine Semenyo.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在对抗中用力量但不拖慢下一步上。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Antonio Nusa.name: Antonio Nusa
Antonio Nusa.summary: Antonio Eromonsele Nordby Nusa (born 17 April 2005) is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays as a winger or attacking midfielder for Bundesliga club RB Leipzig and the Norway national team.
Antonio Nusa.note: Watch Nusa for changing direction without losing control of the ball. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Antonio Nusa.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是变向时仍把球控制在脚下。留意他如何提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。他也会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Arda Guler.name: Arda Guler
Arda Guler.summary: Arda Güler (Turkish pronunciation: [aɾˈda ˈɟylæɾ] ; born 25 February 2005) is a Turkish professional footballer who primarily plays as an attacking midfielder for La Liga club Real Madrid and the Turkey national team.
Arda Guler.note: Güler is defined by creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Arda Guler.noteZh: 他靠在防线重组前制造干净射门与同位置球员拉开差异。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Ayase Ueda.name: Ayase Ueda
Ayase Ueda.summary: Ayase Ueda (上田 綺世, Ueda Ayase; born 28 August 1998) is a Japanese professional footballer who plays as a striker for Eredivisie club Feyenoord and the Japan national team.
Ayase Ueda.note: Ueda is defined by creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Ayase Ueda.noteZh: 他靠在防线重组前制造干净射门与同位置球员拉开差异。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Aymen Hussein.name: Aymen Hussein
Aymen Hussein.summary: Aymen Hussein Ghadhban Al-Mafraje (Arabic: أيمن حسين غضبان المفرجي; born 22 March 1996), nicknamed Abu Tubar (Arabic: أبو طبر, lit.
Aymen Hussein.note: Watch Hussein for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He pins a defender and creates room for the next runner. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Aymen Hussein.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在防线重组前制造干净射门。留意他如何牵制一名后卫，为后插上的队友腾出空间。他也会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Ayoub El Kaabi.name: Ayoub El Kaabi
Ayoub El Kaabi.summary: Ayoub El Kaabi (Arabic: أَيُّوب الْكَعْبِيّ, Berber languages: ⴰⵢⵓⴱ ⴻⵍ ⴽⴰⴰⴱⵉ; born 25 June 1993) is a Moroccan professional footballer who plays as a striker for Super League Greece club Olympiacos and the Morocco national team.
Ayoub El Kaabi.note: Kaabi is defined by waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He attacks the near-post lane before the marker can turn.
Ayoub El Kaabi.noteZh: 他靠等防守者注意力转移后再启动与同位置球员拉开差异。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会在盯防者转身前冲向近门柱线路。

Bradley Barcola.name: Bradley Barcola
Bradley Barcola.summary: Bradley Jean-Manuel Essolisam Addo Barcola (French pronunciation: [bʁɑdlɛ bɑʁkɔlɑ]; born 2 September 2002) is a French professional footballer who plays as a forward for Ligue 1 club Paris Saint-Germain and the France national team.
Bradley Barcola.note: Barcola stands out for explosive speed once open grass appears. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Bradley Barcola.noteZh: 他的突出特点是看到空当后的爆发速度。他会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Brahim Diaz.name: Brahim Diaz
Brahim Diaz.summary: Brahim Abdelkader Díaz (born 3 August 1999), also known mononymously as Brahim, is a professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or winger for La Liga club Real Madrid. Born in Spain, he plays for the Morocco national team.

Sarpreet Singh.note: Watch Singh for seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He varies the height and pace of his delivery. He opens his body on the first touch so he can play forward.

Scott McTominay.name: Scott McTominay
Scott McTominay.summary: Scott Francis McTominay (born 8 December 1996) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Serie A club Napoli. Born in England, he plays for the Scotland national team.
Scott McTominay.note: Watch McTominay for creating a better angle for the next pass. He absorbs contact and keeps the ball close enough to continue forward. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Scott McTominay.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是为下一脚传球制造更好的角度。留意他如何承受身体接触后仍把球留在可继续推进的位置。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Sead Kolasinac.name: Sead Kolasinac

Son Heung-min.name: Son Heung-min

Weston McKennie.name: Weston McKennie

Hassan Alhaydos.name: Hassan Alhaydos

Yassine Bounou.noteZh: 他的突出特点是提前站位后的快速反应。他会等到对方触球前再做扑救选择。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Amar Dedic.name: Amar Dedic
Amar Dedic.summary: Amar Dedić (pronounced [ǎmar dêːditɕ]; born 18 August 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Primeira Liga club Benfica. Born in Austria, he plays for the Bosnia and Herzegovina national team.
Amar Dedic.note: Dedić's edge is making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He turns early and closes the runner before the box. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Amar Dedic.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择。他会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。他也会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Amar Memic.name: Amar Memic
Amar Memic.summary: Amar Memić (pronounced [ǎmar měmitɕ]; born 20 January 2001) is a Bosnian professional footballer who plays as a winger for Czech First League club Viktoria Plzeň and the Bosnia and Herzegovina national team.
Amar Memic.note: Memić's signature is changing direction without losing control of the ball. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Amar Memic.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在变向时仍把球控制在脚下上。他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Amir Hadziahmetovic.name: Amir Hadziahmetovic
Amir Hadziahmetovic.summary: Amir Hadžiahmetović (pronounced [âːmir xadʒiaxmêːtoʋitɕ]; born 8 March 1997) is a professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Premier League club Hull City, on loan from Beşiktaş.
Amir Hadziahmetovic.note: Hadžiahmetović stands out for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Amir Hadziahmetovic.noteZh: 他的突出特点是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Arjan Malic.name: Arjan Malic
Arjan Malic.summary: Arjan Malić (pronounced [ǎrjan mâːlitɕ]; born 28 August 2005) is a professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Austrian Bundesliga club Sturm Graz. Born in Slovenia, he plays for the Bosnia and Herzegovina national team.
Arjan Malic.note: Malić stands out for reading the next phase before the space fully opens. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He checks the runner over his shoulder before the final pass arrives.
Arjan Malic.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在空当完全出现前读懂下一阶段。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会最后一传到来前回头确认跑动者的位置。

Armin Gigovic.name: Armin Gigovic
Armin Gigovic.summary: Armin Gigović (pronounced [ǎrmin ɡîːgoʋitɕ]; born 6 April 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Swiss Super League club Young Boys. Born in Sweden, he plays for the Bosnia and Herzegovina national team.
Armin Gigovic.note: Watch Gigović for creating a better angle for the next pass. He positions himself for the next touch before the first contest is over. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Armin Gigovic.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是为下一脚传球制造更好的角度。留意他如何第一次争抢还没结束，就先为下一脚触球站好位置。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Benjamin Tahirovic.name: Benjamin Tahirovic
Benjamin Tahirovic.summary: Benjamin Tahirović (pronounced [běɲamin tâːxiroʋitɕ]; born 3 March 2003) is a professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Danish Superliga club Brøndby. Born in Sweden, he plays for the Bosnia and Herzegovina national team.
Benjamin Tahirovic.note: Tahirović's signature is creating a better angle for the next pass. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Benjamin Tahirovic.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在为下一脚传球制造更好的角度上。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Dennis Hadzikadunic.name: Dennis Hadzikadunic
Dennis Hadzikadunic.summary: Dennis Hadžikadunić (pronounced [dêːnis xǎdʒikadunitɕ]; born 9 July 1998) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Serie B club Sampdoria, on loan from Rostov. Born in Sweden, he plays for the Bosnia and Herzegovina national team.
Dennis Hadzikadunic.note: Hadžikadunić's edge is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose.
Dennis Hadzikadunic.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。他会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。他也会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。

Dzenis Burnic.name: Dzenis Burnic
Dzenis Burnic.summary: Dženis Burnić (pronounced [dʒêːnis bǔrnitɕ]; born 22 May 1998) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for 2. Bundesliga club Karlsruher SC. Born in Germany, he plays for the Bosnia and Herzegovina national team.
Dzenis Burnic.note: Burnić stands out for choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Dzenis Burnic.noteZh: 他的突出特点是选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。他会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Ermedin Demirovic.name: Ermedin Demirovic
Ermedin Demirovic.summary: Ermedin Demirović (pronounced [ermědin děmiroʋitɕ]; born 25 March 1998) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for Bundesliga club VfB Stuttgart. Born in Germany, he plays for the Bosnia and Herzegovina national team.
Ermedin Demirovic.note: Demirović is defined by pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path. He attacks the near-post lane before the marker can turn.
Ermedin Demirovic.noteZh: 他靠带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑与同位置球员拉开差异。他会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。他也会在盯防者转身前冲向近门柱线路。

Haris Tabakovic.name: Haris Tabakovic
Haris Tabakovic.summary: Haris Tabaković (pronounced [xâːris tǎbakoʋitɕ]; born 20 June 1994) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for Bundesliga club Borussia Mönchengladbach, on loan from TSG Hoffenheim.
Haris Tabakovic.club: Borussia Mönchengladbach (on loan from TSG Hoffenheim)
Haris Tabakovic.note: Tabaković is defined by creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He adjusts his position early enough to make the difficult action look simple. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Haris Tabakovic.noteZh: 他靠在防线重组前制造干净射门与同位置球员拉开差异。他会提前调整位置，让困难处理看起来简单。他也会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。

Martin Zlomislic.name: Martin Zlomislic

Nikola Katic.name: Nikola Katic
Nikola Katic.summary: Nikola Katić (pronounced [nǐkola kâtitɕ]; born 10 October 1996) is a Bosnian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Bundesliga club Schalke 04 and the Bosnia and Herzegovina national team.
Nikola Katic.note: Katić stands out for reading the flight of the ball before the duel begins. He varies the height and pace of his delivery. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Nikola Katic.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在争顶前先判断球的飞行轨迹。他会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Samed Bazdar.summary: Samed Baždar (pronounced [sǎmed bǎʒdar]; born 31 January 2004) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for Spanish club Real Zaragoza. Born in Serbia, he plays for the Bosnia and Herzegovina national team.
Samed Bazdar.note: Watch Baždar for starting his run while defenders are still watching the ball. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Samed Bazdar.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在防守者仍盯着球时提前启动。留意他如何把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Danilo Santos.name: Danilo Santos

Ederson.name: Ederson
Ederson.summary: Ederson Santana de Moraes (born 17 August 1993), simply known as Ederson (Brazilian Portuguese: [ˈɛdɛʁsõ]), is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Süper Lig club Fenerbahçe and the Brazil national team.

Ederson.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在把一次扑救变成进攻第一传上。他会直塞球越过后防时及时出击。他也会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。

Endrick.name: Endrick
Endrick.summary: Endrick Felipe Moreira de Sousa Pessoa (born 21 July 2006), known as Endrick (Brazilian Portuguese: [ˈẽ(j̃)dɾik (i)]), is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a striker for Ligue 1 club Lyon, on loan from La Liga club Real Madrid, and the Brazil...

Fabinho.name: Fabinho
Fabinho.summary: Fábio Henrique Tavares (born 23 October 1993), known as Fabinho (Brazilian Portuguese: [faˈbĩɲu]), is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for and captains Saudi Pro League club Al-Ittihad and the Brazil national team.

Gabriel Magalhaes.name: Gabriel Magalhaes

Gabriel Martinelli.name: Gabriel Martinelli
Gabriel Martinelli.summary: Gabriel Teodoro Martinelli Silva (Brazilian Portuguese: [ga.bɾiˈɛw maʁ.tʃiˈnɛ.lɪ], born 18 June 2001) is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a forward or left winger for Premier League club Arsenal and the Brazil national team.

Igor Thiago.name: Igor Thiago
Igor Thiago.summary: Igor Thiago Nascimento Rodrigues (born 26 June 2001), known simply as Igor Thiago (Brazilian Portuguese pronunciation: [ˈiɡoʁ tʃiˈaɡu]), is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a striker for Premier League club Brentford and the Brazil national...

Luiz Henrique.name: Luiz Henrique
Luiz Henrique.summary: Luiz Henrique André Rosa da Silva (born 2 January 2001), commonly known as Luiz Henrique (Brazilian Portuguese pronunciation: [luˈiz͜ ẽj̃ˈʁi.ki]), is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a right winger for Russian Premier League club Zenit Saint...

Raphinha.summary: Raphael Dias Belloli (Portuguese pronunciation: [ʁɐˈfiɲɐ]; born 14 December 1996), known mononymously as Raphinha, is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a winger or forward for La Liga club Barcelona and the Brazil national team.

Rayan.name: Rayan
Rayan.summary: Rayan Vitor Simplício Rocha (born 3 August 2006), known simply as Rayan (Brazilian Portuguese pronunciation: [ʁaˈjɐ̃]), is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a right winger or forward for Premier League club Bournemouth and the Brazil national...

Gessime Yassine.name: Gessime Yassine

Marwane Saadane.name: Marwane Saadane
Marwane Saadane.summary: Marwane Saâdane (Arabic: مروان سعدان; born 17 January 1992) is a Moroccan professional football player who plays for Saudi Professional League club Al-Fateh and the Morocco national team.

Noussair Mazraoui.name: Noussair Mazraoui
Noussair Mazraoui.summary: Noussair Mazraoui (Arabic: نُصَيْر مَزرَاوِيّ; born 14 November 1997) is a professional footballer who plays as a defender for Premier League club Manchester United and the Morocco national team.

Redouane Halhal.name: Redouane Halhal
Redouane Halhal.summary: Redouane Halhal (Arabic: رضوان حلحل; born 5 March 2003) is a footballer who plays as a defender for Belgian club Mechelen. Born in France, he represents the Morocco national team.

Youssef Belammari.name: Youssef Belammari
Youssef Belammari.summary: Youssef Belammari (Arabic: يُوسُف بَلْعُمَرِيّ; born 20 September 1998) is a Moroccan professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Egyptian Premier League club Al Ahly and the Morocco national team.

Bilal El Khannouss.name: Bilal El Khannouss
Bilal El Khannouss.summary: Bilal El Khannouss (Arabic: بلال الخنوس; born 10 May 2004) is a professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Bundesliga club VfB Stuttgart and the Morocco national team.
Bilal El Khannouss.note: Khannouss is defined by receiving in tight spaces with his next action already planned. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Bilal El Khannouss.noteZh: 他靠在狭小空间接球前就想好下一步与同位置球员拉开差异。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Munir El Kajoui.name: Munir El Kajoui
Munir El Kajoui.summary: Munir El Kajoui (Arabic: منير الكجوي; born 10 May 1989), known as Munir, is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Botola Pro club RS Berkane, whom he captains, and the Morocco national team.

Lukas Provod.note: Provod stands out for delivering the ball without needing much space. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Lukas Provod.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在很小空间里也能送出传中的能力。他会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。他也会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Matej Kovar.name: Matej Kovar
Matej Kovar.summary: Matěj Kovář (born 17 May 2000) is a Czech professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Eredivisie club PSV and the Czech Republic national team. Kovář joined the Manchester United youth system in 2018, from Czech club 1. FC Slovácko.
Matej Kovar.note: Kovář stands out for starting high enough to protect the space behind his defense. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step.
Matej Kovar.noteZh: 他的突出特点是用靠前站位保护后防身后空间。他会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。他也会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。

Mojmir Chytil.name: Mojmir Chytil
Mojmir Chytil.summary: Mojmír Chytil (born 29 April 1999) is a Czech professional footballer who plays as a forward for Slavia Prague and the Czech Republic national team.
Mojmir Chytil.note: Watch Chytil for giving centre-backs a physical problem they cannot ignore. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Mojmir Chytil.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是让中后卫无法忽视的身体支点作用。留意他如何主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Pavel Sulc.name: Pavel Sulc
Pavel Sulc.summary: Pavel Šulc (born 29 December 2000) is a Czech professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Ligue 1 club Lyon and the Czech Republic national team.
Pavel Sulc.note: Šulc's edge is creating a better angle for the next pass. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Pavel Sulc.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是为下一脚传球制造更好的角度。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Robin Hranac.name: Robin Hranac
Robin Hranac.summary: Robin Hranáč (Czech pronunciation: [ˈɦranaːt͡ʃ], born 29 January 2000) is a Czech professional footballer who plays as a defender for Bundesliga club TSG Hoffenheim and the Czech Republic national team.
Robin Hranac.note: Hranáč's signature is recovering position without panicking after the first line is broken. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Robin Hranac.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在第一道防线被突破后仍能冷静回位上。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Stepan Chaloupek.name: Stepan Chaloupek
Stepan Chaloupek.summary: Štěpán Chaloupek (born 8 March 2003) is a Czech professional footballer who plays as a defender for Slavia Prague and the Czech Republic national team.
Stepan Chaloupek.note: Chaloupek's edge is the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Stepan Chaloupek.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Tomas Chory.name: Tomas Chory
Tomas Chory.summary: Tomáš Chorý (born 26 January 1995) is a Czech professional footballer who plays as a forward for Slavia Prague and the Czech Republic national team.
Tomas Chory.note: Chorý is defined by giving centre-backs a physical problem they cannot ignore. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Tomas Chory.noteZh: 他靠让中后卫无法忽视的身体支点作用与同位置球员拉开差异。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。

Tomas Holes.name: Tomas Holes
Tomas Holes.summary: Tomáš Holeš (born 31 March 1993) is a Czech professional footballer who plays as a centre-back, right-back or defensive midfielder for Fortuna Liga club Slavia Prague and the Czech national team.
Tomas Holes.note: Holeš is defined by the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He varies the height and pace of his delivery. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose.
Tomas Holes.noteZh: 他靠在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构与同位置球员拉开差异。他会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。他也会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。

Vladimir Coufal.name: Vladimir Coufal
Vladimir Coufal.summary: Vladimír Coufal (Czech pronunciation: [ˈvlaɟɪmiːr ˈtsoufal]; born 22 August 1992) is a Czech professional footballer who plays as a right-back for German Bundesliga club TSG Hoffenheim and the Czech Republic national team.
Vladimir Coufal.note: Coufal stands out for seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Vladimir Coufal.noteZh: 他的突出特点是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Vladimir Darida.name: Vladimir Darida
Vladimir Darida.summary: Vladimír Darida (Czech pronunciation: [ˈvlaɟɪmiːr ˈdarɪda]; born 8 August 1990) is a Czech professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Czech First League club Hradec Králové and for the Czech Republic national team.
Vladimir Darida.note: Darida is defined by calm decisions shaped by experience in high-pressure moments. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Vladimir Darida.noteZh: 他靠高压时刻由经验带来的冷静判断与同位置球员拉开差异。他会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Alexis Vega.name: Alexis Vega

Alvaro Fidalgo.name: Alvaro Fidalgo

Brian Gutierrez.name: Brian Gutierrez

Carlos Acevedo.name: Carlos Acevedo

Cesar Huerta.name: Cesar Huerta

Cesar Montes.name: Cesar Montes
Cesar Montes.summary: César Jasib Montes Castro (born 24 February 1997) is a Mexican professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Russian Premier League club Lokomotiv Moscow and the Mexico national team.

Erik Lira.name: Erik Lira

Guillermo Ochoa.name: Guillermo Ochoa
Guillermo Ochoa.summary: Francisco Guillermo Ochoa Magaña (Spanish pronunciation: [ɡiˈʝeɾmo oˈtʃo.a]; born 13 July 1985), commonly known as Memo Ochoa, is a Mexican professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for the Mexico national team, best known for his performances in...

Jesus Gallardo.note: Gallardo stands out for making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. He recognizes when to slow the play and when to take the risk.
Jesus Gallardo.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择。他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。他也会判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。

Johan Vasquez.name: Johan Vasquez
Johan Vasquez.summary: Johan Vásquez is a Mexico centre-back from Genoa who gives the national team left-footed defending, aerial power, and Serie A-tested duels.

Roberto Alvarado.name: Roberto Alvarado
Roberto Alvarado.summary: Roberto Carlos “Piojo” Alvarado Hernández (Spanish pronunciation: [ɾɾoβˈeɾto kˈaɾlos ˌalβaɾˈaðo eɾnˈandeθ]; born 7 September 1998) is a Mexican professional footballer who plays as a winger for Liga MX club Guadalajara and the Mexico national team.

Paik Seung-ho.name: Paik Seung-ho
Paik Seung-ho.summary: Paik Seung-ho is a South Korea central midfielder from Birmingham City who adds deep passing, tempo control, and ball-winning balance.
Paik Seung-ho.note: Seung-ho's edge is moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Paik Seung-ho.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是用传球的力度和角度移动防线。他会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Park Jin-seob.name: Park Jin-seob
Park Jin-seob.summary: Park Jin-seob is a South Korea defensive midfielder from Zhejiang FC who adds screening, centre-back cover, and aerial bite.

Park Jin-seob.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Seol Young-woo.name: Seol Young-woo
Seol Young-woo.summary: Seol Young-woo is a South Korea right-back from Red Star Belgrade who adds two-sided full-back cover, recovery speed, and attacking support.
Seol Young-woo.note: Watch Young-woo for the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He turns early and closes the runner before the box. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose.
Seol Young-woo.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。留意他如何提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。他也会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。

Song Bum-keun.name: Song Bum-keun
Song Bum-keun.summary: Song Bum-keun is a South Korea goalkeeper from Jeonbuk Hyundai Motors who adds shot-stopping depth, size, and domestic rhythm.
Song Bum-keun.note: Bum-keun's edge is sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He keeps his feet active and makes the save with the fewest movements. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Song Bum-keun.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是提前站位后的快速反应。他会保持脚下轻快，用最少动作完成扑救。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Angelo Preciado.name: Angelo Preciado

Bazoumana Toure.noteZh: 他的突出特点是带球穿过开放中场的推进力。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Christ Inao Oulai.name: Christ Inao Oulai

Christopher Operi.name: Christopher Operi
Christopher Operi.summary: Christopher Téa Opéri (born 29 April 1997) is an Ivorian professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Süper Lig club İstanbul Başakşehir and the Ivory Coast national team.
Christopher Operi.note: Opéri's signature is delivering the ball without needing much space. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Christopher Operi.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在很小空间里也能送出传中的能力上。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Elye Wahi.name: Elye Wahi
Elye Wahi.summary: Sepe Elye Delmas Wahi (born 2 January 2003) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for Ligue 1 club Nice, on loan from Bundesliga club Eintracht Frankfurt. Born in France, he plays for the Ivory Coast national team.

Elye Wahi.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在防守者仍盯着球时提前启动。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Emmanuel Agbadou.name: Emmanuel Agbadou
Emmanuel Agbadou.summary: Badobre Emmanuel Elysee Djedje Agbadou (born 17 June 1997) is an Ivorian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Süper Lig club Beşiktaş and the Ivory Coast national team.

Mohamed Kone.name: Mohamed Kone

Tsuyoshi Watanabe.summary: Tsuyoshi Watanabe (渡辺 剛, Watanabe Tsuyoshi; born 5 February 1997) is a Japanese football player who plays as a defender for Eredivisie club Feyenoord and the Japan national team.

Tsuyoshi Watanabe.noteZh: 他靠选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢与同位置球员拉开差异。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Yuito Suzuki.name: Yuito Suzuki
Yuito Suzuki.summary: Yuito Suzuki (鈴木 唯人, Suzuki Yuito; born 25 October 2001) is a Japanese professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or a winger for German Bundesliga club SC Freiburg and the Japan national team.
Yuito Suzuki.note: Suzuki's signature is creating a better angle for the next pass. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path. He opens his body on the first touch so he can play forward.
Yuito Suzuki.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在为下一脚传球制造更好的角度上。他会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。他也会第一脚触球时打开身体，准备向前处理。

Yukinari Sugawara.name: Yukinari Sugawara
Yukinari Sugawara.summary: Yukinari Sugawara (菅原 由勢, Sugawara Yukinari; born 28 June 2000) is a Japanese professional footballer who plays as a right-back for EFL Championship club Southampton and the Japan national team. Sugawara began his senior career at Nagoya Grampus.

Yukinari Sugawara.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在很小空间里也能送出传中的能力。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Yuto Nagatomo.name: Yuto Nagatomo
Yuto Nagatomo.summary: Yūto Nagatomo (長友 佑都, Nagatomo Yūto; born 12 September 1986) is a Japanese professional footballer who plays as a full back for J1 League club FC Tokyo and the Japan national team.
Yuto Nagatomo.note: Watch Nagatomo for calm decisions shaped by experience in high-pressure moments. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Yuto Nagatomo.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是高压时刻由经验带来的冷静判断。留意他如何用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Zion Suzuki.name: Zion Suzuki
Zion Suzuki.summary: Zion Suzuki (鈴木 彩艶, Suzuki Zaion; born 21 August 2002) is a Japanese professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Serie A club Parma. Born in the United States, he represents the Japan national team.
Zion Suzuki.note: Suzuki's edge is staying balanced until the shot reveals its direction. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Zion Suzuki.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在射门方向明确前保持身体平衡。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Alexander Bernhardsson.name: Alexander Bernhardsson
Alexander Bernhardsson.summary: Alexander Olof Bernhardsson (born 8 September 1998) is a Swedish professional footballer who plays as a forward for 2. Bundesliga club Holstein Kiel and the Sweden national team.
Alexander Bernhardsson.note: Bernhardsson's edge is making purposeful movement away from the ball. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Alexander Bernhardsson.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是用有目的的无球移动创造接应点。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Benjamin Nygren.name: Benjamin Nygren
Benjamin Nygren.summary: Erik Benjamin Nygren (born 8 July 2001) is a Swedish professional footballer who plays as a winger or attacking midfielder for Scottish Premiership club Celtic and the Sweden national team.
Benjamin Nygren.note: Nygren's signature is making purposeful movement away from the ball. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Benjamin Nygren.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在用有目的的无球移动创造接应点上。他会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。他也会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Besfort Zeneli.name: Besfort Zeneli
Besfort Zeneli.summary: Besfort Zeneli (born 21 November 2002) is a Swedish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Belgian Pro League club Union Saint-Gilloise and the Sweden national team.
Besfort Zeneli.note: Zeneli's edge is creating a better angle for the next pass. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Besfort Zeneli.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是为下一脚传球制造更好的角度。他会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Carl Starfelt.name: Carl Starfelt
Carl Starfelt.summary: Carl Anders Theodor Starfelt (born 1 June 1995) is a Swedish professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for La Liga club Celta de Vigo and the Sweden national team.
Carl Starfelt.note: Starfelt's signature is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He recognizes when to slow the play and when to take the risk.
Carl Starfelt.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢上。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。

Daniel Svensson.name: Daniel Svensson
Daniel Svensson.summary: Daniel Jonathan Svensson (born 12 February 2002) is a Swedish professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder or left-back for Bundesliga club Borussia Dortmund and the Sweden national team.
