Ismael Gharbi.name: Ismael Gharbi
Ismael Gharbi.summary: Ismaël Seifallah Gharbi (Tunisian Arabic: إسماعيل سيفالله غربي; born 10 April 2004) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Bundesliga club FC Augsburg, on loan from Primeira Liga club Braga.
Ismael Gharbi.note: Gharbi stands out for creating a better angle for the next pass. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Ismael Gharbi.noteZh: 他的突出特点是为下一脚传球制造更好的角度。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Khalil Ayari.name: Khalil Ayari
Khalil Ayari.summary: Khalil Ayari (Arabic: خليل العياري; born 2 February 2005) is a Tunisian professional footballer who plays as a winger for Ligue 1 club Paris Saint-Germain, on loan from Tunisian Ligue Professionnelle 1 club Stade Tunisien, and the Tunisia national team.
Khalil Ayari.club: Paris Saint-Germain (on loan from Stade Tunisien)
Khalil Ayari.note: Ayari's edge is explosive speed once open grass appears. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He changes position while keeping his priorities simple.
Khalil Ayari.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是看到空当后的爆发速度。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。

Mohamed Hadj Mahmoud.name: Mohamed Hadj Mahmoud
Mohamed Hadj Mahmoud.summary: Mohamed Belhadj Mahmoud (Arabic: مُحَمَّد بَلْحَاجّ مَحْمُود; born 24 April 2000) is a Tunisian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Swiss Super League club Lugano and the Tunisia national team.
Mohamed Hadj Mahmoud.note: Mahmoud's edge is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Mohamed Hadj Mahmoud.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Montassar Talbi.name: Montassar Talbi
Montassar Talbi.summary: Montassar Omar Talbi (Arabic: مُنْتَصِر عُمَر الطَّالِبِيّ; born 26 May 1998) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Ligue 1 club Lorient. Born in France, he plays for the Tunisia national team.
Montassar Talbi.note: Talbi is defined by organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Montassar Talbi.noteZh: 他靠在危险出现前组织好队友与同位置球员拉开差异。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Mortadha Ben Ouanes.name: Mortadha Ben Ouanes
Mortadha Ben Ouanes.summary: Ahmed Mortadha Ouanes (Arabic: مرتضى بن وناس; born 2 July 1994) is a Tunisian professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Süper Lig club Kasımpaşa and the Tunisia national team.
Mortadha Ben Ouanes.note: Watch Ouanes for making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Mortadha Ben Ouanes.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择。留意他如何传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Mouhib Chamakh.name: Mouhib Chamakh
Mouhib Chamakh.summary: Abdelmouhib Chamakh is a Tunisia goalkeeper at Club Africain who gives the national team shot-stopping depth, height, and domestic title-winning rhythm.
Mouhib Chamakh.note: Watch Chamakh for staying balanced until the shot reveals its direction. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Mouhib Chamakh.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在射门方向明确前保持身体平衡。留意他如何在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Moutaz Neffati.name: Moutaz Neffati
Moutaz Neffati.summary: Moutaz Neffati (Arabic: معتز نفّاتي; born 4 September 2004) is a professional footballer who plays as a right-back for the Superettan club IFK Norrköping. Born in Sweden, he plays for the Tunisia national team.
Moutaz Neffati.note: Neffati stands out for recovery speed when the defensive line is exposed. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Moutaz Neffati.noteZh: 他的突出特点是防线暴露后的回追速度。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Raed Chikhaoui.name: Raed Chikhaoui
Raed Chikhaoui.summary: Raed Chikhaoui is a Tunisia centre-back at US Monastir who gives the national team size, aerial defending, and fresh back-line depth.
Raed Chikhaoui.note: Chikhaoui's signature is making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He changes position while keeping his priorities simple.
Raed Chikhaoui.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择上。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。

Rani Khedira.name: Rani Khedira
Rani Khedira.summary: Rani Khedira (Arabic: راني خضيرة; born 27 January 1994) is a professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Bundesliga club Union Berlin. Born in Germany, he plays for the Tunisia national team.
Rani Khedira.note: Khedira stands out for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Rani Khedira.noteZh: 他的突出特点是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Rayan Elloumi.name: Rayan Elloumi
Rayan Elloumi.summary: Rayan Elloumi (Arabic: ريان اللومي; born 17 September 2007) is a footballer who plays for Vancouver Whitecaps FC in Major League Soccer. Born in Canada, he represents the Tunisia national team.
Rayan Elloumi.note: Elloumi is defined by waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Rayan Elloumi.noteZh: 他靠等防守者注意力转移后再启动与同位置球员拉开差异。他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Sabri Ben Hessen.name: Sabri Ben Hessen
Sabri Ben Hessen.summary: Sabri Ben Hessen (Arabic: صبري بن حسن; born 13 June 1996) is a Tunisian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Tunisian Ligue Professionnelle 1 club ES Sahel, and the Tunisia national team.
Sabri Ben Hessen.note: Hessen is defined by protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He recognizes when to slow the play and when to take the risk.
Sabri Ben Hessen.noteZh: 他靠先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢与同位置球员拉开差异。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。

Sebastian Tounekti.name: Sebastian Tounekti
Sebastian Tounekti.summary: Sebastian Tounekti (born 13 July 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a winger for Scottish Premiership club Celtic. Born in Norway, he plays for the Tunisia national team.
Sebastian Tounekti.note: Tounekti's signature is the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Sebastian Tounekti.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构上。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Yan Valery.name: Yan Valery
Yan Valery.summary: Yan Valery (Arabic: يان فاليري; born 22 February 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as a right-back for EFL League One club Sheffield Wednesday. Born in France, he plays for the Tunisia national team.
Yan Valery.note: Watch Valery for using strength without slowing the next action. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Yan Valery.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在对抗中用力量但不拖慢下一步。留意他如何提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Bart Verbruggen.name: Bart Verbruggen
Bart Verbruggen.summary: Bart Verbruggen (born 18 August 2002) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Premier League club Brighton & Hove Albion and the Netherlands national team.
Bart Verbruggen.note: Verbruggen's signature is staying balanced until the shot reveals its direction. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step.
Bart Verbruggen.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在射门方向明确前保持身体平衡上。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。

Denzel Dumfries.name: Denzel Dumfries
Denzel Dumfries.summary: Denzel Justus Morris Dumfries (born 18 April 1996) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a right-back or right wing-back for Serie A club Inter Milan and the Netherlands national team.
Denzel Dumfries.note: Dumfries is defined by seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He absorbs contact and keeps the ball close enough to continue forward. He checks the runner over his shoulder before the final pass arrives.
Denzel Dumfries.noteZh: 他靠比防线早一步看到决定性的传球与同位置球员拉开差异。他会承受身体接触后仍把球留在可继续推进的位置。他也会最后一传到来前回头确认跑动者的位置。

Donyell Malen.name: Donyell Malen
Donyell Malen.summary: Donyell Malen (born 19 January 1999) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a winger or striker for Serie A club Roma and the Netherlands national team.
Donyell Malen.note: Malen's edge is explosive speed once open grass appears. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Donyell Malen.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是看到空当后的爆发速度。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。

Guus Til.name: Guus Til
Guus Til.summary: Guus Berend Til (born 22 December 1997) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Eredivisie club PSV and the Netherlands national team.
Guus Til.note: Til stands out for creating a better angle for the next pass. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Guus Til.noteZh: 他的突出特点是为下一脚传球制造更好的角度。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Jan Paul van Hecke.name: Jan Paul van Hecke
Jan Paul van Hecke.summary: Jan Paul van Hecke (born 8 June 2000) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Premier League club Tottenham Hotspur and the Netherlands national team.
Jan Paul van Hecke.note: Hecke stands out for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Jan Paul van Hecke.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Jorrel Hato.name: Jorrel Hato
Jorrel Hato.summary: Jorrel Evan Hato (born 7 March 2006) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or left-back for Premier League club Chelsea and the Netherlands national team.
Jorrel Hato.note: Hato's signature is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Jorrel Hato.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢上。他会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Justin Kluivert.name: Justin Kluivert
Justin Kluivert.summary: Justin Dean Kluivert (born 5 May 1999) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or winger for Premier League club Bournemouth and the Netherlands national team.
Justin Kluivert.note: Kluivert stands out for carrying momentum through open midfield. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Justin Kluivert.noteZh: 他的突出特点是带球穿过开放中场的推进力。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Lutsharel Geertruida.name: Lutsharel Geertruida
Lutsharel Geertruida.summary: Lutsharel Emiliano Geertruida (Dutch pronunciation: [xeːrtrœyda]; born 18 July 2000) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays for Premier League club Sunderland, on loan from Bundesliga club RB Leipzig, and the Netherlands national team.
Lutsharel Geertruida.note: Geertruida's edge is the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Lutsharel Geertruida.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。他会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Mark Flekken.name: Mark Flekken
Mark Flekken.summary: Mark Maria Hubertus Flekken (born 13 June 1993) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Bundesliga club Bayer Leverkusen and the Netherlands national team.
Mark Flekken.note: Flekken is defined by turning a save into the first pass of an attack. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Mark Flekken.noteZh: 他靠把一次扑救变成进攻第一传与同位置球员拉开差异。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Marten de Roon.name: Marten de Roon
Marten de Roon.summary: Marten Elco de Roon (born 29 March 1991) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Serie A club Atalanta and the Netherlands national team.
Marten de Roon.note: Roon's edge is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He adjusts his position early enough to make the difficult action look simple. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Marten de Roon.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会提前调整位置，让困难处理看起来简单。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Mats Wieffer.name: Mats Wieffer
Mats Wieffer.summary: Mats Henrik Berne Wieffer (born 16 November 1999) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a right-back or defensive midfielder for Premier League club Brighton & Hove Albion and the Netherlands national team.
Mats Wieffer.note: Wieffer's edge is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose.
Mats Wieffer.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。

Memphis Depay.name: Memphis Depay
Memphis Depay.summary: Memphis Depay (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈmɛɱfɪz dəˈpɑi]; born 13 February 1994), commonly known simply as Memphis, is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a forward for Corinthians in the Campeonato Brasileiro Série A and the Netherlands national team.
Memphis Depay.note: Depay is defined by seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Memphis Depay.noteZh: 他靠比防线早一步看到决定性的传球与同位置球员拉开差异。他会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Micky van de Ven.name: Micky van de Ven
Micky van de Ven.summary: Micky van de Ven (Dutch: [ˈmɪki vɑn də ˈvɛn]; born 19 April 2001) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays either as a centre-back or left-back for Premier League club Tottenham Hotspur and the Netherlands national team.
Micky van de Ven.note: Ven stands out for recovery speed when the defensive line is exposed. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Micky van de Ven.noteZh: 他的突出特点是防线暴露后的回追速度。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Nathan Ake.name: Nathan Ake
Nathan Ake.summary: Nathan Benjamin Aké (Dutch: ['naːtɑn 'aːkeː]; born 18 February 1995) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or left-back for Premier League club Manchester City and the Netherlands national team.
Nathan Ake.note: Aké's signature is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Nathan Ake.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢上。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Noa Lang.name: Noa Lang
Noa Lang.summary: Noa Noëll Lang (born 17 June 1999) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a left winger or left midfielder for Süper Lig club Galatasaray, on loan from Serie A club Napoli, and the Netherlands national team.
Noa Lang.note: Lang's signature is changing direction without losing control of the ball. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Noa Lang.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在变向时仍把球控制在脚下上。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Quinten Timber.name: Quinten Timber
Quinten Timber.summary: Quinten Ryan Crispito Timber (Dutch: [ˈkʋɪntə(n) ˈtɪmbər]; born 17 June 2001) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as midfielder for Ligue 1 club Marseille and the Netherlands national team.
Quinten Timber.note: Timber's edge is changing direction without losing control of the ball. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him.
Quinten Timber.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是变向时仍把球控制在脚下。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。

Robin Roefs.name: Robin Roefs
Robin Roefs.summary: Robin Gerardus Petrus Roefs (born 17 January 2003) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Premier League club Sunderland and the Netherlands national team.
Robin Roefs.note: Watch Roefs for the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He keeps his feet active and makes the save with the fewest movements.
Robin Roefs.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。留意他如何在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会保持脚下轻快，用最少动作完成扑救。

Ryan Gravenberch.name: Ryan Gravenberch
Ryan Gravenberch.summary: Ryan Jiro Gravenberch (Dutch pronunciation: [Ryɑn ɣrɑvɛnbɛrx]; born 16 May 2002) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Premier League club Liverpool and the Netherlands national team.
Ryan Gravenberch.note: Watch Gravenberch for seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Ryan Gravenberch.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。留意他如何出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Teun Koopmeiners.name: Teun Koopmeiners
Teun Koopmeiners.summary: Teun Koopmeiners (Dutch pronunciation: [tøːŋ ˈkoːpmɛinərs]; born 28 February 1998) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Serie A club Juventus and the Netherlands national team.
Teun Koopmeiners.note: Koopmeiners's signature is moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He varies the height and pace of his delivery. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Teun Koopmeiners.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在用传球的力度和角度移动防线上。他会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Tijjani Reijnders.name: Tijjani Reijnders
Tijjani Reijnders.summary: Tijjani Martinus Jan Reijnders (Dutch pronunciation: [tiˈdʒaːni ˈrɛi̯ndərs]; born 29 July 1998) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Premier League club Manchester City and the Netherlands national team.
Tijjani Reijnders.note: Reijnders stands out for seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Tijjani Reijnders.noteZh: 他的突出特点是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。他会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Wout Weghorst.name: Wout Weghorst
Wout Weghorst.summary: Wout François Maria Weghorst (born 7 August 1992) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a striker for Eredivisie club Ajax and the Netherlands national team. Weghorst began his professional career in the second tier of Dutch football with Emmen.
Wout Weghorst.note: Weghorst is defined by making purposeful movement away from the ball. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Wout Weghorst.noteZh: 他靠用有目的的无球移动创造接应点与同位置球员拉开差异。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Abdulkerim Bardakci.name: Abdulkerim Bardakci
Abdulkerim Bardakci.summary: Abdülkerim Bardakcı (born 7 September 1994) is a Turkish professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Süper Lig club Galatasaray and the Turkey national team.
Abdulkerim Bardakci.note: Watch Bardakcı for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Abdulkerim Bardakci.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。留意他如何主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Altay Bayindir.name: Altay Bayindir
Altay Bayindir.summary: Altay Bayındır (born 14 April 1998) is a Turkish professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Premier League club Manchester United and the Turkey national team. Bayındır began his career at Ankaragücü.
Altay Bayindir.note: Bayındır stands out for sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Altay Bayindir.noteZh: 他的突出特点是提前站位后的快速反应。他会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Baris Alper Yilmaz.name: Baris Alper Yilmaz
Baris Alper Yilmaz.summary: Barış Alper Yılmaz (born 23 May 2000) is a Turkish professional footballer who plays as a winger for Süper Lig club Galatasaray and the Turkey national team.
Baris Alper Yilmaz.note: Yılmaz's signature is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He absorbs contact and keeps the ball close enough to continue forward.
Baris Alper Yilmaz.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在防线重组前制造干净射门上。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会承受身体接触后仍把球留在可继续推进的位置。

Caglar Soyuncu.name: Caglar Soyuncu
Caglar Soyuncu.summary: Çağlar Söyüncü (Turkish pronunciation: [tʃaːˈɫaɾ sœjynˈdʒy]; born 23 May 1996) is a Turkish professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Süper Lig club Fenerbahçe and the Turkey national team.
Caglar Soyuncu.note: Söyüncü's signature is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Caglar Soyuncu.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢上。他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Can Uzun.name: Can Uzun
Can Uzun.summary: Can Uzun is a Türkiye attacking midfielder from Eintracht Frankfurt who gives the national team between-lines receiving, sharp shooting, and young creative upside.
Can Uzun.note: Uzun's signature is receiving in tight spaces with his next action already planned. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He changes position while keeping his priorities simple.
Can Uzun.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在狭小空间接球前就想好下一步上。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。

Deniz Gul.name: Deniz Gul
Deniz Gul.summary: Deniz Daniel Gül (born 2 July 2004) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for Primeira Liga club Porto. Born in Sweden, he plays for the Turkish national team.
Deniz Gul.note: Gül's signature is waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Deniz Gul.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在等防守者注意力转移后再启动上。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Eren Elmali.name: Eren Elmali
Eren Elmali.summary: Evren Eren Elmalı (born 7 July 2000) is a Turkish professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Süper Lig club Galatasaray and the Turkey national team.
Eren Elmali.note: Elmalı is defined by making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Eren Elmali.noteZh: 他靠在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择与同位置球员拉开差异。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Ferdi Kadioglu.name: Ferdi Kadioglu
Ferdi Kadioglu.summary: Ferdi Erenay Kadıoğlu (Turkish pronunciation: [fæɾˈdi eɾeˈnaj kaˈdɯoːɫu]; born 7 October 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as a full back, midfielder or winger for Premier League club Brighton & Hove Albion.
Ferdi Kadioglu.note: Kadıoğlu stands out for creating a better angle for the next pass. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Ferdi Kadioglu.noteZh: 他的突出特点是为下一脚传球制造更好的角度。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Ismail Yuksek.name: Ismail Yuksek
Ismail Yuksek.summary: İsmail Yüksek (born 26 January 1999) is a Turkish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Süper Lig side Fenerbahçe and the Turkey national team.
Ismail Yuksek.note: Yüksek's signature is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Ismail Yuksek.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢上。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Kaan Ayhan.name: Kaan Ayhan
Kaan Ayhan.summary: Kaan Ayhan (born 10 November 1994) is a professional footballer who plays as a defender for Süper Lig club Galatasaray. Born in Germany, he plays for the Turkey national team.
Kaan Ayhan.note: Ayhan stands out for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He changes position while keeping his priorities simple. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Kaan Ayhan.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Kerem Akturkoglu.name: Kerem Akturkoglu
Kerem Akturkoglu.summary: Muhammed Kerem Aktürkoğlu (Turkish pronunciation: [ceˈɾɛm akˈtyɾkoːɫu]; born 21 October 1998) is a Turkish professional footballer who plays as a winger or wide midfielder for Süper Lig club Fenerbahçe and the Turkey national team.
Kerem Akturkoglu.note: Aktürkoğlu's signature is explosive speed once open grass appears. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Kerem Akturkoglu.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在看到空当后的爆发速度上。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Merih Demiral.name: Merih Demiral
Merih Demiral.summary: Merih Demiral (born 5 March 1998) is a Turkish professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Saudi Pro League club Al-Ahli and the Turkey national team.
Merih Demiral.note: Demiral stands out for reading the flight of the ball before the duel begins. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Merih Demiral.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在争顶前先判断球的飞行轨迹。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Mert Gunok.name: Mert Gunok
Mert Gunok.summary: Fehmi Mert Günok (Turkish pronunciation: [mæɾt ˈɡynok]; born 1 March 1989) is a Turkish professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Süper Lig club Fenerbahçe and the Turkey national team.
Mert Gunok.note: Watch Günok for staying ready through long quiet spells. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Mert Gunok.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在长时间无事可做后依然保持专注。留意他如何在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Mert Muldur.name: Mert Muldur
Mert Muldur.summary: Mert Müldür is a Türkiye right-back from Fenerbahçe who gives the national team full-back defending, recovery speed, and back-post coverage.
Mert Muldur.note: Müldür's signature is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He turns early and closes the runner before the box. He checks the runner over his shoulder before the final pass arrives.
Mert Muldur.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢上。他会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。他也会最后一传到来前回头确认跑动者的位置。

Oguz Aydin.name: Oguz Aydin
Oguz Aydin.summary: Oğuz Aydın is a Türkiye right winger from Fenerbahçe who gives the national team one-on-one dribbling, acceleration, and direct crossing.
Oguz Aydin.note: Aydın's signature is changing direction without losing control of the ball. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Oguz Aydin.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在变向时仍把球控制在脚下上。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。他也会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Orkun Kokcu.name: Orkun Kokcu
Orkun Kokcu.summary: Orkun Kökçü is a Türkiye central midfielder from Beşiktaş who gives the national team progressive passing, midfield shooting, and press-resistant control.
Orkun Kokcu.note: Watch Kökçü for seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Orkun Kokcu.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。留意他如何穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Ozan Kabak.name: Ozan Kabak
Ozan Kabak.summary: Ozan Kabak is a Türkiye centre-back from TSG Hoffenheim who gives the national team aggressive duels, aerial defending, and recovery cover.
Ozan Kabak.note: Kabak's edge is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Ozan Kabak.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Salih Ozcan.name: Salih Ozcan
Salih Ozcan.summary: Salih Özcan is a Türkiye defensive midfielder from Borussia Dortmund who gives the national team screening, duels, and disciplined possession support.
Salih Ozcan.note: Özcan's edge is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Salih Ozcan.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Samet Akaydin.name: Samet Akaydin
Samet Akaydin.summary: Samet Akaydin (born 13 March 1994) is a Turkish professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Süper Lig club Çaykur Rizespor and the Turkey national team.
Samet Akaydin.note: Akaydin's edge is the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Samet Akaydin.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Ugurcan Cakir.name: Ugurcan Cakir
Ugurcan Cakir.summary: Uğurcan Çakır is a Türkiye goalkeeper from Galatasaray who gives the national team shot stopping, penalty-area command, and long distribution.
Ugurcan Cakir.note: Çakır's signature is sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Ugurcan Cakir.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在提前站位后的快速反应上。他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Yunus Akgun.name: Yunus Akgun
Yunus Akgun.summary: Yunus Akgün (born 7 July 2000) is a Turkish professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or right winger for Süper Lig club Galatasaray and the Turkey national team.
Yunus Akgun.note: Akgün's signature is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Yunus Akgun.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在比防线早一步看到决定性的传球上。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Zeki Celik.name: Zeki Celik
Zeki Celik.summary: Mehmet Zeki Çelik (Turkish pronunciation: [ˈzeci ˈtʃelik]; born 17 February 1997) is a Turkish professional footballer who plays for Serie A club Roma and the Turkey national team. Mainly a right-back, he can also be deployed as a centre-back in a back three.
Zeki Celik.note: Çelik is defined by protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Zeki Celik.noteZh: 他靠先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢与同位置球员拉开差异。他会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Irfan Can Kahveci.name: Irfan Can Kahveci
Irfan Can Kahveci.summary: İrfan Can Kahveci is a Türkiye right winger from Kasımpaşa who gives the national team left-footed crossing, combination play, and set-piece quality.
Irfan Can Kahveci.note: Kahveci's edge is delivering the ball without needing much space. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Irfan Can Kahveci.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在很小空间里也能送出传中的能力。他会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Alex Zendejas.name: Alex Zendejas
Alex Zendejas.summary: Álex Zendejas is a United States right winger from América who gives the national team left-footed service, box arrivals, and Liga MX sharpness.
Alex Zendejas.note: Watch Zendejas for delivering the ball without needing much space. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Alex Zendejas.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在很小空间里也能送出传中的能力。留意他如何从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Antonee Robinson.name: Antonee Robinson
Antonee Robinson.summary: Antonee Robinson (born August 8, 1997) is a professional soccer player who plays as a left-back for Premier League club Fulham. Born in England, he represents the United States national team.
Antonee Robinson.note: Robinson is defined by recovery speed when the defensive line is exposed. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Antonee Robinson.noteZh: 他靠防线暴露后的回追速度与同位置球员拉开差异。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Auston Trusty.name: Auston Trusty
Auston Trusty.summary: Auston Levi-Jesaiah Trusty (born August 12, 1998) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a center-back for Scottish Premiership club Celtic and the United States national team.
Auston Trusty.note: Trusty is defined by creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Auston Trusty.noteZh: 他靠在防线重组前制造干净射门与同位置球员拉开差异。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Brenden Aaronson.name: Brenden Aaronson
Brenden Aaronson.summary: Brenden Russell Aaronson (born October 22, 2000) is an American professional soccer player who plays as an attacking midfielder or winger for Premier League club Leeds United and the United States national team.
Brenden Aaronson.note: Aaronson stands out for pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Brenden Aaronson.noteZh: 他的突出特点是带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑。他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Chris Brady.name: Chris Brady
Chris Brady.summary: Christopher Keith Brady (born March 3, 2004) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a goalkeeper for Major League Soccer club Chicago Fire and the United States national team.
Chris Brady.note: Brady stands out for sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Chris Brady.noteZh: 他的突出特点是提前站位后的快速反应。他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Chris Richards.name: Chris Richards
Chris Richards.summary: Christopher Jeffrey Richards (born March 28, 2000) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a center-back for Premier League club Crystal Palace and the United States national team.
Chris Richards.note: Richards stands out for moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Chris Richards.noteZh: 他的突出特点是用传球的力度和角度移动防线。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Cristian Roldan.name: Cristian Roldan
Cristian Roldan.summary: Cristian Roldan (born June 3, 1995) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a midfielder for Major League Soccer club Seattle Sounders FC, which he captains, and the United States national team.
Cristian Roldan.note: Roldan is defined by creating a better angle for the next pass. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Cristian Roldan.noteZh: 他靠为下一脚传球制造更好的角度与同位置球员拉开差异。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Haji Wright.name: Haji Wright
Haji Wright.summary: Haji Amir Wright (born March 27, 1998) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a forward or winger for Premier League club Coventry City and the United States national team.
Haji Wright.note: Wright stands out for using strength without slowing the next action. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Haji Wright.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在对抗中用力量但不拖慢下一步。他会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Joe Scally.name: Joe Scally
Joe Scally.summary: Joseph Michael Scally (born December 31, 2002) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a full-back for Bundesliga club Borussia Mönchengladbach and the United States national team.
Joe Scally.note: Watch Scally for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. He checks the runner over his shoulder before the final pass arrives.
Joe Scally.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。留意他如何等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。他也会最后一传到来前回头确认跑动者的位置。

Malik Tillman.name: Malik Tillman
Malik Tillman.summary: Malik Leon Tillman (born May 28, 2002) is a German-American professional soccer player who plays as an attacking midfielder for Bundesliga club Bayer Leverkusen. Born in Germany, he represents the United States national team.
Malik Tillman.note: Tillman is defined by creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He adjusts his position early enough to make the difficult action look simple.
Malik Tillman.noteZh: 他靠在防线重组前制造干净射门与同位置球员拉开差异。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会提前调整位置，让困难处理看起来简单。

Matt Freese.name: Matt Freese
Matt Freese.summary: Matthew Andrew Geary Freese (born September 2, 1998) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a goalkeeper for Major League Soccer club New York City FC and the United States national team.
Matt Freese.note: Freese stands out for sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He keeps his feet active and makes the save with the fewest movements. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Matt Freese.noteZh: 他的突出特点是提前站位后的快速反应。他会保持脚下轻快，用最少动作完成扑救。他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Matt Turner.name: Matt Turner
Matt Turner.summary: Matthew Charles Turner (born June 24, 1994) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a goalkeeper for Major League Soccer club New England Revolution, on loan from Ligue 1 club Lyon, and the United States national team.
Matt Turner.club: New England Revolution (on loan from Lyon)
Matt Turner.note: Turner's edge is sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He recognizes when to slow the play and when to take the risk. He waits for the strike before committing.
Matt Turner.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是提前站位后的快速反应。他会判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。他也会等到对方触球前再做扑救选择。

Max Arfsten.name: Max Arfsten
Max Arfsten.summary: Maximilian Michael Arfsten (born April 19, 2001) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a winger for Major League Soccer club Columbus Crew and the United States national team.
Max Arfsten.note: Arfsten stands out for making purposeful movement away from the ball. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Max Arfsten.noteZh: 他的突出特点是用有目的的无球移动创造接应点。他会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。他也会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Miles Robinson.name: Miles Robinson
Miles Robinson.summary: Miles Gordon Robinson (born March 14, 1997) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a center-back for Major League Soccer club FC Cincinnati and the United States national team.
Miles Robinson.note: Robinson stands out for recovery speed when the defensive line is exposed. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Miles Robinson.noteZh: 他的突出特点是防线暴露后的回追速度。他会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Ricardo Pepi.name: Ricardo Pepi
Ricardo Pepi.summary: Ricardo Daniel Pepi (born January 9, 2003) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a striker for Eredivisie club PSV and the United States national team.
Ricardo Pepi.note: Pepi's edge is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He attacks the near-post lane before the marker can turn. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Ricardo Pepi.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会在盯防者转身前冲向近门柱线路。他也会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Sebastian Berhalter.name: Sebastian Berhalter
Sebastian Berhalter.summary: Sebastian Matthew Berhalter (born May 10, 2001) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a midfielder for Major League Soccer club Vancouver Whitecaps and the United States national team.
Sebastian Berhalter.note: Berhalter's edge is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Sebastian Berhalter.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Sergino Dest.name: Sergino Dest
Sergino Dest.summary: Sergiño Gianni Dest (; born November 3, 2000) is a professional soccer player who plays as a full-back for Eredivisie club PSV Eindhoven. Born in the Netherlands, he represents the United States national team.
Sergino Dest.note: Dest stands out for changing direction without losing control of the ball. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him.
Sergino Dest.noteZh: 他的突出特点是变向时仍把球控制在脚下。他会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。他也会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。

Tim Ream.name: Tim Ream
Tim Ream.summary: Timothy Michael Ream (born October 5, 1987) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a center-back or left-back for Major League Soccer club Charlotte and captains the United States national team.
Tim Ream.note: Ream is defined by calm decisions shaped by experience in high-pressure moments. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Tim Ream.noteZh: 他靠高压时刻由经验带来的冷静判断与同位置球员拉开差异。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。

Timothy Weah.name: Timothy Weah
Timothy Weah.summary: Timothy Tarpeh Weah (born February 22, 2000) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a winger or right-back for Ligue 1 club Marseille, on loan from Serie A club Juventus, and the United States national team.
Timothy Weah.note: Weah's edge is explosive speed once open grass appears. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Timothy Weah.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是看到空当后的爆发速度。他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Mark McKenzie.name: Mark McKenzie
Mark McKenzie.summary: Mark McKenzie is a United States centre-back from Toulouse who gives the national team recovery defending, clean passing, and aerial control.
Mark McKenzie.note: Watch McKenzie for recovering position without panicking after the first line is broken. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Mark McKenzie.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是第一道防线被突破后仍能冷静回位。留意他如何穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Alex Arce.name: Alex Arce
Alex Arce.summary: Álex Adrián Arce Barrios (born 16 June 1995) is a Paraguayan professional footballer who plays as a striker for Argentine club Independiente Rivadavia and the Paraguay national team.
Alex Arce.note: Arce is defined by creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He pins a defender and creates room for the next runner. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Alex Arce.noteZh: 他靠在防线重组前制造干净射门与同位置球员拉开差异。他会牵制一名后卫，为后插上的队友腾出空间。他也会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。

Alexandro Maidana.name: Alexandro Maidana
Alexandro Maidana.summary: Alexandro Maidana Mendieta (born 26 July 2005) is a Paraguayan professional football player who plays as a left-back for Argentine Primera División club Talleres, and the Paraguay national team.
Alexandro Maidana.note: Maidana's edge is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He turns early and closes the runner before the box. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him.
Alexandro Maidana.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。他也会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。

Andres Cubas.name: Andres Cubas
Andres Cubas.summary: Adrián Andrés Cubas (born 11 May 1996) is a professional footballer who plays as midfielder for Major League Soccer club Vancouver Whitecaps. Born in Argentina, he plays for the Paraguay national team.
Andres Cubas.note: Cubas's signature is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Andres Cubas.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢上。他会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Antonio Sanabria.name: Antonio Sanabria
Antonio Sanabria.summary: Arnaldo Antonio Sanabria Ayala (born 4 March 1996), also known as Tony Sanabria, is a Paraguayan professional footballer who plays as a forward for Serie B club Cremonese and the Paraguay national team.
Antonio Sanabria.note: Sanabria's signature is making the next teammate's action easier. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Antonio Sanabria.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在让队友下一步处理更轻松上。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Braian Ojeda.name: Braian Ojeda
Braian Ojeda.summary: Braian Óscar Ojeda Rodríguez (born 27 June 2000) is a Paraguayan professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Major League Soccer club Orlando City and the Paraguay national team.
Braian Ojeda.note: Ojeda's signature is changing direction without losing control of the ball. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Braian Ojeda.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在变向时仍把球控制在脚下上。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Diego Gomez.name: Diego Gomez
Diego Gomez.summary: Diego Gómez is a Paraguay central midfielder from Brighton & Hove Albion who gives the national team powerful carrying, midfield shooting, and box-to-box range.
Diego Gomez.note: Gómez's edge is using strength without slowing the next action. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Diego Gomez.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在对抗中用力量但不拖慢下一步。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Fabian Balbuena.name: Fabian Balbuena
Fabian Balbuena.summary: Fabián Cornelio Balbuena González (born 23 August 1991) is a Paraguayan professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Campeonato Brasileiro Série A club Grêmio and the Paraguay national team.
Fabian Balbuena.note: Balbuena stands out for calm decisions shaped by experience in high-pressure moments. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Fabian Balbuena.noteZh: 他的突出特点是高压时刻由经验带来的冷静判断。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。

Gabriel Avalos.name: Gabriel Avalos
Gabriel Avalos.summary: Gabriel Ávalos Stumpfs (born 9 July 1991) is a Paraguayan professional footballer who plays as a striker for Argentine Primera División club Independiente and the Paraguay national team.
Gabriel Avalos.note: Watch Ávalos for making purposeful movement away from the ball. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Gabriel Avalos.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是用有目的的无球移动创造接应点。留意他如何把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Gaston Olveira.name: Gaston Olveira
Gaston Olveira.summary: Gastón Hernán Olveira Echeverría (born 21 April 1993) is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Paraguayan Primera División club Club Olimpia. Born in Uruguay, he plays for the Paraguay national team.
Gaston Olveira.note: Olveira's signature is organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Gaston Olveira.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在危险出现前组织好队友上。他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Gatito Fernandez.name: Gatito Fernandez
Gatito Fernandez.summary: Roberto Júnior Fernández Torres (born 29 March 1988), better known as Gatito Fernández, is a Paraguayan professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Paraguayan Primera División club Cerro Porteño and the Paraguay national team.
Gatito Fernandez.note: Fernández is defined by staying ready through long quiet spells. He keeps his feet active and makes the save with the fewest movements. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step.
Gatito Fernandez.noteZh: 他靠在长时间无事可做后依然保持专注与同位置球员拉开差异。他会保持脚下轻快，用最少动作完成扑救。他也会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。

Gustavo Caballero.name: Gustavo Caballero
Gustavo Caballero.summary: Gustavo Rubén Caballero González (born 21 September 2001) is a Paraguayan professional footballer who plays for EFL Championship club Portsmouth, on loan from Campeonato Brasileiro Série A club Santos, and the Paraguay national team.
Gustavo Caballero.note: Watch Caballero for explosive speed once open grass appears. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap.
Gustavo Caballero.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是看到空当后的爆发速度。留意他如何接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。

Gustavo Velazquez.name: Gustavo Velazquez
Gustavo Velazquez.summary: Víctor Gustavo Velázquez Ramos (born 17 April 1991) is a Paraguayan professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Cerro Porteño and the Paraguay national team.
Gustavo Velazquez.note: Velázquez's edge is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Gustavo Velazquez.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Isidro Pitta.name: Isidro Pitta
Isidro Pitta.summary: Isidro Miguel Pitta Saldivar (born 14 August 1999) is a Paraguayan footballer who plays as a forward for Campeonato Brasileiro Série A club Red Bull Bragantino and the Paraguay national team.
Isidro Pitta.note: Pitta's edge is starting his run while defenders are still watching the ball. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Isidro Pitta.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在防守者仍盯着球时提前启动。他会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。他也会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Jose Canale.name: Jose Canale
Jose Canale.summary: José María Canale Domínguez (born 20 July 1996) is a Paraguayan professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Argentine Primera División side Lanús and the Paraguay national team.
Jose Canale.note: Canale's edge is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose.
Jose Canale.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。

Juan Jose Caceres.name: Juan Jose Caceres
Juan Jose Caceres.summary: Juan José Cáceres (born 1 June 2000) is a professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Russian Premier League club Dynamo Moscow. Born in Argentina, he plays for the Paraguay national team.
Juan Jose Caceres.note: Cáceres's edge is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him.
Juan Jose Caceres.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。他也会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。

Junior Alonso.name: Junior Alonso
Junior Alonso.summary: Júnior Osmar Ignacio Alonso Mujica (born 9 February 1993) is a Paraguayan professional footballer who plays as a defender or left-back for Campeonato Brasileiro Série A club Atlético Mineiro and the Paraguay national team.
Junior Alonso.note: Alonso stands out for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Junior Alonso.noteZh: 他的突出特点是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Omar Alderete.name: Omar Alderete
Omar Alderete.summary: Omar Federico Alderete Fernández (born 26 December 1996) is a Paraguayan professional footballer who plays as a defender for Premier League club Sunderland and the Paraguay national team. Mainly a centre-back, he can also play as a left-back.
Omar Alderete.note: Alderete's edge is making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Omar Alderete.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Orlando Gill.name: Orlando Gill
Orlando Gill.summary: Orlando Daniel Gill Noldin (born 11 June 2000) is a Paraguayan professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for the Argentine Primera División club San Lorenzo and the Paraguay national team.
Orlando Gill.note: Gill stands out for sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Orlando Gill.noteZh: 他的突出特点是提前站位后的快速反应。他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Ramon Sosa.name: Ramon Sosa
Ramon Sosa.summary: Ramón Sosa Acosta (born 31 August 1999) is a Paraguayan professional footballer who plays as a winger for Campeonato Brasileiro Série A club Palmeiras, and the Paraguay national team.
Ramon Sosa.note: Sosa stands out for explosive speed once open grass appears. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Ramon Sosa.noteZh: 他的突出特点是看到空当后的爆发速度。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Kaku.name: Kaku
Kaku.summary: Kaku is a Paraguay attacking midfielder from Al-Ain who gives the national team left-footed creativity, final passes, and set-piece service.
Kaku.note: Kaku's signature is creating a better angle for the next pass. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Kaku.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在为下一脚传球制造更好的角度上。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Aiden Oneill.name: Aiden Oneill
Aiden Oneill.summary: Aiden Connor O'Neill (born 4 July 1998) is an Australian professional soccer player who currently plays as a defensive midfielder for New York City FC and the Australia national team.
Aiden Oneill.note: O'Neill's edge is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Aiden Oneill.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Ajdin Hrustic.name: Ajdin Hrustic
Ajdin Hrustic.summary: Ajdin Hrustic (Bosnian: [ǎjdin xrǔstitɕ] EYE-din HROO-stich; born 5 July 1996) is an Australian professional soccer player who plays as a midfielder for Eerste Divisie club Heracles Almelo and the Australia national team.
Ajdin Hrustic.note: Hrustić's edge is moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He varies the height and pace of his delivery. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Ajdin Hrustic.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是用传球的力度和角度移动防线。他会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Alessandro Circati.name: Alessandro Circati
Alessandro Circati.summary: Alessandro Circati (Italian: [alesˈsandro tʃirˈkaːti]; born 10 October 2003) is a professional soccer player who plays as a central defender for Serie A club Parma.
Alessandro Circati.note: Circati's signature is keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Alessandro Circati.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定上。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Awer Mabil.name: Awer Mabil
Awer Mabil.summary: Awer Bul Mabil (born 15 September 1995) is a professional soccer player who plays as a winger for Segunda División club CD Castellón. Born in a Kenyan refugee camp to South Sudanese parents, he plays for the Australia national team.
Awer Mabil.note: Mabil's edge is explosive speed once open grass appears. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Awer Mabil.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是看到空当后的爆发速度。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Aziz Behich.name: Aziz Behich
Aziz Behich.summary: Aziz Behich (Turkish: [aˈziz eɾaɫˈtaj beˈhit͡ʃ], AZ-iz BAY-itch; born 16 December 1990) is an Australian professional soccer player who plays as a left back for A-League Men club Melbourne City and the Australia national team.
Aziz Behich.note: Watch Behich for calm decisions shaped by experience in high-pressure moments. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him.
Aziz Behich.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是高压时刻由经验带来的冷静判断。留意他如何等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。他也会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。

Cameron Devlin.name: Cameron Devlin
Cameron Devlin.summary: Cammy Devlin is an Australia central midfielder from Heart of Midlothian who gives the national team ball-winning bite, pressing range, and combative energy.
Cameron Devlin.note: Devlin's signature is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Cameron Devlin.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢上。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Harry Souttar.name: Harry Souttar
Harry Souttar.summary: Harry James Souttar (born 22 October 1998) is a professional soccer player who plays as a centre-back for EFL League One club Leicester City. Born in Scotland, he plays for the Australia national team.
Harry Souttar.note: Souttar is defined by reading the flight of the ball before the duel begins. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Harry Souttar.noteZh: 他靠在争顶前先判断球的飞行轨迹与同位置球员拉开差异。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Jacob Italiano.name: Jacob Italiano
Jacob Italiano.summary: Jacob Michael Italiano (born 30 July 2001) is an Australian professional football player who plays as a right back for Austrian Bundesliga club Grazer AK and the Australia national team.
Jacob Italiano.note: Italiano is defined by making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Jacob Italiano.noteZh: 他靠在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择与同位置球员拉开差异。他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。他也会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Jason Geria.name: Jason Geria
Jason Geria.summary: Jason Kato Geria (born 10 May 1993) is an Australian professional soccer player who plays as a defender for Albirex Niigata in the J2 League and the Australia national team.
Jason Geria.note: Geria stands out for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He adjusts his position early enough to make the difficult action look simple. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Jason Geria.noteZh: 他的突出特点是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会提前调整位置，让困难处理看起来简单。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Jordan Bos.name: Jordan Bos
Jordan Bos.summary: Jordan Jacob Bos (born 29 October 2002) is an Australian professional soccer player who plays as a left back for Eredivisie side Feyenoord and the Australia national team.
Jordan Bos.note: Bos's signature is recovery speed when the defensive line is exposed. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him.
Jordan Bos.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在防线暴露后的回追速度上。他会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。他也会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。

Kai Trewin.name: Kai Trewin
Kai Trewin.summary: Kai Clifton Trewin (; born 18 May 2001) is an Australian professional soccer player who plays as a central defender for Major League Soccer club New York City FC and the Australia national team.
Kai Trewin.note: Trewin is defined by moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Kai Trewin.noteZh: 他靠用传球的力度和角度移动防线与同位置球员拉开差异。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Lucas Herrington.name: Lucas Herrington
Lucas Herrington.summary: Lucas Herrington (born 5 September 2007) is an Australian professional soccer player who plays as a central defender for Major League Soccer club Colorado Rapids and the Australia national team.
Lucas Herrington.note: Watch Herrington for keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He changes position while keeping his priorities simple.
Lucas Herrington.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定。留意他如何主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。

Mathew Leckie.name: Mathew Leckie
Mathew Leckie.summary: Mathew Allan Leckie (born 4 February 1991) is an Australian soccer player who plays for A-League club Melbourne City and the Australia national team (whom he previously captained). Leckie, being a quick and agile player, is usually placed on the wing.
Mathew Leckie.note: Leckie's signature is calm decisions shaped by experience in high-pressure moments. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap.
Mathew Leckie.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在高压时刻由经验带来的冷静判断上。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。

Milos Degenek.name: Milos Degenek
Milos Degenek.summary: Miloš Degenek ( MIL-osh DEG-ə-nek; Serbian Cyrillic: Милош Дегенек, born 28 April 1994) is a professional soccer player who plays as a centre-back for Cypriot First Division club APOEL. Born in Croatia, he represents the Australia national team.
Milos Degenek.note: Degenek is defined by the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He recognizes when to slow the play and when to take the risk. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Milos Degenek.noteZh: 他靠在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构与同位置球员拉开差异。他会判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Mohamed Toure.name: Mohamed Toure
Mohamed Toure.summary: Mohamed Touré is an Australia centre-forward from Norwich City who gives the national team pace, penalty-box finishing, and direct channel runs.
Mohamed Toure.note: Touré stands out for explosive speed once open grass appears. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Mohamed Toure.noteZh: 他的突出特点是看到空当后的爆发速度。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Nishan Velupillay.name: Nishan Velupillay
Nishan Velupillay.summary: Nishan Matthew Velupillay (Tamil: நிஷான் மேத்யூ வேலுப்பிள்ளை, pronounced [niːʃɑːn ʋeːlupːiɭɭai]; born 7 May 2001) is an Australian professional soccer player who plays as a winger for Melbourne Victory and the Australia national team.
Nishan Velupillay.note: Velupillay is defined by explosive speed once open grass appears. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Nishan Velupillay.noteZh: 他靠看到空当后的爆发速度与同位置球员拉开差异。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Patrick Beach.name: Patrick Beach
Patrick Beach.summary: Patrick Thomas Beach (born 6 August 2003) is an Australian professional soccer player who plays as a goalkeeper for A-League Men club Melbourne City and the Australia national team.
Patrick Beach.note: Beach's edge is the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Patrick Beach.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Paul Izzo.name: Paul Izzo
Paul Izzo.summary: Paul David Izzo (Italian: [ˈittso]; born 6 January 1995) is an Australian professional soccer player who plays as a goalkeeper for Danish Superliga side Randers and the Australia national team. He was selected to play in the 2026 FIFA World Cup.
Paul Izzo.note: Izzo stands out for sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He keeps his decisions calm when a sudden save is required. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Paul Izzo.noteZh: 他的突出特点是提前站位后的快速反应。他会突然需要扑救时仍能冷静判断。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Paul Okon-Engstler.name: Paul Okon-Engstler
Paul Okon-Engstler.summary: Paul Michael Junior Okon-Engstler (West Flemish: [ˈoːkɔn ˈɛŋstlər]: born 24 January 2005), also known as Paul Okon Junior, is a professional soccer player who plays as a defensive midfielder for Sydney FC in the A-League Men.
Paul Okon-Engstler.note: Okon-Engstler is defined by seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Paul Okon-Engstler.noteZh: 他靠比防线早一步看到决定性的传球与同位置球员拉开差异。他会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Tete Yengi.name: Tete Yengi
Tete Yengi.summary: Tete Owen Yengi (born 28 November 2000) is an Australian professional soccer player who plays as a striker for J1 League club Machida Zelvia, on loan from Scottish Championship club Livingston, and the Australia national team.
Tete Yengi.note: Watch Yengi for using strength without slowing the next action. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Tete Yengi.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在对抗中用力量但不拖慢下一步。留意他如何从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Alexander Sorloth.name: Alexander Sorloth
Alexander Sorloth.summary: Alexander Sørloth (born 5 December 1995) is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays as a striker for La Liga club Atlético Madrid and the Norway national team.
Alexander Sorloth.note: Watch Sørloth for using strength without slowing the next action. He shifts onto his left foot and shoots with little backlift. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Alexander Sorloth.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在对抗中用力量但不拖慢下一步。留意他如何把球调整到左脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Andreas Schjelderup.name: Andreas Schjelderup
Andreas Schjelderup.summary: Andreas Rædergård Schjelderup (born 1 June 2004) is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays as a left winger or forward for Primeira Liga club Benfica and the Norway national team.
Andreas Schjelderup.note: Schjelderup stands out for seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Andreas Schjelderup.noteZh: 他的突出特点是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Egil Selvik.name: Egil Selvik
Egil Selvik.summary: Egil Selvik (born 30 July 1997) is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Watford and the Norway national team.
Egil Selvik.note: Selvik stands out for sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Egil Selvik.noteZh: 他的突出特点是提前站位后的快速反应。他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Fredrik Andre Bjorkan.name: Fredrik Andre Bjorkan
Fredrik Andre Bjorkan.summary: Fredrik André Bjørkan (born 21 August 1998) is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Eliteserien club Bodø/Glimt and the Norway national team.
Fredrik Andre Bjorkan.note: Bjørkan stands out for choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Fredrik Andre Bjorkan.noteZh: 他的突出特点是从后场加入进攻的启动时机。他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。他也会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Fredrik Aursnes.name: Fredrik Aursnes
Fredrik Aursnes.summary: Fredrik Aursnes (born 10 December 1995) is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays primarily as a midfielder for Primeira Liga club Benfica and the Norway national team.
Fredrik Aursnes.note: Watch Aursnes for reading the next phase before the space fully opens. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support. He holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives.
Fredrik Aursnes.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在空当完全出现前读懂下一阶段。留意他如何出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。他也会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Henrik Falchener.name: Henrik Falchener
Henrik Falchener.summary: Henrik Sælebakke Falchener (born 8 May 2003) is a Norwegian footballer who plays as a centre-back for Viking and the Norway national team.
Henrik Falchener.note: Falchener's signature is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Henrik Falchener.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢上。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Jens Petter Hauge.name: Jens Petter Hauge
Jens Petter Hauge.summary: Jens Petter Hauge (born 12 October 1999) is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays as a left winger for Eliteserien club Bodø/Glimt and the Norway national team.
Jens Petter Hauge.note: Watch Hauge for making purposeful movement away from the ball. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Jens Petter Hauge.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是用有目的的无球移动创造接应点。留意他如何把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Kristian Thorstvedt.name: Kristian Thorstvedt
Kristian Thorstvedt.summary: Kristian Thorstvedt (born 13 March 1999) is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Serie A club Sassuolo and the Norway national team.
Kristian Thorstvedt.note: Watch Thorstvedt for creating a better angle for the next pass. He pins a defender and creates room for the next runner. He shifts onto his left foot and shoots with little backlift.
Kristian Thorstvedt.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是为下一脚传球制造更好的角度。留意他如何牵制一名后卫，为后插上的队友腾出空间。他也会把球调整到左脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Kristoffer Ajer.name: Kristoffer Ajer
Kristoffer Ajer.summary: Kristoffer Vassbakk Köpp Ajer (born 17 April 1998) is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays either as centre-back or right-back for Premier League club Brentford and the Norway national team.
Kristoffer Ajer.note: Ajer's edge is the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Kristoffer Ajer.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。他会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Morten Thorsby.name: Morten Thorsby
Morten Thorsby.summary: Morten Thorsby (born 5 May 1996) is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Serie B club Cremonese and the Norway national team.
Morten Thorsby.note: Thorsby is defined by choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support. He holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives.
Morten Thorsby.noteZh: 他靠选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢与同位置球员拉开差异。他会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。他也会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Orjan Nyland.name: Orjan Nyland
Orjan Nyland.summary: Ørjan Nyland is a Norway goalkeeper from Sevilla FC who gives the national team veteran shot stopping, box command, and tournament experience.
Orjan Nyland.note: Nyland stands out for sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders. He recognizes when to slow the play and when to take the risk.
Orjan Nyland.noteZh: 他的突出特点是提前站位后的快速反应。他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。他也会判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。

Oscar Bobb.name: Oscar Bobb
Oscar Bobb.summary: Oscar Bobb (born 12 July 2003) is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder or winger for Premier League club Fulham and the Norway national team.
Oscar Bobb.note: Bobb's edge is changing direction without losing control of the ball. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Oscar Bobb.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是变向时仍把球控制在脚下。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Patrick Berg.name: Patrick Berg
Patrick Berg.summary: Patrick Berg (born 24 November 1997) is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Eliteserien club Bodø/Glimt and the Norway national team.
Patrick Berg.note: Berg stands out for keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Patrick Berg.noteZh: 他的突出特点是压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Sander Berge.name: Sander Berge
Sander Berge.summary: Sander Gard Bolin Berge also known as Sandy Berge (born 14 February 1998) is a Norwegian professional footballer from Asker who plays as a defensive midfielder for Premier League club Fulham and the Norway national team.
Sander Berge.note: Berge's signature is creating a better angle for the next pass. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Sander Berge.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在为下一脚传球制造更好的角度上。他会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。他也会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Sander Tangvik.name: Sander Tangvik
Sander Tangvik.summary: Sander Tangvik (born 29 November 2002) is a Norwegian footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for German Bundesliga club Hamburger SV and the Norway national team.
Sander Tangvik.note: Tangvik stands out for the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Sander Tangvik.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Sondre Langas.name: Sondre Langas
Sondre Langas.summary: Sondre Klingen Langås (born 2 February 2001) is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL Championship club Derby County and the Norway national team. Langås made his debut in the Norwegian Eliteserien for Viking.
Sondre Langas.note: Langås is defined by protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He changes position while keeping his priorities simple.
Sondre Langas.noteZh: 他靠先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢与同位置球员拉开差异。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。

Thelo Aasgaard.name: Thelo Aasgaard
Thelo Aasgaard.summary: Thelonious "Thelo" Gerard Aasgaard (pronounced /ˈtɛloʊ ˈæzɡɑːrd/; TELL-oh AZ-gard; Norwegian pronunciation: [ˈtɛlːʊ ˈoːsɡoːr]; born 2 May 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Scottish Premiership club Rangers.
Thelo Aasgaard.note: Watch Aasgaard for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Thelo Aasgaard.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在防线重组前制造干净射门。留意他如何从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Torbjorn Heggem.name: Torbjorn Heggem
Torbjorn Heggem.summary: Torbjørn Lysaker Heggem (born 12 January 1999) is a Norwegian footballer who plays as a defender for Serie A club Bologna and the Norway national team. Primarily a centre-back, Heggem can also play as a left-back.
Torbjorn Heggem.note: Heggem stands out for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Torbjorn Heggem.noteZh: 他的突出特点是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

David Moller Wolfe.name: David Moller Wolfe
David Moller Wolfe.summary: David Møller Wolfe (born 23 April 2002) is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays as a left-back or left wing-back for EFL Championship club Wolverhampton Wanderers and the Norway national team.
David Moller Wolfe.note: Watch Wolfe for making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
David Moller Wolfe.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择。留意他如何提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Jorgen Strand Larsen.name: Jorgen Strand Larsen
Jorgen Strand Larsen.summary: Jørgen Strand Larsen (Norwegian: [ˈjøːɾɡən strɑn ˈlɑːɾsən], born 6 February 2000) is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays as a striker for Premier League club Crystal Palace and the Norway national team.
Jorgen Strand Larsen.note: Larsen's signature is making the next teammate's action easier. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. He pins a defender and creates room for the next runner.
Jorgen Strand Larsen.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在让队友下一步处理更轻松上。他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。他也会牵制一名后卫，为后插上的队友腾出空间。

Adrien Rabiot.name: Adrien Rabiot
Adrien Rabiot.summary: Adrien Thibault Marie Rabiot (French pronunciation: [adʁijɛ̃ tibo maʁi ʁabjo]; born 3 April 1995) is a French professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Serie A club AC Milan and the France national team.
Adrien Rabiot.note: Watch Rabiot for creating a better angle for the next pass. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Adrien Rabiot.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是为下一脚传球制造更好的角度。留意他如何主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Aurelien Tchouameni.name: Aurelien Tchouameni
Aurelien Tchouameni.summary: Aurélien Djani Tchouaméni (French pronunciation: [oʁeljɛ̃ dʒani tʃuameni, tʃwa-]; born 27 January 2000) is a French professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder or a centre-back for La Liga club Real Madrid and the France national team.
Aurelien Tchouameni.note: Tchouaméni's edge is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Aurelien Tchouameni.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Brice Samba.name: Brice Samba
Brice Samba.summary: Brice Lauriche Samba (born 25 April 1994) is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Ligue 1 club Rennes. Born in the Republic of the Congo, he plays for the France national team.
Brice Samba.note: Samba is defined by organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He keeps his feet active and makes the save with the fewest movements.
Brice Samba.noteZh: 他靠在危险出现前组织好队友与同位置球员拉开差异。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会保持脚下轻快，用最少动作完成扑救。

Dayot Upamecano.name: Dayot Upamecano
Dayot Upamecano.summary: Dayotchanculle Oswald Upamecano (French: [upamekano]; born 27 October 1998) is a French professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Bundesliga club Bayern Munich and the France national team.
Dayot Upamecano.note: Watch Upamecano for choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He turns early and closes the runner before the box. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose.
Dayot Upamecano.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。留意他如何提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。他也会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。

Desire Doue.name: Desire Doue
