Lucas Hernandez.name: Lucas Hernandez
Lucas Hernandez.summary: Lucas François Bernard Hernandez (French pronunciation: [lukas ɛʁnɑ̃dɛz, - ɛʁnandɛs]; born 14 February 1996) is a French professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or left-back for Ligue 1 club Paris Saint-Germain and the France national team.

Maghnes Akliouche.name: Maghnes Akliouche

El Hadji Malick Diouf.name: El Hadji Malick Diouf
El Hadji Malick Diouf.summary: El Hadji Malick Diouf (born 29 December 2004) is a Senegalese professional footballer who plays as a left-back or left wing-back for EFL Championship club West Ham United and the Senegal national team.
El Hadji Malick Diouf.note: Diouf is defined by making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He turns early and closes the runner before the box. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
El Hadji Malick Diouf.noteZh: 他靠在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择与同位置球员拉开差异。他会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Idrissa Gueye.name: Idrissa Gueye
Idrissa Gueye.summary: Idrissa Gana Gueye (born 26 September 1989) is a Senegalese professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Premier League club Everton and the Senegal national team.
Idrissa Gueye.note: Gueye is defined by moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support. He positions himself for the next touch before the first contest is over.
Idrissa Gueye.noteZh: 他靠用传球的力度和角度移动防线与同位置球员拉开差异。他会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。他也会第一次争抢还没结束，就先为下一脚触球站好位置。

Pape Matar Sarr.name: Pape Matar Sarr
Pape Matar Sarr.summary: Pape Matar Sarr (French pronunciation: [pap matɑʁ sɑʁ]; born 14 September 2002) is a Senegalese professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Premier League club Tottenham Hotspur and the Senegal national team.
Pape Matar Sarr.note: Sarr stands out for creating a better angle for the next pass. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Pape Matar Sarr.noteZh: 他的突出特点是为下一脚传球制造更好的角度。他会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Ahmed Basil.name: Ahmed Basil
Ahmed Basil.summary: Ahmed Basil Fadhil Al Fadhli (Arabic: أَحْمَد بَاسِل فَاضِل الْفَضْلِيّ; born 19 August 1996) is an Iraqi professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for the Iraq Stars League club Al-Shorta and the Iraq national team.
Ahmed Basil.note: Watch Fadhil for sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Ahmed Basil.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是提前站位后的快速反应。留意他如何判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Ahmed Qasem.name: Ahmed Qasem
Ahmed Qasem.summary: Ahmed Ihab Ahmed, known as Ahmed Qasem (Arabic: أحمد قاسم, romanized: ʾAḥmad Qāsim pronounced [ˈ(ʔ)aħmad ˈqaː.sɪm]; born 12 July 2003), is a professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Major League Soccer club Nashville SC.
Ahmed Qasem.note: Qasem is defined by creating a better angle for the next pass. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Ahmed Qasem.noteZh: 他靠为下一脚传球制造更好的角度与同位置球员拉开差异。他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Aimar Sher.name: Aimar Sher
Aimar Sher.summary: Aimar Hazar Anwar Sher (born 20 December 2002) is an Iraqi professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Sarpsborg 08 and the Iraq national team.
Aimar Sher.note: Sher's edge is the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Aimar Sher.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Akam Hashim.name: Akam Hashim
Akam Hashim.summary: Akam Hashim Rahman (Arabic: اكام هاشم رحمن; Kurdish: ئاکام هاشم ڕەحمان; born 16 August 1998) is a Kurdish Iraqi professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or midfielder for Al-Zawraa and the Iraq national team.
Akam Hashim.note: Hashem stands out for choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Akam Hashim.noteZh: 他的突出特点是选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Ali Yousif.name: Ali Yousif
Ali Yousif.summary: Ali Yousif Hashim Najatee (Arabic: علي يوسف هاشم; born 19 January 1996) is an Iraqi professional footballer who plays as a forward for Al-Talaba and the Iraq national team.
Ali Yousif.note: Yousif's signature is making purposeful movement away from the ball. He pins a defender and creates room for the next runner. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Ali Yousif.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在用有目的的无球移动创造接应点上。他会牵制一名后卫，为后插上的队友腾出空间。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Fahad Talib.name: Fahad Talib
Fahad Talib.summary: Fahad Talib Raheem (Arabic: فَهْد طَالِب رَحِيم; born 21 October 1994) is an Iraqi professional footballer who played as a goalkeeper for Iraq Stars League club Al Talaba and the Iraq national team.
Fahad Talib.note: Talib stands out for sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Fahad Talib.noteZh: 他的突出特点是提前站位后的快速反应。他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Frans Putros.name: Frans Putros
Frans Putros.summary: Frans Dhia Jirjis Haddad (born 14 July 1993), commonly known as Frans Putros (Arabic: فرانس بطرس; Syriac: ܦܪܢܣ ܦܘܛܪܘܣ), is a professional footballer who plays as a Centre-back, Full-back or Defensive midfielder for Super League club Persib Bandung.
Frans Putros.note: Watch Putros for the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Frans Putros.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。留意他如何守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Hussein Ali.name: Hussein Ali
Hussein Ali.summary: Hussein Ali Jasim Al Saedi (Arabic: حسين علي جاسم الساعدي; born 29 November 1996) is an Iraqi professional footballer who plays for Iraq Stars League club Al-Shorta and the Iraq national team.
Hussein Ali.note: Ali is defined by creating a better angle for the next pass. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Hussein Ali.noteZh: 他靠为下一脚传球制造更好的角度与同位置球员拉开差异。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Ibrahim Bayesh.name: Ibrahim Bayesh
Ibrahim Bayesh.summary: Ibrahim Bayesh Kamil Al-Kaabawi (Arabic: إبرَاهِيْم بَايَش كَامِل الْكَعْبَاوِيّ; born 1 May 2000) is an Iraqi professional footballer who plays Al-Dhafra as a midfielder for UAE Pro League club Al-Dhafra and the Iraq national team.
Ibrahim Bayesh.note: Bayesh is defined by creating a better angle for the next pass. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Ibrahim Bayesh.noteZh: 他靠为下一脚传球制造更好的角度与同位置球员拉开差异。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Jalal Hassan.name: Jalal Hassan
Jalal Hassan.summary: Jalal Hassan Hachem (Arabic: جَلَال حَسَن هَاشِم; born 18 May 1991) is an Iraqi professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for and captains both Al-Zawraa and the Iraq football team.
Jalal Hassan.note: Hassan is defined by staying ready through long quiet spells. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Jalal Hassan.noteZh: 他靠在长时间无事可做后依然保持专注与同位置球员拉开差异。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。

Kevin Yakob.name: Kevin Yakob
Kevin Yakob.summary: Kevin Enkido Yakob William (Syriac: ܟܒܢ ܝܥܩܘܒ, born 10 October 2000) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Danish Superliga club AGF. Born in Sweden, he plays for the Iraq national team.
Kevin Yakob.note: Yakob's signature is keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Kevin Yakob.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定上。他会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Marko Farji.name: Marko Farji
Marko Farji.summary: Marko Zana Hussein Farji (Arabic: ماركو زانا حسين فرج; Kurdish: Marko Zana Husên Fercî; born 16 March 2004) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for Serie A club Venezia. Born in Norway, he plays for the Iraq national team.
Marko Farji.note: Farji is defined by explosive speed once open grass appears. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Marko Farji.noteZh: 他靠看到空当后的爆发速度与同位置球员拉开差异。他会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。他也会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Merchas Doski.name: Merchas Doski
Merchas Doski.summary: Merchas Ghazi Salih Doski (Kurdish: مێرخاس غازی ساڵح دۆسکی, romanized: Mîrxas Qazî Salih Doskî, Arabic: ميرخاس غازي صالح دوسكي) is a professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Viktoria Plzeň. Born in Germany, he plays for the Iraq national team.
Merchas Doski.note: Doski stands out for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area. He turns early and closes the runner before the box.
Merchas Doski.noteZh: 他的突出特点是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。他也会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。

Mohanad Ali.name: Mohanad Ali
Mohanad Ali.summary: Mohanad Ali Kadhim Al-Shammari (Arabic: مُهَنَّد عَلِيّ كَاظِم الشَّمَّرِيّ, born 20 June 2000), commonly known in Iraq as Mimi (Arabic: ميمي), is an Iraqi professional footballer who plays as a forward for UAE club Dibba and the Iraq national team.
Mohanad Ali.note: Ali's signature is waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Mohanad Ali.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在等防守者注意力转移后再启动上。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Munaf Younus.name: Munaf Younus
Munaf Younus.summary: Manaf Younus Hashim Al-Tekreeti (Arabic: مَنَاف يُونُس هَاشِم التِّكرِيْتِيّ; born 16 November 1996) is an Iraqi professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Iraq Stars League club Al-Shorta and the Iraq national team.
Munaf Younus.note: Younis is defined by using strength without slowing the next action. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Munaf Younus.noteZh: 他靠在对抗中用力量但不拖慢下一步与同位置球员拉开差异。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Mustafa Saadoon.name: Mustafa Saadoon
Mustafa Saadoon.summary: Mustafa Saadoon is an Iraq right-back from Al-Shorta who gives the national team wide defending, recovery speed, and overlap support.
Mustafa Saadoon.note: Saadoon is defined by protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He turns early and closes the runner before the box. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him.
Mustafa Saadoon.noteZh: 他靠先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢与同位置球员拉开差异。他会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。他也会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。

Rebin Sulaka.name: Rebin Sulaka
Rebin Sulaka.summary: Rebin Gharib Sulaka Adhamat (Arabic: ريبين غريب سولاقا عظمت; born 12 April 1992) is an Iraqi professional footballer who plays as a centre back for Thai League 1 club Port and the Iraq national team.
Rebin Sulaka.note: Watch Sulaka for calm decisions shaped by experience in high-pressure moments. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Rebin Sulaka.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是高压时刻由经验带来的冷静判断。留意他如何主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。

Youssef Amyn.name: Youssef Amyn
Youssef Amyn.summary: Youssef Wali Faeq Amyn (Arabic: يوسف والي فائق أمين; Kurdish: یوسف وەلی فائق ئەمین‎; born 21 August 2003) is a professional footballer who plays as a winger for Cypriot First Division club AEK Larnaca. Born in Germany, he plays for the Iraq national team.
Youssef Amyn.note: Watch Amyn for explosive speed once open grass appears. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Youssef Amyn.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是看到空当后的爆发速度。留意他如何主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。

Zaid Tahseen.name: Zaid Tahseen
Zaid Tahseen.summary: Zaid Tahseen Abd Zaid Hantoosh (Arabic: زَيْد تَحْسِيْن عَبد زيد; born 29 January 2001) is an Iraqi footballer who plays as a center back for Pakhtakor in the Uzbekistan Super League and the Iraq national team.
Zaid Tahseen.note: Tahseen's edge is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He changes position while keeping his priorities simple.
Zaid Tahseen.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。

Ahmed Maknzi.name: Ahmed Maknzi
Ahmed Maknzi.summary: Ahmed Maknzi is an Iraq left-back from Al-Karma who gives the national team wide defending, recovery runs, and defensive flexibility.
Ahmed Maknzi.note: Maknzi's edge is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose.
Ahmed Maknzi.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。他也会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。

Ali Al-Hamadi.name: Ali Al-Hamadi
Ali Al-Hamadi.summary: Ali Al-Hamadi is an Iraq centre-forward from Luton Town who gives the national team hold-up play, runs in behind, and penalty-box finishing.
Ali Al-Hamadi.note: Al-Hamadi's edge is making the next teammate's action easier. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Ali Al-Hamadi.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是让队友下一步处理更轻松。他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Amir Al-Ammari.name: Amir Al-Ammari
Amir Al-Ammari.summary: Amir Al-Ammari is an Iraq defensive midfielder from Cracovia who gives the national team screening, left-footed passing, and set-piece support.
Amir Al-Ammari.note: Al-Ammari stands out for seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Amir Al-Ammari.noteZh: 他的突出特点是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。他会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Zaid Ismail.name: Zaid Ismail
Zaid Ismail.summary: Zaid Ismail is an Iraq defensive midfielder from Al-Talaba who gives the national team screening, duel work, and simple central passing.
Zaid Ismail.note: Ismail's edge is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Zaid Ismail.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Dailon Livramento.name: Dailon Livramento
Dailon Livramento.summary: Dailon Rocha Livramento do Rosario (Portuguese: [ˈdaj.lɔn ˈʀɔ.ʃɐ li.vɾɐ.ˈmẽ.tu du ʀu.ˈza.ɾi.u]; born 4 May 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for Primeira Liga club Casa Pia, on loan from Serie B club Hellas Verona.
Dailon Livramento.club: Casa Pia (on loan from Hellas Verona)
Dailon Livramento.note: Livramento stands out for waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Dailon Livramento.noteZh: 他的突出特点是等防守者注意力转移后再启动。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Deroy Duarte.name: Deroy Duarte
Deroy Duarte.summary: Deroy d'Encarnação Duarte (Dutch: [də.ˈɾɔj] Portuguese: [dẽ.kɐɾ.nɐ.ˈsɐ̃w du.ˈaɾ.tɨ]; born 4 July 1999) is a professional football player who plays as a midfielder for Bulgarian First League club Ludogorets Razgrad.
Deroy Duarte.note: Duarte's signature is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Deroy Duarte.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在防线重组前制造干净射门上。他会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Diney Borges.name: Diney Borges
Diney Borges.summary: Edilson Alberto Monteiro Sanches Borges (Portuguese: [e.ˈdil.sɔn al.ˈbɛɾ.tu mõ.ˈtej.ɾu ˈsɐ̃.ʃɨʒ ˈbɔɾ.ʒɨʃ]; born 17 January 1995), known as Diney (Kabuverdianu: [di.ˈnej]), is a Cape Verdean professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for UAE Pro League...
Diney Borges.note: Diney stands out for choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Diney Borges.noteZh: 他的突出特点是选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Garry Rodrigues.name: Garry Rodrigues
Garry Rodrigues.summary: Garry Mendes Rodrigues (Portuguese: [ɡa.ˈʀi ˈmẽ.dɨʒ ʀu.ˈdɾi.ɡɨʃ]; born 27 November 1990) is a professional footballer who plays as a winger for Cypriot First Division club Apollon Limassol. Born in the Netherlands, he plays for the Cape Verde national team.
Garry Rodrigues.note: Rodrigues's edge is explosive speed once open grass appears. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Garry Rodrigues.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是看到空当后的爆发速度。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Gilson Benchimol.name: Gilson Benchimol
Gilson Benchimol.summary: Gilson Benchimol Tavares (Portuguese: [ˈʒil.sɔn bẽ.ʃi.ˈmɔl ta.ˈva.ɾɨʃ]; born 29 December 2001) is a Cape Verdean professional footballer who plays as a striker for Russian club Akron Tolyatti and the Cape Verde national team.
Gilson Benchimol.note: Benchimol stands out for making purposeful movement away from the ball. He pins a defender and creates room for the next runner. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Gilson Benchimol.noteZh: 他的突出特点是用有目的的无球移动创造接应点。他会牵制一名后卫，为后插上的队友腾出空间。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Jamiro Monteiro.name: Jamiro Monteiro
Jamiro Monteiro.summary: Jamiro Gregory Monteiro Alvarenga (Portuguese: [ʒɐ.ˈmi.ɾu ˈɡɾɛ.ɡɔ.ɾi mõ.ˈtej.ɾu al.vɐ.ˈɾẽ.ɡɐ]; born 23 November 1993), commonly known as Jamiro, is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Eredivisie club PEC Zwolle.
Jamiro Monteiro.note: Monteiro's signature is keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Jamiro Monteiro.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定上。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

João Paulo.name: João Paulo
João Paulo.summary: João Paulo Moreira Fernandes (Portuguese: [ʒu.ˈɐ̃w ˈpaw.lu mu.ˈɾej.ɾɐ fɨɾ.ˈnɐ̃.dɨʃ]; born 26 May 1998), commonly known as João Paulo, is a Cape Verdean professional footballer who plays as a midfielder or a left-back for Liga I club FCSB and the Cape Verde...
João Paulo.note: Paulo's edge is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
João Paulo.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Jovane Cabral.name: Jovane Cabral
Jovane Cabral.summary: Jovane Eduardo Borges Cabral (Portuguese: [ʒɔ.ˈvɐ.nɨ e.du.ˈaɾ.du ˈbɔɾ.ʒɨʃ kɐ.ˈbɾal]; born 14 June 1998) is a Cape Verdean professional footballer who plays as a winger for Primeira Liga club Estrela da Amadora and the Cape Verde national team.
Jovane Cabral.note: Cabral's signature is changing direction without losing control of the ball. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him.
Jovane Cabral.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在变向时仍把球控制在脚下上。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。

Kelvin Pires.name: Kelvin Pires
Kelvin Pires.summary: Kelvin Spencer Pires (Portuguese: [ˈkɛl.vin ˈspɛ̃.sɛɾ ˈpi.ɾɨʃ]; born 5 June 2000) is a Cape Verdean professional footballer who plays as a centre back for Veikkausliiga club SJK and the Cape Verde national team.
Kelvin Pires.note: Pires is defined by making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Kelvin Pires.noteZh: 他靠在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择与同位置球员拉开差异。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Laros Duarte.name: Laros Duarte
Laros Duarte.summary: Laros Michael d'Encarnação Duarte (Dutch: [ˈla.ɾos mɪ.ˈxa.əl] Portuguese: [dẽ.kɐɾ.nɐ.ˈsɐ̃w du.ˈaɾ.tɨ]; born 28 February 1997) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Hungarian club Puskás Akadémia.
Laros Duarte.note: Duarte stands out for choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Laros Duarte.noteZh: 他的突出特点是选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。他会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Logan Costa.name: Logan Costa
Logan Costa.summary: Logan Evans Costa (Portuguese: [ˈlo.ɡɐn ˈɛ.vɐns ˈkɔʃ.tɐ]; born 1 April 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for La Liga club Villarreal. Born in France, he represents the Cape Verde national team.
Logan Costa.note: Costa's edge is recovering position without panicking after the first line is broken. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Logan Costa.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是第一道防线被突破后仍能冷静回位。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Marcio Rosa.name: Marcio Rosa
Marcio Rosa.summary: Márcio Salomão Brazão da Rosa (Portuguese: [ˈmaɾ.si.u sɐ.lu.ˈmɐ̃w bɾɐ.ˈzɐ̃w dɐ ˈʀɔ.zɐ]; born 23 February 1997) is a Cape Verdean professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Bulgarian First League club Montana and the Cape Verde national team.
Marcio Rosa.note: Rosa's signature is staying ready through long quiet spells. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Marcio Rosa.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在长时间无事可做后依然保持专注上。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Steven Moreira.name: Steven Moreira
Steven Moreira.summary: Steven Moreira (Portuguese: [ˈsti˸.vən mu.ˈɾej.ɾɐ]; born 13 August 1994) is a professional footballer who plays as a right-back or centre-back for Major League Soccer club Columbus Crew. Born in France, he plays for the Cape Verde national team.
Steven Moreira.note: Moreira stands out for calm decisions shaped by experience in high-pressure moments. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him.
Steven Moreira.noteZh: 他的突出特点是高压时刻由经验带来的冷静判断。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。

Telmo Arcanjo.name: Telmo Arcanjo
Telmo Arcanjo.summary: Telmo Emanuel Gomes Arcanjo (Portuguese: [ˈtɛl.mu e.mɐ.nu.ˈɛl ˈɡo.mɨz ɐɾ.ˈkɐ̃.ʒu]; born 21 June 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder or winger for Vitória S.C. Born in Portugal, he plays for the Cape Verde national team.
Telmo Arcanjo.note: Arcanjo's signature is creating a better angle for the next pass. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Telmo Arcanjo.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在为下一脚传球制造更好的角度上。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Wagner Pina.name: Wagner Pina
Wagner Pina.summary: Wagner Fabrício Cardoso de Pina (Portuguese: [ˈvag.nɛɾ fɐ.ˈbɾi.si.u kɐɾ.ˈdo.zu dɨ ˈpi.nɐ]; born 3 November 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Süper Lig club Trabzonspor. Born in Portugal, he plays for the Cape Verde national team.
Wagner Pina.note: Pina stands out for pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Wagner Pina.noteZh: 他的突出特点是带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Willy Semedo.name: Willy Semedo
Willy Semedo.summary: Willy Johnson Semedo Afonso (Portuguese: [ˈwi.li ˈʤɔn.sɔn sɨ.ˈme.du ɐ.ˈfõ.su]; born 27 April 1994) is a professional footballer who plays as a winger. Born in France, he plays for the Cape Verde national team.
Willy Semedo.note: Watch Semedo for making purposeful movement away from the ball. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Willy Semedo.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是用有目的的无球移动创造接应点。留意他如何从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Yannick Semedo.name: Yannick Semedo
Yannick Semedo.summary: Jair Semedo Monteiro (Portuguese: [ʒɐ.ˈiɾ sɨ.ˈme.du mõ.ˈtej.ɾu]; born 29 December 1995), known as Yannick Semedo (Portuguese: [ja.ˈnik sɨ.ˈme.du]), is a Cape Verdean professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Liga Portugal 2 club Farense and the...

Yannick Semedo.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。留意他如何出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。他也会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Nuno da Costa.name: Nuno da Costa
Nuno da Costa.summary: Nuno Miguel da Costa Jóia (Portuguese: [ˈnu.nu mi.ˈɡɛl dɐ ˈkɔʃ.tɐ ˈʒɔ.jɐ]; born 10 February 1991), known as Nuno da Costa, is a Cape Verdean professional footballer who plays as a forward or winger for Süper Lig club İstanbul Başakşehir and the Cape Verde...
Nuno da Costa.note: Watch Costa for making the next teammate's action easier. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Nuno da Costa.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是让队友下一步处理更轻松。留意他如何从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Sidny Lopes Cabral.name: Sidny Lopes Cabral
Sidny Lopes Cabral.summary: Sidny Lopes Cabral (Portuguese: [ˈsid.ni ˈlɔ.pɨʃ kɐ.ˈbɾal]; born 18 September 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a full-back for Süper Lig club Trabzonspor. Born in the Netherlands, he plays for the Cape Verde national team.
Sidny Lopes Cabral.note: Cabral's signature is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He absorbs contact and keeps the ball close enough to continue forward. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Sidny Lopes Cabral.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在防线重组前制造干净射门上。他会承受身体接触后仍把球留在可继续推进的位置。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

CJ dos Santos.name: CJ dos Santos
CJ dos Santos.summary: Carlos Joaquim Antunes dos Santos (Portuguese: [ˈkaɾ.luʒ ʒu.ɐ.ˈkĩ ɐ̃.ˈtu.nɨʒ duʃ ˈsɐ̃.tuʃ]; born 24 August 2000), known as CJ dos Santos, is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Major League Soccer club San Diego FC.
CJ dos Santos.note: Santos is defined by sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
CJ dos Santos.noteZh: 他靠提前站位后的快速反应与同位置球员拉开差异。他会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Stopira.name: Stopira

Stopira.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在高压时刻由经验带来的冷静判断上。他会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Mohamed Kanno.name: Mohamed Kanno
Mohamed Kanno.summary: Mohamed Ibrahim Abdullah Kanno (Arabic: محمد إبراهيم عبد الله كنو; born 22 September 1994) is a Saudi Arabian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Saudi Pro League club Al Hilal and the Saudi Arabia national team.
Mohamed Kanno.note: Kanno's signature is using strength without slowing the next action. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Mohamed Kanno.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在对抗中用力量但不拖慢下一步上。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Saud Abdulhamid.name: Saud Abdulhamid
Saud Abdulhamid.summary: Saud Abdullah Salem Abdulhamid (Arabic: سُعُود عَبْد الله سَالِم عَبْد الْحَمِيد; born 18 July 1999) is a Saudi Arabian professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Ligue 1 club Lens and the Saudi Arabia national team.

Sultan Mandash.name: Sultan Mandash

Sultan Mandash.noteZh: 他靠用有目的的无球移动创造接应点与同位置球员拉开差异。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。

Abdullah Al-Hamdan.name: Abdullah Al-Hamdan
Abdullah Al-Hamdan.summary: Abdullah Abdulrahman Al-Hamdan (Arabic: عَبْد الله عَبْد الرَّحْمٰن الْحَمْدَان; born 13 September 1999) is a Saudi Arabian football player who plays as a forward for Saudi Pro League club Al-Nassr and the Saudi Arabia national team.
Abdullah Al-Hamdan.note: Al-Hamdan's signature is pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Abdullah Al-Hamdan.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑上。他会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Abdullah Al-Khaibari.name: Abdullah Al-Khaibari
Abdullah Al-Khaibari.summary: Abdullah Mohammed Al-Khaibari (Arabic: عبد الله محمد الخيبري, born 16 August 1996) is a Saudi Arabian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Saudi Pro League club Al-Nassr and the Saudi Arabia national team.
Abdullah Al-Khaibari.note: Al-Khaibari stands out for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He positions himself for the next touch before the first contest is over. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Abdullah Al-Khaibari.noteZh: 他的突出特点是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会第一次争抢还没结束，就先为下一脚触球站好位置。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Ahmed Al-Kassar.name: Ahmed Al-Kassar
Ahmed Al-Kassar.summary: Ahmed Al-Kassar is a Saudi Arabia goalkeeper from Al-Qadsiah who brings experience, reaction saves, and penalty-area control.
Ahmed Al-Kassar.note: Al-Kassar stands out for sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Ahmed Al-Kassar.noteZh: 他的突出特点是提前站位后的快速反应。他会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Alaa Hejji.name: Alaa Hejji
Alaa Hejji.summary: Alaa Hejji is a Saudi Arabia central midfielder from NEOM SC who helps connect possession and support counter-pressing phases.

Ayman Yahya.name: Ayman Yahya
Ayman Yahya.summary: Ayman Yahya Salem Ahmed (Arabic: أَيْمَن يَحْيَى سَالِم أَحْمَد, born 14 May 2001) is a Saudi Arabian professional footballer who plays as a winger or full-back for Saudi Pro League club Al-Nassr and the Saudi Arabia national team.
Ayman Yahya.note: Yahya stands out for making purposeful movement away from the ball. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Ayman Yahya.noteZh: 他的突出特点是用有目的的无球移动创造接应点。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Hassan Al-Tambakti.name: Hassan Al-Tambakti
Hassan Al-Tambakti.summary: Hassan Mohammed Osama Al-Tambakti (Arabic: حسان محمد أسامة التمبكتي; born 9 February 1999) is a Saudi Arabian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for the Saudi Arabia national team and for Saudi Pro League side Al Hilal.
Hassan Al-Tambakti.note: Al-Tambakti is defined by recovery speed when the defensive line is exposed. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Hassan Al-Tambakti.noteZh: 他靠防线暴露后的回追速度与同位置球员拉开差异。他会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Hassan Kadesh.name: Hassan Kadesh
Hassan Kadesh.summary: Hassan Kadesh is a Saudi Arabia left-back from Al-Ittihad who gives the team left-footed balance, defensive experience, and set-piece presence.
Hassan Kadesh.note: Watch Kadesh for making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He checks the runner over his shoulder before the final pass arrives. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Hassan Kadesh.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择。留意他如何最后一传到来前回头确认跑动者的位置。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Jehad Thakri.name: Jehad Thakri
Jehad Thakri.summary: Jehad Thakri is a Saudi Arabia centre-back from Al-Qadsiah who adds size, aerial defending, and squad depth.
Jehad Thakri.note: Watch Thakri for the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Jehad Thakri.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。留意他如何主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Khalid Al-Ghannam.name: Khalid Al-Ghannam
Khalid Al-Ghannam.summary: Khalid Eissa Al-Ghannam (Arabic: خالد الغنام; born 8 November 2000) is a Saudi Arabian professional footballer who plays as a winger for Saudi Pro League side Al-Ettifaq and the Saudi Arabia national team.
Khalid Al-Ghannam.note: Al-Ghannam's signature is changing direction without losing control of the ball. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Khalid Al-Ghannam.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在变向时仍把球控制在脚下上。他会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Mohammed Abu Al-Shamat.name: Mohammed Abu Al-Shamat
Mohammed Abu Al-Shamat.summary: Mohammed Abu Al-Shamat is a Saudi Arabia right-back from Al-Qadsiah who offers recovery speed, overlap timing, and defensive energy.
Mohammed Abu Al-Shamat.note: Al-Shamat stands out for recovering position without panicking after the first line is broken. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Mohammed Abu Al-Shamat.noteZh: 他的突出特点是第一道防线被突破后仍能冷静回位。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Moteb Al-Harbi.name: Moteb Al-Harbi
Moteb Al-Harbi.summary: Moteb Al-Harbi is a Saudi Arabia left-back from Al-Hilal who brings overlap timing, recovery defending, and left-footed service.

Nawaf Al-Aqidi.name: Nawaf Al-Aqidi

Saleh Al-Shehri.name: Saleh Al-Shehri
Saleh Al-Shehri.summary: Saleh Khalid Mohammed Al-Shehri (Arabic: صالح خالد محمد الشهري; born 1 November 1993) is a Saudi Arabian professional football player who plays as a striker for Al-Ittihad and the Saudi Arabia national team.

Eric Garcia.summary: Eric García is a Spain centre-back from Barcelona who gives the national team build-up passing, tactical coverage, and calm defending.
Eric Garcia.note: García stands out for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Eric Garcia.noteZh: 他的突出特点是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Fabian Ruiz.name: Fabian Ruiz
Fabian Ruiz.summary: Fabián Ruiz Peña (Spanish pronunciation: [faˈβjan rwiθ ˈpeɲa]; born 3 April 1996), also known simply as Fabián, is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Ligue 1 club Paris Saint-Germain and the Spain national team.
Fabian Ruiz.note: Ruiz's edge is keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Fabian Ruiz.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Ferran Torres.name: Ferran Torres
Ferran Torres.summary: Ferran Torres García (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈferan ˈtores]; born 29 February 2000) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a forward or winger for La Liga club Barcelona and the Spain national team.
Ferran Torres.note: Watch Torres for waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Ferran Torres.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是等防守者注意力转移后再启动。留意他如何从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Gavi.name: Gavi
Gavi.summary: Pablo Martín Páez Gavira (born 5 August 2004), known as Gavi, is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for La Liga club Barcelona and the Spain national team.

Gavi.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑上。他会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Joan Garcia.name: Joan Garcia

Marc Cucurella.name: Marc Cucurella
Marc Cucurella.summary: Marc Cucurella Saseta (Catalan pronunciation: [ˈmaɾ(k) kukuˈɾeʎə səˈzɛtə]; born 22 July 1998) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a left-back or left wing-back for Premier League club Chelsea and the Spain national team.
Marc Cucurella.note: Cucurella is defined by choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose.

Marc Pubill.name: Marc Pubill

Tarek Alaa.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Yasser Ibrahim.name: Yasser Ibrahim
Yasser Ibrahim.summary: Yasser Ibrahim Ahmed El Hanafi (Arabic: يَاسِر إبرَاهِيْم أَحمَد الْحَنَفِي; born 10 February 1993) is an Egyptian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Egyptian Premier League club Al Ahly and the Egypt national team.
Yasser Ibrahim.note: Ibrahim stands out for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Yasser Ibrahim.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Zizo.name: Zizo
Zizo.summary: Ahmed Mostafa Mohamed Sayed (Arabic: أحمد مصطفى محمد سيد; born 10 January 1996) commonly known as Zizo (Arabic: زيزو), is an Egyptian professional footballer who plays as a winger for Egyptian Premier League club Al Ahly and the Egypt national team.
Zizo.note: Zizo's edge is delivering the ball without needing much space. He varies the height and pace of his delivery. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Zizo.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在很小空间里也能送出传中的能力。他会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Ali Alipour.name: Ali Alipour
Ali Alipour.summary: Ali Alipour (Persian: علی علیپور; born 11 November 1995) is an Iranian professional footballer who plays as a Striker for Persian Gulf Pro League club Persepolis and the Iran national team.
Ali Alipour.note: Watch Alipour for waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Ali Alipour.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是等防守者注意力转移后再启动。留意他如何接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Ali Nemati.name: Ali Nemati
Ali Nemati.summary: Ali Nemati is an IR Iran centre-back from Foolad FC who gives the national team left-footed defending, aerial cover, and back-line depth.
Ali Nemati.note: Nemati's edge is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Ali Nemati.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Alireza Beiranvand.name: Alireza Beiranvand
Alireza Beiranvand.summary: Alireza Safar Beiranvand (born 21 September 1992) is an Iranian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for the Persian Gulf Pro League club Tractor and the Iran national team.
Alireza Beiranvand.note: Beiranvand is defined by organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step.
Alireza Beiranvand.noteZh: 他靠在危险出现前组织好队友与同位置球员拉开差异。他会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。他也会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。

Amirhossein Hosseinzadeh.name: Amirhossein Hosseinzadeh
Amirhossein Hosseinzadeh.summary: Amirhossein Hosseinzadeh is an IR Iran forward from Tractor FC who gives the national team quick turns, final-third carrying, and attacking spark.
Amirhossein Hosseinzadeh.note: Hosseinzadeh's edge is making purposeful movement away from the ball. He opens his body on the first touch so he can play forward. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Amirhossein Hosseinzadeh.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是用有目的的无球移动创造接应点。他会第一脚触球时打开身体，准备向前处理。他也会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Amirmohammad Razaghinia.name: Amirmohammad Razaghinia
Amirmohammad Razaghinia.summary: Amirmohammad Razzaghinia is an IR Iran central midfielder from Esteghlal FC who gives the national team midfield legs, duel pressure, and simple progression.
Amirmohammad Razaghinia.note: Razzaghinia's signature is creating a better angle for the next pass. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Amirmohammad Razaghinia.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在为下一脚传球制造更好的角度上。他会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Arya Yousefi.name: Arya Yousefi
Arya Yousefi.summary: Arya Yousefi is an IR Iran right-back from Sepahan FC who gives the national team overlap timing, recovery defending, and right-side energy.
Arya Yousefi.note: Yousefi's edge is pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Arya Yousefi.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Danial Iri.name: Danial Iri
Danial Iri.summary: Danial Eiri is an IR Iran centre-back from Malavan Bandar Anzali who gives the national team centre-back depth, aerial defending, and box protection.

Danial Iri.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Dennis Dargahi.name: Dennis Dargahi

Ehsan Hajisafi.name: Ehsan Hajisafi

Hossein Hosseini.name: Hossein Hosseini
Hossein Hosseini.summary: Seyed Hossein Hosseini (Persian: سید حسین حسینی; born 30 June 1992) is an Iranian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Persian Gulf Pro League club Sepahan and the Iran national team.

Hossein Kanani.name: Hossein Kanani
Hossein Kanani.summary: Mohammad Hossein Kanaanizadegan (Persian: محمد حسین کنعانی زادگان; born 23 March 1994), known as Hossein Kanaani, is an Iranian professional footballer who plays as a defender for Persian Gulf Pro League club Persepolis and Iran national team.

Mehdi Ghayedi.name: Mehdi Ghayedi
Mehdi Ghayedi.summary: Mehdi Ghayedi is an IR Iran winger from Al-Nasr SC who gives the national team low-centre turns, inside shots, and left-wing dribbling.
Mehdi Ghayedi.note: Ghayedi stands out for changing direction without losing control of the ball. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target. He opens his body on the first touch so he can play forward.
Mehdi Ghayedi.noteZh: 他的突出特点是变向时仍把球控制在脚下。他会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。他也会第一脚触球时打开身体，准备向前处理。

Milad Mohammadi.name: Milad Mohammadi
Milad Mohammadi.summary: Milad Mohammadi Keshmarzi, known as Milad Mohammadi (Persian: ميلاد محمدی کشمرزی; born 29 September 1993) is an Iranian professional footballer who plays for Persian Gulf Pro League club Persepolis and the Iran national team.

Payam Niazmand.name: Payam Niazmand
Payam Niazmand.summary: Payam Niazmand (Persian: پیام نیازمند; born 6 April 1995) is an Iranian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Iranian club Persepolis and the Iran national team.
Payam Niazmand.note: Niazmand is defined by sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Payam Niazmand.noteZh: 他靠提前站位后的快速反应与同位置球员拉开差异。他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Ben Old.name: Ben Old

Cedric Bakambu.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在防守者仍盯着球时提前启动。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Chancel Mbemba.name: Chancel Mbemba
Chancel Mbemba.summary: Chancel Mangulu Mbemba (born 8 August 1994) is a Congolese professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Ligue 1 club Lille and the DR Congo national team, of which he is the captain.
Chancel Mbemba.note: Mbemba is defined by seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Chancel Mbemba.noteZh: 他靠比防线早一步看到决定性的传球与同位置球员拉开差异。他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Charles Pickel.name: Charles Pickel
Charles Pickel.summary: Charles Monginda Pickel (born 15 May 1997) is a professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for La Liga club Espanyol. Born in Switzerland, he plays for the DR Congo national team.

Charles Pickel.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。留意他如何等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Cristian Romero.name: Cristian Romero
Cristian Romero.summary: Cristian Gabriel Romero (born 27 April 1998) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Premier League club Tottenham Hotspur, whom he captains, and the Argentina national team.

Damian Emiliano Martinez.name: Damian Emiliano Martinez

Ngalayel Mukau.name: Ngalayel Mukau

Nico Gonzalez.name: Nico Gonzalez

Nico Paz.name: Nico Paz

Nicolas Otamendi.name: Nicolas Otamendi

Nicolas Seiwald.name: Nicolas Seiwald

Nicolas Tagliafico.name: Nicolas Tagliafico

Utkir Yusupov.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在长时间无事可做后依然保持专注上。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会保持脚下轻快，用最少动作完成扑救。

Willer Ditta.name: Willer Ditta
Willer Ditta.summary: Willer Emilio Ditta Pérez (born 23 January 1998) is a Colombian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Liga MX club Cruz Azul and the Colombia national team.
Willer Ditta.note: Ditta is defined by using strength without slowing the next action. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Willer Ditta.noteZh: 他靠在对抗中用力量但不拖慢下一步与同位置球员拉开差异。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Yassine Titraoui.name: Yassine Titraoui
Yassine Titraoui.summary: Yacine Mohamed El Ghazali Titraoui (Arabic: ياسين محمد الغزالي تيطراوي; born 26 July 2003) is an Algerian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Belgian club Charleroi and the Algeria national team.
Yassine Titraoui.note: Watch Titraoui for changing direction without losing control of the ball. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Yassine Titraoui.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是变向时仍把球控制在脚下。留意他如何第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Yerry Mina.name: Yerry Mina
Yerry Mina.summary: Yerry Fernando Mina González (born 23 September 1994) is a Colombian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Serie A club Cagliari and the Colombia national team.
Yerry Mina.note: Mina is defined by reading the flight of the ball before the duel begins. He varies the height and pace of his delivery. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Yerry Mina.noteZh: 他靠在争顶前先判断球的飞行轨迹与同位置球员拉开差异。他会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。他也会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。

Zineddine Belaid.name: Zineddine Belaid
Zineddine Belaid.summary: Zineddine Belaïd (Arabic: زَيْن الدِّين بَلْعِيد; Tamazight: ⵣⵉⵏⴷⴷⵉⵏ ⴱⵍⵄⵉⴷ; born 20 March 1999) is an Algerian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for JS Kabylie and the Algeria national team.
Zineddine Belaid.note: Belaïd's edge is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Zineddine Belaid.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Abdallah Al-Fakhori.name: Abdallah Al-Fakhori
Abdallah Al-Fakhori.summary: Abdallah Ra'ed Mahmoud Al-Fakhouri (Arabic: عَبْد الله رَائِد مَحْمُود الْفَاخُورِيّ; born January 22, 2000) is a Jordanian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Jordanian Pro League side Al-Wehdat and the Jordan national team.
Abdallah Al-Fakhori.note: Al-Fakhouri stands out for organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Abdallah Al-Fakhori.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在危险出现前组织好队友。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Abdallah Nasib.name: Abdallah Nasib
Abdallah Nasib.summary: Abdallah Mousa Musallam Nasib (Arabic: عَبْد الله مُوسَى مُسْلِم نَصِيب; born 25 February 1994) is a Jordanian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Iraq Stars League club Al-Zawraa, on loan from Al-Hussein, and the Jordan national team.
Abdallah Nasib.note: Nasib's edge is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Abdallah Nasib.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Abdul Fatawu.name: Abdul Fatawu
Abdul Fatawu.summary: Abdul Fatawu Issahaku (born 8 March 2004), commonly known as Abdul Fatawu, is a Ghanaian professional footballer who plays as a winger for EFL League One club Leicester City and the Ghana national team.
Abdul Fatawu.note: Watch Fatawu for explosive speed once open grass appears. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Abdul Fatawu.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是看到空当后的爆发速度。留意他如何提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Abdul Mumin.name: Abdul Mumin
Abdul Mumin.summary: Khalid Abdul Mumin Suleman (born 6 June 1998), commonly known as Abdul Mumin, is a Ghanaian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for La Liga club Rayo Vallecano and the Ghana national team.
Abdul Mumin.note: Watch Mumin for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Abdul Mumin.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。留意他如何等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Ali Azaizeh.name: Ali Azaizeh
Ali Azaizeh.summary: Ali Ahmad Ali Azaizeh (Arabic: علي العزايزة; born 13 April 2004) is a Jordanian professional footballer who plays as a winger for Saudi Pro League club Al-Shabab, on loan from Kuwait Premier League club Kazma.
Ali Azaizeh.note: Azaizeh's signature is making purposeful movement away from the ball. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Ali Azaizeh.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在用有目的的无球移动创造接应点上。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。他也会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Alidu Seidu.name: Alidu Seidu
Alidu Seidu.summary: Alidu Seidu (born 4 June 2000) is a Ghanaian-French professional footballer who plays as a defender for French Ligue 1 club Rennes and the Ghana national team.
Alidu Seidu.note: Watch Seidu for recovery speed when the defensive line is exposed. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Alidu Seidu.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是防线暴露后的回追速度。留意他如何守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Amer Jamous.name: Amer Jamous
Amer Jamous.summary: Amer Rasem Adel Jamous (Arabic: عَامِر رَاسِم عَادِل جَامُوس; born 3 July 2002) is a Jordanian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Iraq Stars League club Al-Zawraa, on loan from Al-Wehdat, as well as the Jordan national team.
Amer Jamous.note: Jamous is defined by creating a better angle for the next pass. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Amer Jamous.noteZh: 他靠为下一脚传球制造更好的角度与同位置球员拉开差异。他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Anas Badawi.name: Anas Badawi
Anas Badawi.summary: Anas Saeed Badawi (Arabic: أنس بدوي; born 13 September 1997) is a Jordanian professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Jordanian Pro League club Al-Faisaly and the Jordan national team.
Anas Badawi.note: Badawi stands out for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He turns early and closes the runner before the box.
Anas Badawi.noteZh: 他的突出特点是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。

Augustine Boakye.name: Augustine Boakye
Augustine Boakye.summary: Augustine Boakye (born 3 November 2000) is a Ghanaian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Ligue 2 club Saint-Étienne and the Ghana national team.
Augustine Boakye.note: Boakye stands out for changing direction without losing control of the ball. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him.
Augustine Boakye.noteZh: 他的突出特点是变向时仍把球控制在脚下。他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。

Baba Rahman.name: Baba Rahman
Baba Rahman.summary: Abdul Rahman Baba (born 2 July 1994), also known as Baba Rahman, is a Ghanaian professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Super League Greece club PAOK and the Ghana national team.
Baba Rahman.note: Baba stands out for making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Baba Rahman.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择。他会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Benjamin Asare.name: Benjamin Asare
Benjamin Asare.summary: Benjamin Asare (born 13 July 1992) is a Ghanaian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Accra Hearts of Oak in the Ghana Premier League and the Ghana national team.
Benjamin Asare.note: Watch Asare for sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Benjamin Asare.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是提前站位后的快速反应。留意他如何判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Brandon Thomas-Asante.name: Brandon Thomas-Asante
Brandon Thomas-Asante.summary: Solomon Brandon Michael Clarke Thomas-Asante (born 29 December 1998) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre forward for Premier League club Coventry City. Born in England, he plays for the Ghana national team.
Brandon Thomas-Asante.note: Thomas-Asante is defined by pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Brandon Thomas-Asante.noteZh: 他靠带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑与同位置球员拉开差异。他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。他也会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Christopher Bonsu Baah.name: Christopher Bonsu Baah
Christopher Bonsu Baah.summary: Christopher Bonsu Baah (born 14 December 2004) is a Ghanaian professional footballer who plays as a forward for Saudi Pro League side Al-Qadsiah and the Ghana national team.
Christopher Bonsu Baah.note: Baah stands out for explosive speed once open grass appears. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Christopher Bonsu Baah.noteZh: 他的突出特点是看到空当后的爆发速度。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。

Derrick Luckassen.name: Derrick Luckassen
Derrick Luckassen.summary: Derrick Luckassen (born 3 July 1995) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Cypriot club Pafos. Born in the Netherlands, he plays for the Ghana national team.

Derrick Luckassen.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在防线重组前制造干净射门。留意他如何判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Ehsan Haddad.name: Ehsan Haddad
Ehsan Haddad.summary: Ehsan Manial Farhan Haddad (Arabic: إِحْسَان منيل فَرْحَان حَدَّاد; born 5 February 1994) is a Jordanian footballer who plays for the Jordanian club Al-Hussein and the Jordan national team.
Ehsan Haddad.note: Haddad's edge is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He recognizes when to slow the play and when to take the risk. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.

Elisha Owusu.name: Elisha Owusu

Ernest Nuamah.name: Ernest Nuamah
Ernest Nuamah.summary: Ernest Nuamah Appiah (born 1 November 2003) is a Ghanaian professional footballer who plays as a winger for Ligue 1 club Lyon and the Ghana national team.

Ernest Nuamah.noteZh: 他靠比防线早一步看到决定性的传球与同位置球员拉开差异。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Gideon Mensah.name: Gideon Mensah
Gideon Mensah.summary: Gideon Mensah (born 18 July 1998) is a Ghanaian professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Ligue 1 club Auxerre and the Ghana national team.
Gideon Mensah.note: Mensah stands out for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.

Husam Abu Dahab.summary: Husam Ali Mohammad Abu Dahab (Arabic: حُسَام عَلِيّ مُحَمَّد أَبُو ذَهَب, born 13 May 2000) is a Jordanian footballer who is a center-back for Jordanian Pro League club Al-Faisaly, as well as the Jordan national team.

Ibrahim Sadeh.name: Ibrahim Sadeh
Ibrahim Sadeh.summary: Ibrahim Mohammad Sami Sadeh (Arabic: إبراهيم سعادة; born 27 April 2000) is a Jordanian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Iraqi Stars League side Al-Karma and the Jordan national team.

Jonas Adjetey.name: Jonas Adjetey
Jonas Adjetey.summary: Jonas Adjei Adjetey (born 13 December 2003) is a Ghanaian professional footballer who plays for German 2. Bundesliga side VfL Wolfsburg and the Ghana national team. He plays mainly in the position of centre-back, but can also play as full-back on either side.
Jonas Adjetey.note: Adjetey stands out for using strength without slowing the next action. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Jonas Adjetey.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在对抗中用力量但不拖慢下一步。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Joseph Anang.name: Joseph Anang
Joseph Anang.summary: Joseph Tetteh Anang (born 8 June 2000) is a Ghanaian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for League of Ireland Premier Division club St Patrick's Athletic and the Ghana national team.
Joseph Anang.note: Anang stands out for sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.

Kamaldeen Sulemana.name: Kamaldeen Sulemana
Kamaldeen Sulemana.summary: Kamaldeen Sulemana (born 15 February 2002), also known simply as Kamaldeen, is a Ghanaian professional footballer who plays as a left winger or a forward for Serie A club Atalanta and the Ghana national team.
Kamaldeen Sulemana.note: Watch Sulemana for changing direction without losing control of the ball. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.

Kojo Peprah Oppong.name: Kojo Peprah Oppong
Kojo Peprah Oppong.summary: Kojo Peprah Oppong (born 4 June 2004) is a French-Ghanaian professional footballer who plays as a defender for Ligue 1 club Nice and the Ghana national team.

Kwasi Sibo.name: Kwasi Sibo
Kwasi Sibo.summary: Kwasi Sibo (born 24 June 1998) is a Ghanaian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Segunda División club Real Oviedo and the Ghana national team.

Kwasi Sibo.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是为下一脚传球制造更好的角度。留意他如何第一次争抢还没结束，就先为下一脚触球站好位置。他也会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Lawrence Ati-Zigi.name: Lawrence Ati-Zigi
Lawrence Ati-Zigi.summary: Lawrence Ati-Zigi (born 29 November 1996) is a Ghanaian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Swiss Super League club St. Gallen and the Ghana national team. Ati-Zigi has represented Ghana at under-17 and under-20 levels.

Mahmoud Al-Mardi.name: Mahmoud Al-Mardi
Mahmoud Al-Mardi.summary: Mahmoud Nayef Mardi Al-Hwaitat (Arabic: مَحْمُود نَايِف مَرْضِيّ الحويطات; born 6 October 1993) is a Jordanian footballer who plays as a winger for the Jordanian club Al-Hussein and the Jordan national team.

Marvin Senaya.name: Marvin Senaya
Marvin Senaya.summary: Marvin Senaya (born 28 January 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Ligue 1 club Auxerre. Born in France, he plays for the Ghana national team.
