Mohammad Abu Alnadi.name: Mohammad Abu Alnadi
Mohammad Abu Alnadi.summary: Mohammad Abu Alnadi is a Jordanian centre-back for Selangor and the Jordan national team.
Mohammad Abu Alnadi.note: Watch Alnadi for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Mohammad Abu Alnadi.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。留意他如何主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Mohammad Abu Ghoush.name: Mohammad Abu Ghoush
Mohammad Abu Ghoush.summary: Mohammad Ahmed Mohammad Taha (Arabic: محمد أحمد محمد طه; born 13 July 2005), also known as Mohammad Abu Ghoush (Arabic: محمد أبو غوش), is a Jordanian professional footballer who plays as a left back for Jordanian Pro League club Al-Hussein, on loan from Shabab...
Mohammad Abu Ghoush.note: Taha is defined by making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Mohammad Abu Ghoush.noteZh: 他靠在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择与同位置球员拉开差异。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Mohammad Abu Hasheesh.name: Mohammad Abu Hasheesh
Mohammad Abu Hasheesh.summary: Mohammad Ali Hasan Abu Hashish (Arabic: مُحَمَّد عَلِيّ حَسَن أَبُو حَشِيش; born 9 May 1995) is a professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Iraq Stars League side Al-Karma. Born in Iraq, he represents the Jordan national team.
Mohammad Abu Hasheesh.note: Hashish's signature is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him.
Mohammad Abu Hasheesh.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢上。他会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。他也会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。

Mohammad Abu Zraiq.name: Mohammad Abu Zraiq
Mohammad Abu Zraiq.summary: Mohammad Faisal Yousef Abu Zrayq (Arabic: محمد فيصل يوسف أبو زريق, born 30 December 1997), popularly known as Sharara (Arabic: شرارة), is a Jordanian professional footballer who plays as a winger for Botola Pro club Raja CA and the Jordan national team.
Mohammad Abu Zraiq.note: Zraiq stands out for changing direction without losing control of the ball. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Mohammad Abu Zraiq.noteZh: 他的突出特点是变向时仍把球控制在脚下。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。他也会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。

Mohammad Al-Daoud.name: Mohammad Al-Daoud
Mohammad Al-Daoud.summary: Mohammad Rateb Al-Dawoud (Arabic: مُحَمَّد رَاتِب الدَّاوُود; born 12 April 1992) is a Jordanian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Jordanian Pro League club Al-Wehdat and the Jordan national team.
Mohammad Al-Daoud.note: Al-Daoud's signature is keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. He positions himself for the next touch before the first contest is over. He adjusts his position early enough to make the difficult action look simple.
Mohammad Al-Daoud.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定上。他会第一次争抢还没结束，就先为下一脚触球站好位置。他也会提前调整位置，让困难处理看起来简单。

Mohannad Abu Taha.name: Mohannad Abu Taha
Mohannad Abu Taha.summary: Mohannad Mahmoud Saleh Abu Taha (Arabic: مُهَنَّد مَحْمُود صَالِح أَبُو طٰهٰ; born 2 February 2003) is a Jordanian footballer who plays as a winger or left-back for Iraq Stars League club Al-Quwa Al-Jawiya, and the Jordan national team.
Mohannad Abu Taha.note: Taha's edge is making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Mohannad Abu Taha.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择。他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。他也会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Nizar Al-Rashdan.name: Nizar Al-Rashdan
Nizar Al-Rashdan.summary: Nizar Mahmoud Ahmed Al-Rashdan (Arabic: نزار الرشدان; born 23 March 1999) is a Jordanian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Qatar Stars League club Qatar SC and the Jordan national team.
Nizar Al-Rashdan.note: Al-Rashdan stands out for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Nizar Al-Rashdan.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Nour Bani Attiah.name: Nour Bani Attiah
Nour Bani Attiah.summary: Noureddin Ziad Bani Attiah (Arabic: نُور الدِّين زِيَاد بَنِي عَطِيَّة; born 25 January 1993) is a Jordanian footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Al-Faisaly and the Jordan national team.
Nour Bani Attiah.note: Attiah is defined by organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Nour Bani Attiah.noteZh: 他靠在危险出现前组织好队友与同位置球员拉开差异。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Odeh Fakhoury.name: Odeh Fakhoury
Odeh Fakhoury.summary: Odeh Burhan Shehadeh Fakhoury (Arabic: عودة برهان شحادة الفاخوري; born 22 November 2005) is a Jordanian footballer who plays as a forward for Egyptian Premier League club Pyramids and the Jordan national team.
Odeh Fakhoury.note: Watch Al-Fakhouri for making purposeful movement away from the ball. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Odeh Fakhoury.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是用有目的的无球移动创造接应点。留意他如何从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Prince Adu.name: Prince Adu
Prince Adu.summary: Prince Kwabena Adu (born 23 September 2003) is a Ghanaian footballer who plays for Viktoria Plzeň and the Ghana national team. He was included in The Guardian's "Next Generation 2020".
Prince Adu.note: Adu's edge is starting his run while defenders are still watching the ball. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Prince Adu.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在防守者仍盯着球时提前启动。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Rajaei Ayed.name: Rajaei Ayed
Rajaei Ayed.summary: Raja'ei Ayed Fadel Hasan (Arabic: رَجَائِيّ عَايِد فَاضِل حَسَن; born 25 July 1993) is a Jordanian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Jordanian Pro League club Al-Hussein and the Jordan national team.
Rajaei Ayed.note: Watch Ayed for creating a better angle for the next pass. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives.
Rajaei Ayed.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是为下一脚传球制造更好的角度。留意他如何第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Saed Al-Rosan.name: Saed Al-Rosan
Saed Al-Rosan.summary: Saed Ahmad Salameh Al-Rosan (Arabic: سَعْد أَحْمَد سَلَامَة الرُّوسَان; born 1 February 1997) is a Jordanian professional footballer who plays as a center-back for Jordanian Pro League side Al-Hussein and the Jordan national team.
Saed Al-Rosan.note: Al-Rosan stands out for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Saed Al-Rosan.noteZh: 他的突出特点是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Saleem Obaid.name: Saleem Obaid
Saleem Obaid.summary: Saleem Amer Obaid (Arabic: سَلِيم عَامِر عُبَيْد; born 17 January 1992) is a Jordanian footballer who plays as a left back for Jordanian Pro League side Al-Hussein and the Jordan national team.
Saleem Obaid.note: Obaid's edge is the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Saleem Obaid.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Yazan Al-Arab.name: Yazan Al-Arab
Yazan Al-Arab.summary: Yazan Mousa Mahmoud Abu Al-Arab (Arabic: يَزَن مُوسَى مَحْمُود أَبُو الْعَرَب; born 31 January 1996) is a Jordanian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for K-League side FC Seoul and the Jordan national team.
Yazan Al-Arab.note: Watch Al-Arab for organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Yazan Al-Arab.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在危险出现前组织好队友。留意他如何主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Yazeed Abulaila.name: Yazeed Abulaila
Yazeed Abulaila.summary: Yazeed Moein Hasan Abu Laila (Arabic: يَزِيد مُعِين حَسَن أَبُو لَيْلَى; born 8 January 1993) is a Jordanian footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Jordanian Pro League side Al-Hussein and the Jordan national team.
Yazeed Abulaila.note: Laila stands out for sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Yazeed Abulaila.noteZh: 他的突出特点是提前站位后的快速反应。他会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Douglas Santos.name: Douglas Santos
Douglas Santos.summary: Douglas dos Santos Justino de Melo (Russian: Дуглас До Сантос Жустино Де Мело; born 22 March 1994), known as Douglas Santos or simply Douglas (Brazilian Portuguese: [ˈdowɡlɐs ˈsɐ̃tus]), is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a left-back for...
Douglas Santos.note: Santos stands out for keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Douglas Santos.noteZh: 他的突出特点是压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Ederson Silva.name: Ederson Silva
Ederson Silva.summary: Éderson José dos Santos Lourenço da Silva (born 7 July 1999), simply known as Éderson (Brazilian Portuguese: [ˈɛdeʁsõ(w̃)]), is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Serie A club Atalanta and the Brazil national team.
Ederson Silva.note: Silva's signature is creating a better angle for the next pass. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Ederson Silva.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在为下一脚传球制造更好的角度上。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

note.en: Aguirre gives Mexico a pragmatic tournament shape, with compact defending, fast counters, and enough attacking freedom for the front line to improvise.
note.zh: 阿吉雷让墨西哥呈现务实的大赛形态：防守紧凑、反击迅速，同时给锋线足够自由去即兴创造。

history.en: Back for a third spell with Mexico, he brings long international and club experience from Mexico, Spain, Japan, Egypt, and Mallorca.
history.zh: 这是他第三次执教墨西哥，他带来在墨西哥、西班牙、日本、埃及以及马略卡长期执教的国家队和俱乐部经验。

note.en: Broos favors a disciplined South Africa block, asking his side to protect central spaces before breaking quickly through direct runners.
note.zh: 布鲁斯偏好纪律严明的南非防守阵型，要求球队先保护中路空间，再依靠直接跑动快速反击。

history.en: Appointed in 2021, he rebuilt Bafana Bafana around a younger core after previously winning the Africa Cup of Nations with Cameroon in 2017.
history.zh: 他于2021年上任，此前曾带领喀麦隆赢得2017年非洲杯，随后围绕更年轻的核心重建南非队。

note.en: Hong leans on defensive order and controlled transitions, using South Korea's athletic midfield to press in bursts rather than chase every phase.
note.zh: 洪明甫依靠防守秩序和可控转换，利用韩国队运动能力强的中场进行阶段性压迫，而不是每个阶段都盲目追抢。

history.en: A former national-team captain and 2012 Olympic bronze-medal coach, he returned to the South Korea job in 2024.
history.zh: 他曾是韩国队队长，并作为主教练带队获得2012年奥运会铜牌，2024年重返韩国队帅位。

note.en: Koubek sets Czechia up with a coach's eye for structure: compact lines, physical pressure, and quick service into attacking zones.
note.zh: 库贝克以重视结构的教练视角打造捷克队：阵线紧凑、身体压迫强，并快速把球送入进攻区域。

history.en: A veteran Czech manager, he has led top-flight clubs including Viktoria Plzen and brings decades of domestic experience to the national setup.
history.zh: 他是经验丰富的捷克教练，曾执教比尔森胜利等顶级联赛球队，把数十年的本土执教经验带入国家队体系。

note.en: Marsch wants Canada to play on the front foot, pressing aggressively and turning recoveries into quick vertical attacks.
note.zh: 马什希望加拿大主动出击，高强度压迫，并把夺回球权后的瞬间转化为快速纵向进攻。

history.en: Appointed in 2024, he arrived after senior jobs with New York Red Bulls, Salzburg, Leipzig, Leeds United, and Canada's new-era program.
history.zh: 他于2024年上任，此前执教过纽约红牛、萨尔茨堡、莱比锡、利兹联，并参与加拿大新周期建设。

note.en: Barbarez gives Bosnia and Herzegovina a possession-minded but emotionally direct identity, with midfield control feeding early forward runs.
note.zh: 巴尔巴雷兹让波黑兼具控球思路和直接冲击的气质，用中场控制去支撑锋线更早的前插。

history.en: A former national-team star, he took the Bosnia and Herzegovina job in 2024 after a long playing career in Germany.
history.zh: 他曾是波黑国家队球星，在德国拥有漫长球员生涯，并于2024年接手波黑队。

note.en: Pochettino brings a high-energy United States model built around pressing triggers, brave fullbacks, and quick support around the ball.
note.zh: 波切蒂诺为美国队带来高能量模式，核心是明确的压迫触发点、敢于前插的边后卫，以及围绕持球点的快速支援。

history.en: Appointed in 2024, he came to the USMNT after major club roles with Southampton, Tottenham, Paris Saint-Germain, Chelsea, and Espanyol.
history.zh: 他于2024年上任，此前曾执教南安普顿、托特纳姆热刺、巴黎圣日耳曼、切尔西和西班牙人等俱乐部。

note.en: Alfaro gives Paraguay a rugged, detail-heavy shape: protect the box, compete on set pieces, and counter through direct wide outlets.
note.zh: 阿尔法罗让巴拉圭呈现强硬且重细节的形态：保护禁区、争夺定位球，并通过边路直接出口反击。

history.en: He took over Paraguay in 2024 after leading Ecuador at the 2022 World Cup and Costa Rica through a transition cycle.
history.zh: 他在2024年接手巴拉圭，此前带领厄瓜多尔参加2022年世界杯，并执教哥斯达黎加经历过换代周期。

note.en: Lopetegui usually wants controlled buildup and positional patience, with Qatar trying to move opponents before attacking the final third.
note.zh: 洛佩特吉通常要求可控的后场组织和位置耐心，让卡塔尔先调动对手，再攻击前场最后三区。

history.en: A former Spain, Porto, Real Madrid, Sevilla, Wolves, and West Ham coach, he brings extensive club and international experience.
history.zh: 他曾执教西班牙队、波尔图、皇家马德里、塞维利亚、狼队和西汉姆联，拥有丰富的俱乐部和国家队经验。

note.en: Yakin's Switzerland is comfortable managing tight games, defending compactly, and using set pieces or quick counters to tilt margins.
note.zh: 雅金的瑞士队擅长处理胶着比赛，防守紧凑，并用定位球或快速反击改变细微优势。

history.en: Appointed in 2021, he led Switzerland through the 2022 World Cup and Euro 2024 while keeping a veteran core competitive.
history.zh: 他于2021年上任，带领瑞士参加2022年世界杯和2024年欧洲杯，同时保持老将核心的竞争力。

note.en: Ancelotti keeps Brazil balanced rather than frantic, trusting flexible possession, experienced game management, and individual quality between the lines.
note.zh: 安切洛蒂让巴西保持平衡而非急躁，依靠灵活控球、成熟的比赛管理，以及线间区域的个人能力。

history.en: He moved from a trophy-laden Real Madrid spell to Brazil in 2025, adding the national-team role to one of club football's deepest resumes.
history.zh: 他在2025年从收获众多冠军的皇家马德里转任巴西队主帅，为自己深厚的俱乐部履历增添国家队经历。

note.en: Ouahbi brings a development coach's lens to Morocco, pairing organized defending with quick pressing moments and faith in younger technical players.
note.zh: 瓦赫比把培养型教练视角带到摩洛哥，把有组织的防守、快速压迫时刻，以及对年轻技术型球员的信任结合起来。

history.en: Promoted after work in Morocco's youth pathway, he carries federation continuity from the country's recent international rise.
history.zh: 他在摩洛哥青训体系工作后升任主帅，延续了该国近年国际赛场崛起中的足协路线。

note.en: Migne keeps Haiti pragmatic, asking for defensive discipline first before using set pieces and quick breaks to create tournament chances.
note.zh: 米涅让海地保持务实，先要求防守纪律，再通过定位球和快速突破创造大赛机会。

history.en: He has built a broad international resume across African national teams and clubs before taking charge of Haiti.
history.zh: 在接手海地之前，他已在多支非洲国家队和俱乐部积累了广泛的国际执教履历。

note.en: Clarke's Scotland is organized and stubborn, built on back-line discipline, second-ball pressure, and quick counters from wide areas.
note.zh: 克拉克的苏格兰组织严密且韧性十足，依靠后防纪律、二点球压迫，以及从边路发起的快速反击。

history.en: Appointed in 2019, he guided Scotland back to major tournaments after successful spells with Kilmarnock and West Bromwich Albion.
history.zh: 他于2019年上任，此前在基尔马诺克和西布罗姆维奇执教成功，并带领苏格兰重返大赛舞台。

note.en: Popovic gives Australia a direct, physically secure structure, combining defensive spacing with quick pressure after turnovers.
note.zh: 波波维奇让澳大利亚拥有直接且身体对抗稳定的结构，把防守站位和失球后的快速压迫结合起来。

history.en: Appointed in 2024, the former Socceroo arrived after A-League success with Western Sydney Wanderers, Perth Glory, and Melbourne Victory.
history.zh: 这位前澳大利亚国脚于2024年上任，此前在西悉尼流浪者、珀斯光荣和墨尔本胜利取得澳超成功。

note.en: Montella's Türkiye tries to attack with rhythm, using technical midfielders, wide combinations, and pressing spells to keep opponents under stress.
note.zh: 蒙特拉的土耳其试图用节奏感进攻，依靠技术型中场、边路配合和阶段性压迫持续给对手施压。

history.en: Appointed in 2023, he came from club management in Italy and Türkiye and led the national side into a more expansive phase.
history.zh: 他于2023年上任，此前在意大利和土耳其俱乐部执教，并把国家队带入更开放的阶段。

note.en: Nagelsmann gives Germany flexible pressing and possession patterns, shifting shapes to create overloads without losing rest-defense cover.
note.zh: 纳格尔斯曼给德国带来灵活的压迫和控球模式，通过阵型变化制造人数优势，同时不丢失反击防护。

history.en: Appointed in 2023, he brought high-level Bundesliga and Champions League experience from Hoffenheim, Leipzig, and Bayern Munich.
history.zh: 他于2023年上任，带来在霍芬海姆、莱比锡和拜仁慕尼黑积累的德甲与欧冠高水平经验。

note.en: Advocaat keeps Curacao organized and practical, leaning on defensive clarity, set-piece detail, and experienced game management.
note.zh: 阿德沃卡特让库拉索保持有组织且务实，依靠清晰防守、定位球细节和老练的比赛管理。

history.en: One of international football's most traveled managers, he took charge of Curacao after long spells with clubs and national teams across Europe and beyond.
history.zh: 他是国际足坛执教足迹最广的教练之一，在欧洲及其他地区长期执教俱乐部和国家队后接手库拉索。

note.en: Koeman balances Dutch possession with set-piece threat and measured defensive structure, preferring control over constant risk.
note.zh: 科曼让荷兰队在控球、定位球威胁和稳健防守结构之间取得平衡，更偏好控制而不是持续冒险。

history.en: Back in charge since 2023, he returned to the Netherlands job after earlier national-team work and major club roles including Barcelona.
history.zh: 他自2023年重新执教荷兰队，此前已有国家队经历，并执教过巴塞罗那等重要俱乐部。

note.en: Moriyasu's Japan can control the ball or counter at speed, using disciplined spacing and direct transitions from a deep technical squad.
note.zh: 森保一的日本队既能控球，也能高速反击，依靠纪律严明的站位和技术储备深厚阵容中的直接转换。

history.en: Appointed in 2018, he led Japan at the 2022 World Cup and kept the program on a steady post-tournament path.
history.zh: 他于2018年上任，带领日本参加2022年世界杯，并让球队在赛后周期继续稳定前进。

note.en: Fae gives Cote d'Ivoire a calm counter-attacking base, prioritizing defensive balance before releasing powerful runners into space.
note.zh: 法埃为科特迪瓦建立冷静的反击基础，先确保防守平衡，再把冲击力强的跑动者释放到空间中。

history.en: Promoted during the 2023 Africa Cup of Nations, he guided Cote d'Ivoire to the title and stayed on as head coach.
history.zh: 他在2023年非洲杯期间升任主帅，带领科特迪瓦夺冠，并继续留任。

note.en: Beccacece wants Ecuador to play with intensity, pressing high when possible and using possession to create aggressive attacking angles.
note.zh: 贝卡塞塞希望厄瓜多尔踢得有强度，在条件允许时高位压迫，并用控球创造更具侵略性的进攻角度。

history.en: Appointed in 2024, he arrived after coaching spells in Argentina, Chile, Spain, and the Ecuadorian club game.
history.zh: 他于2024年上任，此前在阿根廷、智利、西班牙以及厄瓜多尔俱乐部执教。

note.en: Potter's Sweden is expected to value patient buildup, flexible attacking rotations, and wide combinations rather than pure direct play.
note.zh: 波特的瑞典预计会重视耐心组织、灵活的进攻轮转和边路配合，而不是单纯直接冲击。

history.en: Appointed after his Premier League and European club work, he brought a development-focused coaching background to Sweden.
history.zh: 他在英超和欧洲俱乐部执教后上任，把重视球员发展的执教背景带到瑞典队。

note.en: Lamouchi gives Tunisia a transition-minded setup, mixing midfield pressure with direct forward runs once possession is recovered.
note.zh: 拉穆希让突尼斯更重视攻防转换，在夺回球权后把中场压迫和直接前插结合起来。

history.en: A former France international, he has managed Cote d'Ivoire, Rennes, Nottingham Forest, Cardiff City, and several clubs in the Middle East.
history.zh: 他曾是法国国脚，执教过科特迪瓦、雷恩、诺丁汉森林、卡迪夫城以及多支中东俱乐部。

note.en: De la Fuente keeps Spain connected to its possession identity while adding vertical runners and trust in players he developed through the youth teams.
note.zh: 德拉富恩特让西班牙延续控球身份，同时加入纵向跑动者，并信任自己在青年队培养过的球员。

history.en: Promoted to the senior job in 2022, he previously led Spain's under-19, under-21, and Olympic teams.
history.zh: 他于2022年升任成年队主帅，此前执教过西班牙19岁以下、21岁以下和奥运代表队。

note.en: Bubista makes Cabo Verde hard to play through, using compact defending, counters, and set pieces to keep matches within reach.
note.zh: 布比斯塔让佛得角很难被打穿，通过紧凑防守、反击和定位球把比赛保持在可争范围内。

history.en: A former Cabo Verde international, he has led the national team since 2020 and overseen one of its strongest competitive periods.
history.zh: 他曾是佛得角国脚，自2020年起执教国家队，并带队经历队史最具竞争力的时期之一。

note.en: Garcia gives Belgium an attacking structure based on passing rhythm, wide support, and pressure from advanced midfielders.
note.zh: 加西亚让比利时的进攻结构建立在传球节奏、边路支援和前插中场的压迫之上。

history.en: Appointed in 2025, he brought club experience from Lille, Roma, Marseille, Lyon, Al Nassr, and Napoli.
history.zh: 他于2025年上任，带来在里尔、罗马、马赛、里昂、利雅得胜利和那不勒斯的俱乐部执教经验。

note.en: Hassan's Egypt is direct and emotionally intense, built around defensive security, quick counters, and set-piece pressure.
note.zh: 哈桑的埃及直接且情绪强度很高，围绕防守安全、快速反击和定位球压力来搭建。

history.en: The country's all-time leading scorer became Egypt head coach in 2024 after a long domestic managerial career.
history.zh: 这位埃及队史射手王在长期本土执教生涯后，于2024年成为埃及主教练。

note.en: Donis tends to use wide overloads and attacking rotations, asking Saudi Arabia to move quickly from buildup into the final third.
note.zh: 多尼斯倾向使用边路人数优势和进攻轮转，要求沙特阿拉伯从组织阶段快速推进到前场最后三区。

history.en: A former Greece international, he has coached clubs in Greece, Cyprus, Saudi Arabia, and the Gulf before this national-team spell.
history.zh: 他曾是希腊国脚，在执教这支国家队之前，曾在希腊、塞浦路斯、沙特阿拉伯和海湾地区俱乐部执教。

note.en: Bielsa's Uruguay plays with relentless pressing, direct running, and man-oriented intensity that can turn games into physical sprints.
note.zh: 贝尔萨的乌拉圭依靠不停歇的压迫、直接跑动和人盯人强度，能把比赛变成身体冲刺。

history.en: Appointed in 2023, he brought his influential club and international career to Uruguay after spells with Argentina, Chile, Athletic Club, Marseille, Lille, and Leeds.
history.zh: 他于2023年上任，此前执教阿根廷、智利、毕尔巴鄂竞技、马赛、里尔和利兹联，把极具影响力的俱乐部和国家队经历带到乌拉圭。

note.en: Ghalehnoy keeps Iran compact and combative, mixing defensive organization with sharp counters through experienced attackers.
note.zh: 加莱诺伊让伊朗保持紧凑且善于对抗，把有组织的防守和老练攻击手发起的锐利反击结合起来。

history.en: Back in charge since 2023, he previously managed Iran in the 2000s and built a long title-winning resume in Iranian club football.
history.zh: 他自2023年重新执教伊朗队，此前曾在2000年代执教国家队，并在伊朗俱乐部足坛积累了长期夺冠履历。

note.en: Bazeley gives New Zealand a disciplined, development-minded setup, with clear roles, organized pressing, and set-piece attention.
note.zh: 巴泽利让新西兰拥有纪律性和发展导向的体系，角色清晰、压迫有组织，并重视定位球。

history.en: Appointed in 2023, he moved up from New Zealand youth and interim roles after a long playing and coaching career in the country.
history.zh: 他于2023年上任，此前在新西兰拥有漫长的球员和教练经历，并从青年队及临时主帅岗位升任。

note.en: Deschamps keeps France ruthlessly practical: defend the center, manage momentum, and let elite transition players decide matches.
note.zh: 德尚让法国保持极其务实：守住中路、管理比赛势头，并让顶级转换球员决定比赛。

history.en: Appointed in 2012, he led France to the 2018 World Cup title, the Euro 2016 final, and the 2022 World Cup final.
history.zh: 他于2012年上任，带领法国赢得2018年世界杯，打进2016年欧洲杯决赛和2022年世界杯决赛。

note.en: Thiaw gives Senegal direct attacking energy, looking for quick service into forwards while keeping enough midfield cover behind the ball.
note.zh: 蒂亚乌给塞内加尔带来直接的进攻能量，寻找快速向前锋输送，同时在球后保留足够中场保护。

history.en: A former Senegal international, he moved through assistant and interim roles before taking over the senior national team.
history.zh: 他曾是塞内加尔国脚，在担任助教和临时主帅后接手成年国家队。

note.en: Arnold's Iraq profile is direct and competitive, using organized defending, pressing spells, and quick forward balls to unsettle opponents.
note.zh: 阿诺德麾下的伊拉克直接且有竞争力，依靠有组织的防守、阶段性压迫和快速前传打乱对手。

history.en: A former Australia head coach and A-League winner, he brings major-tournament experience from the Socceroos and Sydney FC.
history.zh: 他曾执教澳大利亚队并赢得澳超冠军，带来澳大利亚国家队和悉尼足球俱乐部时期的大赛经验。

note.en: Solbakken gives Norway a compact, counter-punching shape, using direct transitions to maximize the side's elite attacking finishers.
note.zh: 索尔巴肯让挪威形成紧凑的反击形态，通过直接转换最大化球队顶级终结者的威胁。

history.en: Appointed in 2020, he arrived after a long club career, especially with Copenhagen, and has steered Norway through multiple qualification cycles.
history.zh: 他于2020年上任，此前拥有长期俱乐部执教经历，尤其是在哥本哈根，并带领挪威走过多个预选赛周期。

note.en: Scaloni builds a compact, intelligent Argentina side that can switch from cautious possession into fast transitions and decisive forward bursts.
note.zh: 斯卡洛尼打造了一支紧凑而聪明的阿根廷队，能从谨慎控球迅速切换到快速转换和决定性的前插冲击。

history.en: Appointed in 2018, he lifted the 2021 Copa America, 2022 Finalissima, 2022 World Cup, and 2024 Copa America.
history.zh: 他于2018年上任，率队赢得2021年美洲杯、2022年欧美杯、2022年世界杯和2024年美洲杯。

note.en: Petkovic gives Algeria defensive structure and pressing discipline, with set pieces and quick wide attacks as practical routes to chances.
note.zh: 佩特科维奇让阿尔及利亚拥有防守结构和压迫纪律，并把定位球和快速边路进攻作为制造机会的务实路径。

history.en: Appointed in 2024, he previously led Switzerland from 2014 to 2021 and coached clubs including Lazio and Bordeaux.
history.zh: 他于2024年上任，此前在2014年至2021年执教瑞士，并执教过拉齐奥和波尔多等俱乐部。

note.en: Rangnick's Austria is defined by coordinated pressure, quick vertical passing, and aggressive counter-pressing after losing the ball.
note.zh: 朗尼克的奥地利以协同压迫、快速纵向传球和失球后的强势反抢为标志。

history.en: Appointed in 2022, he brought his influential pressing background from German club football and consultancy roles to Austria.
history.zh: 他于2022年上任，把自己在德国俱乐部足球和顾问岗位中形成的压迫理念带到奥地利队。

note.en: Sellami keeps Jordan organized and brave in transition, protecting central spaces before springing counters through quick support runs.
note.zh: 塞拉米让约旦保持有组织且敢于转换，先保护中路空间，再通过快速支援跑动发动反击。

history.en: A former Morocco international, he took the Jordan job in 2024 after work with Morocco's domestic and youth programs.
history.zh: 他曾是摩洛哥国脚，在摩洛哥本土和青年项目工作后，于2024年接手约旦队。

note.en: Martinez gives Portugal possession control with pragmatic tournament safeguards, letting creative attackers rotate while the back line stays protected.
note.zh: 马丁内斯让葡萄牙在控球中加入务实的大赛保护，让创造型攻击手轮转，同时保持后防线受保护。

history.en: Appointed in 2023, he came to Portugal after leading Belgium through an extended top-ranked era and the 2018 World Cup semifinals.
history.zh: 他于2023年上任，此前带领比利时长期位居高位，并打进2018年世界杯半决赛。

note.en: Desabre's DR Congo side is built for speed: compact defending, direct transitions, and aggressive forward runs once space opens.
note.zh: 德萨布尔的刚果民主共和国为速度而建：防守紧凑、转换直接，并在空间出现时积极前插。

history.en: Appointed in 2022, he arrived after extensive club and national-team work across Africa and helped DR Congo return to continental prominence.
history.zh: 他于2022年上任，此前在非洲多支俱乐部和国家队积累丰富经历，并帮助刚果民主共和国重返洲际舞台中心。

note.en: Tuchel is detail-heavy: he likes control, clear roles, counter-pressing, and patient problem-solving against packed defenses.
note.zh: 图赫尔非常重视细节：他喜欢控制、清晰角色、丢球反抢，以及面对密集防守时耐心解决问题。

history.en: Appointed England head coach in 2025, he brought Champions League-winning club experience from Chelsea plus major roles at Dortmund, PSG, and Bayern Munich.
history.zh: 他于2025年出任英格兰主教练，带来在切尔西赢得欧冠的俱乐部经验，以及执教多特蒙德、巴黎圣日耳曼和拜仁慕尼黑的履历。

note.en: Dalic gives Croatia tournament calm, trusting midfield control, compact defending, and timely counters rather than chasing every game state.
note.zh: 达利奇让克罗地亚保持大赛冷静，信任中场控制、紧凑防守和适时反击，而不是追着每个比赛状态跑。

history.en: Appointed in 2017, he led Croatia to the 2018 World Cup final, the 2022 World Cup semifinals, and the 2023 Nations League final.
history.zh: 他于2017年上任，带领克罗地亚打进2018年世界杯决赛、2022年世界杯半决赛和2023年欧国联决赛。

note.en: Queiroz gives Ghana a safety-first tournament shape, emphasizing defensive organization, compact midfield spacing, and counters from wide areas.
note.zh: 奎罗斯让加纳呈现安全优先的大赛形态，强调防守组织、紧凑的中场间距，以及从边路发起反击。

history.en: A veteran international coach, he has led Portugal, Iran, Egypt, Colombia, and South Africa, alongside major assistant and club roles.
history.zh: 他是经验丰富的国际教练，曾执教葡萄牙、伊朗、埃及、哥伦比亚和南非，也担任过重要助教和俱乐部职务。

note.en: Christiansen's Panama plays with attacking intent, using direct transitions, wide support, and quick combinations around the forwards.
note.zh: 克里斯蒂安森的巴拿马带着进攻意图比赛，使用直接转换、边路支援和锋线周围的快速配合。

history.en: Appointed in 2020, he led Panama through a strong qualification cycle after club roles in Cyprus, England, Belgium, and Spain.
history.zh: 他于2020年上任，此前在塞浦路斯、英格兰、比利时和西班牙俱乐部执教，并带领巴拿马完成强势预选赛周期。

note.en: Cannavaro's Uzbekistan is built from defensive detail, with set pieces and quick counters used to protect leads and punish mistakes.
note.zh: 卡纳瓦罗的乌兹别克斯坦建立在防守细节之上，通过定位球和快速反击保护领先并惩罚失误。

history.en: The 2006 Ballon d'Or winner moved into management after his playing career, coaching in China, Saudi Arabia, Italy, and Croatia before Uzbekistan.
history.zh: 这位2006年金球奖得主退役后转入教练岗位，在接手乌兹别克斯坦前曾在中国、沙特阿拉伯、意大利和克罗地亚执教。

note.en: Lorenzo prefers a disciplined Colombia shape built on defensive cover, compact pressing windows, and quick vertical counters from narrow zones.
note.zh: 洛伦索偏好纪律严明的哥伦比亚形态，依靠防守保护、紧凑的压迫窗口，以及从狭窄区域发起的快速纵向反击。

history.en: Appointed in 2022, he steadied Colombia after years as an assistant with the national team and coaching experience in Peru.
history.zh: 他于2022年上任，此前多年担任哥伦比亚国家队助教，并在秘鲁有执教经历，上任后稳定了球队。

note.en: Renard gives Tunisia a rugged tournament identity, emphasizing defensive organization, set pieces, and confident pressing in selected moments.
note.zh: 勒纳尔让突尼斯拥有强硬的大赛身份，强调防守组织、定位球，以及在特定时刻自信压迫。

history.en: A two-time Africa Cup of Nations winner with Zambia and Cote d'Ivoire, he brings extensive national-team experience across Africa, Asia, and Europe.
history.zh: 他曾分别带领赞比亚和科特迪瓦两夺非洲杯，拥有横跨非洲、亚洲和欧洲的丰富国家队经验。

note.en: Dalic gives Croatia tournament calm, trusting midfield control, compact defending, and timely counters rather than chasing every game state.
note.zh: 达利奇让克罗地亚保持大赛冷静，信任中场控制、紧凑防守和适时反击，而不是追着每个比赛状态跑。

history.en: This abbreviated FIFA lineup name refers to Zlatko Dalic, Croatia's head coach since 2017 and a World Cup finalist in 2018.
history.zh: 这个国际足联阵容中的缩写姓名指的是兹拉特科·达利奇，他自2017年起执教克罗地亚，并在2018年率队打进世界杯决赛。

ALG.summary: are a technical North African side that want the game to run through the left foot and calm of midfield
ALG.plan: They are at their best when Riyad Mahrez can slow defenders down, Houssem Aouar can connect midfield, and Amine Gouiri can drift away from markers.
ALG.attackPlan: give Mahrez time on the ball while Aouar connects the next pass toward Gouiri
ALG.matchupWin: make the match about controlled touches rather than long defensive chases
ALG.defensiveTask: protecting the space behind their midfield when the ball turns over

ARG.summary: are the defending champions and still one of the most complete tournament teams
ARG.plan: Argentina can keep the ball patiently, but they become much quicker after winning it. Julián Álvarez leads the press, Lionel Messi finds space behind midfield, and Enzo Fernández changes the angle with forward passes.
ARG.planZh: 阿根廷可以耐心控球，但一旦夺回球权就会迅速提速。胡利安·阿尔瓦雷斯负责带动逼抢，梅西寻找对方中场身后的空间，恩佐·费尔南德斯则用向前传球改变进攻角度。
ARG.attackPlan: press high through Alvarez, find Messi in space behind midfield, and let Enzo Fernandez change the angle of the attack
ARG.matchupWin: keep possession without losing pressure after turnovers
ARG.defensiveTask: closing central counters before they reach Emiliano Martinez's box
ARG.defensiveTaskZh: 阻止对手摆脱第一层逼抢后从中路快速反击

AUS.summary: are a durable, physical side built around organization, pressure, and free-kick and corner toughness
AUS.plan: They are comfortable in rugged games where Jackson Irvine can hunt loose balls after duels and Christian Volpato can add the cleaner pass.
AUS.attackPlan: make the match direct enough for Irvine's running and Volpato's left foot to matter
AUS.matchupWin: turn free kicks, corners, and loose balls into territory
AUS.defensiveTask: keeping Mathew Ryan protected through compact defending

AUT.summary: are a high-pressure European side with enough experience to make the press feel organized rather than wild
AUT.plan: They want David Alaba to organize the structure while Marcel Sabitzer and Konrad Laimer turn pressure into quick second attacks.
AUT.attackPlan: force rushed passes and let Sabitzer and Laimer attack the next ball before defenses reset
AUT.matchupWin: make the opponent play at Austria's pressing tempo
AUT.defensiveTask: keeping the defense connected behind Alaba

BEL.summary: are an elite chance-creation team when their creators get space to face forward
BEL.plan: They want Kevin De Bruyne to find early service, Romelu Lukaku to occupy central defenders, and Jeremy Doku to unbalance the far side.

BEL.matchupWin: make the match about chance quality rather than long defensive phases
BEL.defensiveTask: stopping counters before their attacking shape gets stretched

BIH.summary: are a veteran-leaning side that still carry real danger when the match becomes physical and direct
BIH.plan: They can lean on Edin Dzeko as the reference point, then use Sead Kolasinac's edge and Esmir Bajraktarevic's spark to keep attacks alive.
BIH.attackPlan: play into Dzeko early and build around the loose balls that follow
BIH.matchupWin: make the game slower, heavier, and more comfortable for their senior players
BIH.defensiveTask: holding the left side firm when opponents try to run behind Kolasinac

BRA.summary: are a top-tier attacking side whose best moments mix individual invention with sudden acceleration
BRA.plan: They want Neymar to connect the attack, Vinicius Junior to isolate defenders, and Casemiro to stop counters before they grow.
BRA.attackPlan: isolate Vinicius Junior quickly and let Neymar combine around the fouls and gaps that creates
BRA.matchupWin: force defenders into individual matchups they cannot keep winning
BRA.defensiveTask: using Casemiro to close the space behind Brazil's attacking wide defenders

CAN.summary: are a fast, direct host-side threat with enough top-end speed to change games in a few seconds
CAN.plan: They are most dangerous when Alphonso Davies can carry from deep and Jonathan David can attack cutbacks or quick passes after Canada win the ball.
CAN.attackPlan: release Davies into space and get David facing goal before the opponent's defense is set
CAN.matchupWin: turn open grass into the defining feature of the match
CAN.defensiveTask: using Stephen Eustaquio to keep quick breaks from becoming too loose

CIV.summary: are a powerful quick-break team with enough midfield force to turn loose games in their favor
CIV.plan: They want Franck Kessie to drive through midfield, Simon Adingra to stretch the flank, and Evann Guessand to attack the penalty area.
CIV.attackPlan: win the midfield collision and send Adingra into space before Guessand attacks the box
CIV.matchupWin: make the opponent defend power running instead of calm possession
CIV.defensiveTask: keeping the midfield compact when their wide players break forward

COD.summary: are an explosive quick-break side that can make favorites uncomfortable if the match opens up
COD.plan: They need Yoane Wissa as the outlet, Aaron Wan-Bissaka to survive wing pressure, and Noah Sadiki to connect the first pass forward.
COD.attackPlan: spring Wissa early and let Sadiki carry the first clean pass out of pressure
COD.matchupWin: turn defensive stands into counters before the opponent can reset
COD.defensiveTask: surviving wide pressure through Wan-Bissaka's individual defending

COL.summary: are a rhythm-and-width team with enough individual quality to punish any loose defensive spacing
COL.plan: They want Luis Diaz to attack from the left, James Rodriguez to find the final pass, and Luis Suarez to occupy the box.
COL.attackPlan: let Diaz run behind defenders while James looks for the pass that changes the speed of the move
COL.matchupWin: stretch the defense horizontally before playing into the striker
COL.defensiveTask: stopping counters when Diaz and James commit numbers forward

CPV.summary: are compact tournament disruptors who need experience and goalkeeping to keep matches close
CPV.plan: They want Ryan Mendes to make the rare attacking moments count while Roberto Lopes and Vozinha keep the game narrow.
CPV.attackPlan: stay compact long enough for Mendes to find a composed final pass or shot
CPV.matchupWin: make the opponent impatient and protect the center of the box
CPV.defensiveTask: limiting clean shots so Vozinha's saves can matter

CRO.summary: are a control team whose tournament identity still runs through midfield calm
CRO.plan: They want Luka Modric and Mateo Kovacic to slow the match down, while Josko Gvardiol gives them cover when play spreads wide.
CRO.attackPlan: use Modric and Kovacic to turn pressure into possession and move the opponent side to side
CRO.matchupWin: make the game feel like a passing exercise instead of a sprint
CRO.defensiveTask: asking Gvardiol to cover wide spaces when the midfield steps forward

CUW.summary: are a veteran-heavy underdog side trying to stay connected and choose their moments carefully
CUW.plan: They need Juninho Bacuna to carry them forward, Leandro Bacuna to manage free kicks and corners, and Tahith Chong to give counters a runner.
CUW.attackPlan: use the Bacuna brothers to turn pressure relief into free kicks and corners before Chong attacks open space
CUW.matchupWin: make the match choppy enough that favorites lose rhythm
CUW.defensiveTask: staying compact enough for Chong's outlet runs to matter

CZE.summary: are a free-kick, corner, and crossing threat that become dangerous when the game is played in the air
CZE.plan: They want Patrik Schick attacking service, Tomas Soucek crashing the box, and Adam Hlozek connecting play underneath.
CZE.attackPlan: load early service toward Schick and Soucek before the defense settles
CZE.matchupWin: make free kicks, corners, and loose balls as important as open play
CZE.defensiveTask: keeping enough bodies behind the ball when wide defenders deliver early

ECU.summary: are an intense, athletic side that can disrupt stronger opponents through midfield pressure
ECU.plan: They want Moises Caicedo to erase central danger, Piero Hincapie to defend space, and Enner Valencia to finish quick breaks.
ECU.attackPlan: win the midfield duel through Caicedo and release Valencia before the defense is set
ECU.matchupWin: make the middle of the pitch uncomfortable
ECU.defensiveTask: using Hincapie to cover the channels when the line steps up

EGY.summary: are a direct team built around Salah's runs that can look quiet until one attack opens the match
EGY.plan: They want Mohamed Salah running into space, Omar Marmoush adding a second lane, and Zizo supplying the next pass or shot.
EGY.attackPlan: release Salah early and let Marmoush arrive as the second wave

ENG.summary: are one of the strongest teams in the tournament, built around power, speed, and danger near goal
ENG.plan: They can attack aggressively through Harry Kane's link play and Jude Bellingham's runs, then rely on Declan Rice to stop counters.
ENG.attackPlan: turn Kane's dropping movements into Bellingham runs and fast cutbacks from wide areas
ENG.matchupWin: make the match fast and physical before the opponent can settle
ENG.defensiveTask: pressing the first pass into midfield through Rice's positioning

ESP.summary: are one of the tournament's most polished possession teams
ESP.plan: They use Lamine Yamal and Nico Williams to stretch the pitch, then trust Pedri to find the pass through the line.
ESP.attackPlan: pin the wide defenders with Yamal and Williams before Pedri plays through the gaps
ESP.matchupWin: force defenders to choose between stopping the wingers and protecting the middle
ESP.defensiveTask: keeping pressure tight behind their wide defenders

FRA.summary: are an elite attacking side with Mbappe's speed now fed by Olise's left-footed creation
FRA.plan: They want Kylian Mbappe attacking space, Michael Olise choosing the pass or shot, and William Saliba protecting the open field.
FRA.attackPlan: let Olise receive inside, draw pressure, and release Mbappe before the defense can reset
FRA.matchupWin: make the opponent defend space behind their defense
FRA.defensiveTask: trusting Saliba to control counters when France's attackers push high

GER.summary: are a technical control side with enough young creativity to open compact defenses

GER.attackPlan: pull midfielders out with Kimmich's passing before Musiala and Wirtz attack the gaps near the box
GER.matchupWin: make the central gaps too crowded to defend cleanly
GER.defensiveTask: protecting the space behind their advanced midfielders

GHA.summary: are a fast front-line team that need their direct runners to turn defensive work into threat
GHA.plan: They want Antoine Semenyo and Inaki Williams attacking before the defense settles, with Jordan Ayew steadying the ball when needed.
GHA.attackPlan: send Semenyo and Williams into space before the opponent can compress the field
GHA.matchupWin: make the game about running power rather than calm possession
GHA.defensiveTask: using Ayew's calm touches to stop clearances coming straight back

HAI.summary: are a direct attacking underdog with enough forward power to punish loose defending
HAI.plan: They want Duckens Nazon and Frantzdy Pierrot to attack the box while Jean-Ricner Bellegarde helps them escape pressure.
HAI.attackPlan: play forward quickly toward Nazon and Pierrot before the opponent can crowd the box
HAI.matchupWin: make the favorite defend uncomfortable direct balls
HAI.defensiveTask: keeping Bellegarde close enough to turn clearances into attacks

IRN.summary: are a streetwise counterattacking side with experienced attackers who understand tournament margins
IRN.plan: They want Mehdi Taremi linking play, Saman Ghoddos adding the clever pass, and Alireza Jahanbakhsh delivering from wide or dead balls.
IRN.attackPlan: draw contact, slow the rhythm, and then find Taremi or Jahanbakhsh around the box
IRN.matchupWin: turn a patient defensive shape into selective attacks
IRN.defensiveTask: keeping the wide lanes protected before Jahanbakhsh can break out

IRQ.summary: are a passionate, direct side that need their attacking moments to be clean and immediate

IRQ.attackPlan: find Ali Jasim between defenders and then play quickly toward Hussein in the box
IRQ.matchupWin: turn rare possession into attacks with a real endpoint
IRQ.defensiveTask: keeping Iqbal connected to the first outlet pass

JOR.summary: are a disciplined counterattacking side that can hurt teams through speed and timing
JOR.plan: They want Mousa Al-Taamari to carry the break, Ali Olwan to attack the box, and Noor Al-Rawabdeh to keep the defense connected.
JOR.attackPlan: spring Al-Taamari into open space and let Olwan attack the first clear chance
JOR.matchupWin: make the opponent nervous about every turnover
JOR.defensiveTask: holding midfield distances through Al-Rawabdeh's work

JPN.summary: are a precise, fast-passing side that can make possession feel sudden and sharp
JPN.plan: They want the front line to keep moving, Ritsu Doan to attack inside from the right, and Daichi Kamada to connect the final pass.
JPN.attackPlan: move the ball quickly enough for their attackers to receive between defenders
JPN.matchupWin: make the opponent defend repeated changes of angle
JPN.defensiveTask: keeping the first counter controlled after their attacking midfielders commit forward

KOR.summary: are a relentless running side with star quality at both ends of the spine
KOR.plan: They want Son Heung-min attacking space, Kim Min-jae winning first contact, and Lee Kang-in adding the pass that slows the rush.
KOR.attackPlan: release Son behind the line and let Lee Kang-in choose the final pass
KOR.defensiveTask: keeping Kim Min-jae protected from repeated emergency defending

KSA.summary: are a fearless pressing underdog with enough big-moment attackers to punish complacency
KSA.plan: They need Salem Al-Dawsari carrying the emotional moments, Firas Al-Buraikan linking play, and Mohammed Al-Owais keeping them alive.
KSA.attackPlan: press in bursts and give Al-Dawsari room to attack the first retreating defender
KSA.matchupWin: make the favorite play through noise and pressure
KSA.defensiveTask: limiting clean shots so Al-Owais is not overworked

MAR.summary: are a disciplined, dangerous side whose structure lets their flair players attack with freedom
MAR.plan: They want Achraf Hakimi to own the right side, Brahim Diaz to receive between lines, and Ayoub El Kaabi to finish moves.
MAR.attackPlan: use Hakimi's overlaps to tilt the field before Brahim or El Kaabi attacks the final pass or shot
MAR.matchupWin: make the opponent defend both long passes across the field and aerial service
MAR.defensiveTask: keeping the defense compact behind Hakimi's forward runs

MEX.summary: are a home-side pressure team that want territory, crowd energy, and repeated penalty-area touches
MEX.plan: They want Santiago Gimenez occupying the central defenders, Edson Alvarez protecting quick breaks, and Luis Chavez punishing loose clearances.
MEX.attackPlan: keep the ball in the opponent's half and feed Gimenez before Chavez attacks free kicks, corners, or rebounds
MEX.matchupWin: turn pressure into a constant stream of box entries
MEX.defensiveTask: letting Alvarez stop counters before they become open-field runs

NED.summary: are a control team with a strong defensive base and enough technical quality to play through pressure
NED.plan: They want Virgil van Dijk to hold the line, Frenkie de Jong to escape pressure, and Cody Gakpo to connect the attack.
NED.attackPlan: build calmly through De Jong and let Gakpo receive between wide and central defenders
NED.matchupWin: make possession feel secure while still threatening the front line
NED.defensiveTask: using Van Dijk to control depth when the line steps higher

NOR.summary: are a direct star-powered side whose attacking question is how quickly they can serve the finisher
NOR.plan: They want Martin Odegaard finding the pass, Antonio Nusa adding speed, and Erling Haaland attacking the last pass or shot.
NOR.attackPlan: get Odegaard facing forward and deliver early enough for Haaland to attack the box
NOR.matchupWin: make every deep defending moment feel like a Haaland chance is coming
NOR.defensiveTask: keeping enough pressure on the ball before direct counters reach the defense

NZL.summary: are an aerial, organized side that need territory and service to keep stronger opponents honest
NZL.plan: They want Chris Wood as the endpoint, Liberato Cacace moving them up the left, and Sarpreet Singh adding craft.
NZL.attackPlan: move play wide through Cacace and serve Wood before the box gets crowded
NZL.matchupWin: make crosses and loose balls meaningful
NZL.defensiveTask: staying compact enough that Singh can receive the first pass out

PAN.summary: are an organized disruptor side that can make matches uncomfortable through midfield control and wide thrust
PAN.plan: They want Adalberto Carrasquilla to calm the ball, Michael Murillo to push the right side, and Ismael Diaz to finish rare openings.
PAN.attackPlan: use Carrasquilla to escape pressure and let Murillo turn the right side into territory
PAN.matchupWin: make the opponent work through a stubborn, connected defense
PAN.defensiveTask: keeping Diaz close enough to threaten when possession turns

PAR.summary: are rugged counterpunchers who are comfortable turning matches into physical, tight contests
PAR.plan: They want Miguel Almiron carrying them forward, Julio Enciso taking brave shots, and Gustavo Gomez controlling the box.
PAR.attackPlan: release Almiron into space and let Enciso attack the pocket before defenders settle
PAR.matchupWin: make the opponent deal with duels, fouls, and sudden counters
PAR.defensiveTask: leaning on Gomez to organize the penalty area

POR.summary: are a star-heavy attacking side with enough creators to feed several different scoring routes
POR.plan: They want Cristiano Ronaldo occupying the box, Bruno Fernandes creating the chance, and Vitinha setting the rhythm underneath.
POR.attackPlan: let Vitinha control the first pass, then use Bruno Fernandes to find Ronaldo or the far-side runner
POR.matchupWin: make their technical quality show up around the penalty area
POR.defensiveTask: preventing counters when their creators commit forward

QAT.summary: are compact possession builders who need their best attackers to turn long spells into sharper chances
QAT.plan: They want Akram Afif receiving in space, Almoez Ali attacking the final ball, and Homam Ahmed giving them width and recovery runs.
QAT.attackPlan: find Afif in small gaps and let Almoez Ali attack the first clean service
QAT.matchupWin: make possession patient without becoming harmless
QAT.defensiveTask: keeping Ahmed's side secure when the attack pushes up

RSA.summary: are counterattacking underdogs who can stay in games if their goalkeeper and forwards give them belief
RSA.plan: They need Ronwen Williams to hold the scoreline, Teboho Mokoena to compete through midfield, and Lyle Foster to threaten behind.
RSA.attackPlan: absorb pressure, let Mokoena make the first forward pass, and release Foster before the defense recovers
RSA.matchupWin: make the favorite chase without finding a clean second goal
RSA.defensiveTask: protecting Williams from repeated central shots

SCO.summary: are a physical midfield side that can make opponents defend deliveries, duels, and late runners
SCO.plan: They want Andy Robertson serving from the left, John McGinn setting the tone, and Scott McTominay arriving late.
SCO.attackPlan: work the ball left for Robertson and attack the second phase through McTominay
SCO.matchupWin: make the game about timing runs and contact in the box
SCO.defensiveTask: keeping McGinn close enough to stop counters through midfield

SEN.summary: are an athletic, experienced side with enough defensive presence to survive pressure and enough speed to punish it
SEN.plan: They want Sadio Mane leading the attack, Nicolas Jackson stretching the line, and Kalidou Koulibaly winning the defensive duels.
SEN.attackPlan: use Mane's timing and Jackson's depth to attack before the opponent's defense is set
SEN.matchupWin: make the match feel like a series of athletic duels
SEN.defensiveTask: trusting Koulibaly to organize the box under pressure

SUI.summary: are a tournament-tested structure team who rarely look rushed when the match gets tense
SUI.plan: They want Granit Xhaka to set the rhythm, Manuel Akanji to organize the line, and Breel Embolo to give them a target.
SUI.attackPlan: let Xhaka dictate the first pass and find Embolo before the opponent can squeeze midfield
SUI.matchupWin: turn the match into a controlled, repeatable pattern
SUI.defensiveTask: keeping Akanji's line compact against runners

SWE.summary: are a tall, technical attacking side with two forwards who can change the shape of a match
SWE.plan: They want Alexander Isak finding clean touches, Viktor Gyokeres forcing contact, and Yasin Ayari arriving from midfield.
SWE.attackPlan: connect through Ayari and then choose between Isak's polish or Gyokeres' power
SWE.matchupWin: make central defenders handle different kinds of striker movement
SWE.defensiveTask: preventing the midfield from getting stretched behind the front two

TUN.summary: are an organized defensive side that need energy and directness to make their structure bite
TUN.plan: They want Ellyes Skhiri shielding the center, Hannibal Mejbri lifting the intensity, and Elias Saad providing the route forward.
TUN.attackPlan: stay compact through Skhiri and then use Saad as the first runner into space
TUN.matchupWin: turn defensive patience into frustration for the opponent
TUN.defensiveTask: keeping Hannibal's pressure connected rather than scattered

TUR.summary: are a creative young attacking side with enough free-kick and corner quality to punish small mistakes
TUR.plan: They want Hakan Calhanoglu setting the rhythm, Arda Guler creating near the box, and Kenan Yildiz attacking defenders directly.
TUR.attackPlan: use Calhanoglu's passing to find Guler in space before Yildiz attacks the gap
TUR.matchupWin: make their young creators receive facing goal
TUR.defensiveTask: protecting the spaces left when their attackers take risks

URU.summary: are a South American intensity side with enough running power to turn every phase into a contest
URU.plan: They want Federico Valverde to set the energy, Darwin Nunez to stretch the line, and Ronald Araujo to win emergency duels.
URU.attackPlan: use Valverde's running to release Nunez before the defense can control the space behind
URU.matchupWin: make the opponent deal with constant pressure and depth
URU.defensiveTask: trusting Araujo to clean up when the line is exposed

USA.summary: are an athletic pressing team with enough direct attacking talent to make games feel stretched
USA.plan: They want Christian Pulisic attacking near goal, Weston McKennie arriving around the box, and Tyler Adams killing counters.
USA.attackPlan: press into turnovers and let Pulisic or McKennie attack before the defense resets
USA.matchupWin: make the game fast enough that their athleticism matters
USA.defensiveTask: using Adams to stop counters through the middle

UZB.summary: are a disciplined first-time World Cup side with enough spine quality to make opponents work
UZB.plan: They want Eldor Shomurodov to lead the line, Abdukodir Khusanov to organize the defense, and Abbosbek Fayzullaev to add invention.
UZB.attackPlan: play through Fayzullaev's movement and give Shomurodov a real target in the box
UZB.matchupWin: keep the match structured long enough for nerves to shift to the opponent
UZB.defensiveTask: trusting Khusanov to manage pressure without losing the line

worldCupAwards.coverage: Leading-scorer records cover every men's World Cup from 1930 through 2026. Golden Ball records begin in 1978, FIFA Fair Play in 1970, Golden Glove in 1994, and Best Young Player in 2006. Complete five-award sets are archived for every edition from 2006 onward; the active edition is also read from tournament.json.

translations.Vargas converted the decisive kick, comp: 바르가스가 마지막 킥을 성공시켜 스위스의 4-3 승부차기 승리와 아르헨티나와 맞붙는 8강 진출을 확정했다.
translations.Viktor Gyokeres set up Anthony Elanga fo: 빅토르 요케레스의 패스를 받은 안토니 엘랑가가 62분에 득점해 스웨덴을 1-1 동점으로 이끌었다.
translations.Vinicius Junior set up Matheus Cunha for: 비니시우스 주니어의 패스를 받은 마테우스 쿠냐가 36분에 득점해 브라질의 리드를 두 골 차로 벌렸다.
translations.Vladimir Coufal set up Ladislav Krejci f: 블라디미르 초우팔의 패스를 받은 라디슬라프 크레지가 59분에 득점해 체코를 앞서게 했다.
translations.Volpato hit the crossbar before Ashour h: 볼파토가 골대를 맞힌 뒤 아슈르가 13분 하페즈의 크로스를 헤더로 마무리해 이집트를 앞세웠다.
translations.Wilfried Singo set up Amad Diallo for a: 윌프리드 싱고의 패스를 받은 아마드 디알로가 90분에 득점해 마침내 0-0 균형을 깨며 코트디부아르를 앞서게 했다.
translations.Withdrew due to injury on June 11 and wa: 6월 11일 부상으로 대표팀에서 이탈했고, 마치노 슈토가 대체 발탁됐습니다.
translations.Xaver Schlager set up Romano Schmid for: 크사버 슐라거의 패스를 받은 로마노 슈미트가 20분에 득점해 오스트리아를 앞서게 했다.
translations.Yakin's Switzerland is comfortable manag: 야킨 감독의 스위스는 팽팽한 경기 운영에 능하다. 촘촘하게 수비하고 세트피스와 빠른 역습으로 접전의 균형을 자신들 쪽으로 기울인다.
translations.Yamal won the 22nd-minute penalty, and O: 야말이 22분 페널티킥을 얻어냈고, 오야르사발이 성공시켜 대회 5호 골을 기록했다.
translations.Yan Diomande set up Nicolas Pepe for a f: 얀 디오망데의 패스를 받은 니콜라 페페가 7분에 득점해 코트디부아르에 빠른 출발을 안겼다.
translations.Yasin Ayari struck in the 7th minute, gi: 야신 아야리가 7분에 득점해 스웨덴에 빠른 출발을 안겼다.
translations.Yasser Ibrahim and Mostafa Ziko gave Egy: 야세르 이브라힘과 모스타파 지코가 이집트에 2-0 리드를 안기며 아르헨티나를 탈락 직전까지 몰았다.
translations.Yoane Wissa levelled at 68', but Fiston: 요안 위사가 68분에 동점골을 넣었지만, 피스통 마옐레가 78분에 득점해 콩고민주공화국의 리드를 되찾았다.

headline.en: Messi leads all scorers with five World Cup goals
headline.zh: 梅西以5球领跑世界杯射手榜

body.en: Lionel Messi's brace against Austria lifted him to five goals from Argentina's first two matches.
body.zh: 利昂内尔·梅西对奥地利的梅开二度，让他在阿根廷前两场比赛后达到5球。

standouts.en: He sits alone at the top of the Golden Boot race after following his opening hat trick with another decisive night.
standouts.zh: 他在首战帽子戏法后又打出决定性表现，独自领跑金靴奖竞争。
